-- Studio lighting is applied on the server; no frame loops or client effects required.
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local StudioLighting = {}

StudioLighting.PresetOrder = { "Warm", "Broadcast", "Daylight", "Night", "TealAmber", "Violet", "Focus", "Portrait" }
StudioLighting.AccentColors = {
	{ Name = "Teal", Hex = "47DCC6" }, { Name = "Amber", Hex = "FFBE73" },
	{ Name = "Ice", Hex = "8BCFFF" }, { Name = "Violet", Hex = "B299FF" },
	{ Name = "Rose", Hex = "F58EB2" }, { Name = "White", Hex = "E9EFEA" },
}

local function preset(name, description, temperature, key, fill, accent, exposure, bloom, contrast, color, ceiling, practical)
	return {
		Name = name, Description = description,
		Settings = {
			Temperature = temperature, KeyIntensity = key, FillIntensity = fill, AccentIntensity = accent,
			Exposure = exposure, Bloom = bloom, Contrast = contrast, AccentColor = color,
			CeilingLights = ceiling, PracticalLights = practical, AccentLights = true,
		},
	}
end

StudioLighting.Presets = {
	Warm = preset("Warm conversation", "Warm skin tones, gentle fill, and a restrained teal background.", 3600, 1.0, 0.80, 0.65, -0.15, 0.06, 0.06, "47DCC6", true, true),
	Broadcast = preset("Broadcast neutral", "Clean neutral lighting for a polished panel or interview.", 5000, 1.20, 1.05, 0.40, -0.10, 0.025, 0.04, "8BCFFF", true, true),
	Daylight = preset("Daylight meeting", "Bright, cool-white studio lighting for a clear daytime meeting.", 6500, 1.15, 1.30, 0.35, 0.0, 0.02, 0.0, "E9EFEA", true, false),
	Night = preset("Late night", "Low ambient light with warm faces and a quiet blue backdrop.", 3000, 1.10, 1.00, 0.65, -0.10, 0.08, 0.04, "8BCFFF", false, true),
	TealAmber = preset("Teal & amber", "Amber conversation lighting against a stronger teal studio accent.", 3200, 1.05, 0.65, 1.15, -0.20, 0.075, 0.10, "47DCC6", true, true),
	Violet = preset("Violet lounge", "Soft neutral faces with a violet background for relaxed sessions.", 4300, 1.05, 1.05, 1.05, -0.10, 0.08, 0.04, "B299FF", false, true),
	Focus = preset("Meeting focus", "Even, low-contrast light with minimal decorative glow.", 4700, 1.15, 1.35, 0.15, 0.0, 0.0, -0.04, "E9EFEA", true, false),
	Portrait = preset("Soft portrait", "Gentle warm-white keys and generous fill for close camera angles.", 4200, 0.95, 1.20, 0.40, -0.10, 0.025, -0.02, "F58EB2", true, true),
}
for id, entry in pairs(StudioLighting.Presets) do
	entry.Settings.Preset = id
end
StudioLighting.Defaults = table.clone(StudioLighting.Presets.Warm.Settings)

local bounds = {
	KeyIntensity = { 0, 2 }, FillIntensity = { 0, 2 }, AccentIntensity = { 0, 2 },
	Temperature = { 2700, 7500 }, Exposure = { -1, 1 }, Bloom = { 0, 0.4 }, Contrast = { -0.2, 0.3 },
}

-- A deliberately softened white balance: extremely orange lights clip faces and pale props.
local function temperatureColor(kelvin)
	local t = kelvin / 100
	local red = t <= 66 and 255 or 329.698727446 * ((t - 60) ^ -0.1332047592)
	local green = t <= 66 and (99.4708025861 * math.log(t) - 161.1195681661)
		or (288.1221695283 * ((t - 60) ^ -0.0755148492))
	local blue = t >= 66 and 255 or (138.5177312231 * math.log(t - 10) - 305.0447927307)
	local color = Color3.fromRGB(math.clamp(red, 0, 255), math.clamp(green, 0, 255), math.clamp(blue, 0, 255))
	return color:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.38)
end

local function sanitize(input)
	input = type(input) == "table" and input or {}
	local selected = StudioLighting.Presets[input.Preset] and input.Preset or "Warm"
	local result = table.clone(StudioLighting.Presets[selected].Settings)
	result.SceneSet = type(input.SceneSet) == "string" and input.SceneSet or "Custom"
	for key, range in pairs(bounds) do
		local value = input[key]
		if type(value) == "number" and value == value then
			result[key] = math.clamp(value, range[1], range[2])
		end
	end
	for _, key in ipairs({ "CeilingLights", "PracticalLights", "AccentLights" }) do
		if type(input[key]) == "boolean" then result[key] = input[key] end
	end
	if type(input.AccentColor) == "string" then
		local hex = string.upper(input.AccentColor:gsub("^#", ""))
		if #hex == 6 and hex:match("^%x+$") then result.AccentColor = hex end
	end
	local catalog = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("PodcastRooms")
	if catalog then
		for _, scene in ipairs(catalog:GetChildren()) do
			local groups = scene:FindFirstChild("LightingGroups")
			if groups then
				for _, group in ipairs(groups:GetChildren()) do
					local key = group:GetAttribute("Key")
					if type(key) == "string" then
						local value = input[key]
						result[key] = type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.clamp(value, 0, 1.5) or 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return result
end

local function ensure(parent, className, name)
	local instance = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if instance and not instance:IsA(className) then instance:Destroy(); instance = nil end
	if not instance then
		instance = Instance.new(className)
		instance.Name = name
		instance.Parent = parent
	end
	return instance
end

local function fixture(rig, name, position, target, brightness, color, lightClass, range, shadows)
	local part = ensure(rig, "Part", name)
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position, target)
	local light = ensure(part, lightClass, "StudioLight")
	light.Enabled = brightness > 0
	light.Brightness = brightness
	light.Color = color
	light.Range = range
	light.Shadows = shadows
	if light:IsA("SpotLight") then light.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front; light.Angle = 85 end
	return part
end

local function emissive(part, enabled, color, strength)
	part.Material = enabled and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.Color = enabled and color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), math.clamp(0.42 - strength * 0.15, 0.12, 0.42))
		or color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.85)
end

local function roomBounds(model, entry)
	local low = entry and entry:GetAttribute("BoundsMin")
	local high = entry and entry:GetAttribute("BoundsMax")
	if typeof(low) == "Vector3" and typeof(high) == "Vector3"
		and high.X - low.X > 2 and high.Y - low.Y > 2 and high.Z - low.Z > 2 then
		return low, high
	end
	local frame, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
	local half = size * 0.5
	local x, y, z = frame.RightVector, frame.UpVector, frame.LookVector
	local extent = Vector3.new(
		math.abs(x.X) * half.X + math.abs(y.X) * half.Y + math.abs(z.X) * half.Z,
		math.abs(x.Y) * half.X + math.abs(y.Y) * half.Y + math.abs(z.Y) * half.Z,
		math.abs(x.Z) * half.X + math.abs(y.Z) * half.Y + math.abs(z.Z) * half.Z)
	return frame.Position - extent, frame.Position + extent
end

local function resolveRoom(name)
	if type(name) ~= "string" then return nil end
	local simpleName = name:match("([^%./]+)$") or name
	local root = workspace:FindFirstChild(simpleName)
	local collection = workspace:FindFirstChild("RoomCollection")
	return root or (collection and collection:FindFirstChild(simpleName))
end

local function collectRooms()
	local catalog = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("PodcastRooms")
	local byScene, allRooms, seen = {}, {}, {}
	local function add(id, model, entry)
		if not model or not model:IsA("Model") then return end
		local low, high = roomBounds(model, entry)
		local center = entry and entry:GetAttribute("Center")
		local spec = { Id = id, Model = model, Entry = entry, Min = low, Max = high,
			Center = typeof(center) == "Vector3" and center or (low + high) * 0.5 }
		byScene[id] = spec
		if not seen[model] then table.insert(allRooms, spec); seen[model] = true end
	end
	if catalog then
		for _, entry in ipairs(catalog:GetChildren()) do
			if entry.Name ~= "Custom" then add(entry.Name, resolveRoom(entry:GetAttribute("ModelName")), entry) end
		end
	end
	for id, name in pairs({ FreeModels = "FreeModelStudio", Broadcast = "BroadcastSet", Boardroom = "ConferenceRoom", Lounge = "LivingRoom" }) do
		if not byScene[id] then add(id, resolveRoom(name), nil) end
	end
	-- Disable lighting in imported rooms even before they receive a catalog entry.
	local collection = workspace:FindFirstChild("RoomCollection")
	if collection then
		for _, model in ipairs(collection:GetChildren()) do
			if model:IsA("Model") and not seen[model] then add(model.Name, model, nil) end
		end
	end
	return byScene, allRooms
end

local groupDefinitions = {
	FreeModels = {
		{ Id = "Ceiling", Label = "Ceiling & pendant lights", Circuit = "Ceiling" },
		{ Id = "Lamps", Label = "Floor & task lamps", Circuit = "Practical" },
		{ Id = "Accents", Label = "Wall accent strips", Circuit = "Accent" },
	},
	Broadcast = {
		{ Id = "Truss", Label = "Overhead truss lights", Circuit = "Ceiling" },
		{ Id = "Softboxes", Label = "Studio softboxes", Circuit = "Practical" },
		{ Id = "Practicals", Label = "Signs & practical lights", Circuit = "Accent" },
	},
	Boardroom = {
		{ Id = "Perimeter", Label = "Perimeter lights", Circuit = "Ceiling" },
		{ Id = "Presentation", Label = "Presentation wall lights", Circuit = "Ceiling" },
		{ Id = "DeskLamps", Label = "Desk lamps", Circuit = "Practical" },
	},
	Lounge = {
		{ Id = "Ceiling", Label = "Ceiling spotlights", Circuit = "Ceiling" },
		{ Id = "Pendants", Label = "Kitchen pendant lights", Circuit = "Practical" },
		{ Id = "Wall", Label = "Wall & feature lights", Circuit = "Accent" },
		{ Id = "TaskLamps", Label = "Reading & task lamps", Circuit = "Practical" },
	},
}

groupDefinitions.AfterHoursFree = groupDefinitions.FreeModels

local function nativeGroup(spec, part)
	local ancestry = part and string.lower(part:GetFullName()) or ""
	local position = part and part.Position or spec.Center
	local taskLamp = ancestry:find("task lamp", 1, true) or ancestry:find("desk lamp", 1, true)
	local height = position.Y - spec.Min.Y
	if spec.Id == "FreeModels" or spec.Id == "AfterHoursFree" then
		if taskLamp or ancestry:find("floor lamp", 1, true) or ancestry:find("bulb_color4", 1, true) then return "Lamps" end
		if ancestry:find("lobbylight", 1, true) or height > 10 then return "Ceiling" end
		return "Accents"
	elseif spec.Id == "Broadcast" then
		if ancestry:find("softbox", 1, true) or ancestry:find("ubrella", 1, true) or ancestry:find("umbrella", 1, true) then return "Softboxes" end
		if not taskLamp and height > (spec.Max.Y - spec.Min.Y) * 0.6 then return "Truss" end
		return "Practicals"
	elseif spec.Id == "Boardroom" then
		if taskLamp then return "DeskLamps" end
		if height < 8.5 then return "Presentation" end
		return "Perimeter"
	elseif spec.Id == "Lounge" then
		if taskLamp then return "TaskLamps" end
		if height > (spec.Max.Y - spec.Min.Y) * 0.88 then return "Ceiling" end
		-- The kitchen pendant cluster sits just left of center at mid-room height.
		if position.X > spec.Min.X + 14 and position.X < spec.Min.X + 17
			and height > 7 and height < 10 then return "Pendants" end
		return "Wall"
	end
	return nil
end

local function isDisplaySurface(part, room)
	-- A lamp mounted near a screen still belongs to its lighting circuit.
	if part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Light", true) then return false end
	local ancestor = part
	while ancestor and ancestor ~= room do
		local name = string.lower(ancestor.Name)
		if name == "tv" or name:find("television", 1, true) or name:find("display", 1, true)
			or name:find("monitor", 1, true) or name:find("screen", 1, true) then return true end
		ancestor = ancestor.Parent
	end
	return false
end

-- Run after adding imported fixtures. This only writes catalog metadata and light tags.
function StudioLighting.RefreshLightingGroups()
	local byScene = collectRooms()
	local summary = {}
	for sceneId, definitions in pairs(groupDefinitions) do
		local spec = byScene[sceneId]
		if spec and spec.Entry then
			local folder = ensure(spec.Entry, "Folder", "LightingGroups")
			local counts, nativeCounts, configs = {}, {}, {}
			for index, definition in ipairs(definitions) do
				local group = ensure(folder, "Folder", definition.Id)
				group:SetAttribute("Label", definition.Label)
				group:SetAttribute("Key", sceneId .. "_" .. definition.Id)
				group:SetAttribute("Default", 1)
				group:SetAttribute("Order", index)
				counts[definition.Id], nativeCounts[definition.Id], configs[definition.Id] = 0, 0, definition
			end
			for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
				if not configs[child.Name] then child:Destroy() end
			end
			local function tag(object, part)
				local id = nativeGroup(spec, part)
				local definition = configs[id]
				if not definition then return nil end
				local circuit = definition.Circuit
				if part then
					local path = string.lower(part:GetFullName())
					if path:find("task lamp", 1, true) or path:find("desk lamp", 1, true) then circuit = "Practical" end
				end
				object:SetAttribute("StudioLightGroup", sceneId .. "_" .. id)
				object:SetAttribute("StudioLightCircuit", circuit)
				return id
			end
			for _, item in ipairs(spec.Model:GetDescendants()) do
				if item:IsA("Light") then
					local part = item:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
					local id = tag(item, part)
					if id then counts[id] += 1; nativeCounts[id] += 1 end
					if part then tag(part, part) end
				elseif item:IsA("BasePart") and (item.Material == Enum.Material.Neon or item:GetAttribute("PodcastEmissiveCircuit")) then
					-- Preserve tiny equipment indicators; a bulb carrying a native light is tagged above.
					if isDisplaySurface(item, spec.Model) then
						item:SetAttribute("StudioLightGroup", nil)
						item:SetAttribute("StudioLightCircuit", nil)
					elseif math.max(item.Size.X, item.Size.Y, item.Size.Z) >= 1 or item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Light", true) then
						local id = tag(item, item)
						if id and not item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Light", true) then counts[id] += 1 end
					end
				end
			end
			for id, count in pairs(counts) do
				folder[id]:SetAttribute("Count", count)
				folder[id]:SetAttribute("NativeLightCount", nativeCounts[id])
			end
			summary[sceneId] = counts
		end
	end
	return summary
end

local function importedRoomLights(spec, active, state, white, accent)
	local room = spec.Model
	local floorY = spec.Min.Y
	local roomHeight = spec.Max.Y - floorY
	local descendants = room:GetDescendants()
	local count = 0
	for _, item in ipairs(descendants) do if item:IsA("Light") then count += 1 end end
	local densityScale = math.clamp(math.sqrt(12 / math.max(count, 12)), 0.45, 1)
	local function groupPower(item)
		local key = item:GetAttribute("StudioLightGroup")
		local value = key and state[key]
		return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.clamp(value, 0, 1.5) or 1
	end
	local function circuitFor(part)
		if not part then return "Practical" end
		local ancestry = string.lower(part:GetFullName())
		if ancestry:find("on air", 1, true) or ancestry:find("neon", 1, true) or ancestry:find("accent", 1, true) then return "Accent" end
		if part.Name == "Bulb_Color4" or ancestry:find("floor lamp", 1, true)
			or ancestry:find("softbox", 1, true) or ancestry:find("umbrella", 1, true) or ancestry:find("ubrella", 1, true) then return "Practical" end
		if part.Name == "Lightbulb" or ancestry:find("ceiling", 1, true)
			or part.Position.Y > floorY + roomHeight * 0.60 then return "Ceiling" end
		if part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Light", true) then return "Practical" end
		-- Small microphone/status LEDs are equipment, not room-lighting controls.
		if math.max(part.Size.X, part.Size.Y, part.Size.Z) >= 1 then return "Accent" end
		return nil
	end
	local function enabled(circuit)
		if not active then return false end
		if circuit == "Ceiling" then return state.CeilingLights end
		if circuit == "Practical" then return state.PracticalLights end
		return state.AccentLights and state.AccentIntensity > 0
	end
	for _, item in ipairs(descendants) do
		if item:IsA("Light") then
			local part = item:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
			local circuit = item:GetAttribute("StudioLightCircuit") or item:GetAttribute("PodcastLightCircuit") or circuitFor(part) or "Accent"
			if item:GetAttribute("PodcastLightBrightness") == nil then
				item:SetAttribute("PodcastLightBrightness", item.Brightness)
				item:SetAttribute("PodcastLightColor", item.Color)
				item:SetAttribute("PodcastLightRange", item.Range)
				item:SetAttribute("PodcastLightEnabled", item.Enabled)
				item:SetAttribute("PodcastLightCircuit", circuit)
			end
			-- Active circuits may restore lights hidden by room switching before baseline capture.
			local groupScale = groupPower(item)
			item.Enabled = enabled(circuit) and groupScale > 0 and item:GetAttribute("PodcastLightBrightness") > 0
			item.Color = circuit == "Accent" and accent or white
			local multiplier = circuit == "Ceiling" and 0.55 or (circuit == "Accent" and state.AccentIntensity or 1)
			local cap = circuit == "Ceiling" and 0.9 or (circuit == "Accent" and 0.65 * state.AccentIntensity or 0.75)
			local baseOutput = math.min(item:GetAttribute("PodcastLightBrightness") * multiplier, cap) * densityScale
			-- Reserve headroom for the complete 0–150% slider travel instead of flattening its top end.
			if spec.Id == "Lounge" then baseOutput = math.min(baseOutput, 0.7 / 1.5) end
			local output = baseOutput * groupScale
			item.Brightness = spec.Id == "Lounge" and math.min(output, 0.7) or output
			item.Range = math.min(item:GetAttribute("PodcastLightRange"), circuit == "Ceiling" and 24 or 14,
				math.max(8, math.max(spec.Max.X - spec.Min.X, spec.Max.Z - spec.Min.Z) * 0.7), spec.Id == "Lounge" and 18 or 60)
		elseif item:IsA("BasePart") and (item.Material == Enum.Material.Neon or item:GetAttribute("PodcastEmissiveCircuit")) then
			if isDisplaySurface(item, room) then
				-- Repair screens tinted by earlier versions, then leave their native appearance alone.
				local originalColor = item:GetAttribute("PodcastEmissiveColor")
				local originalMaterial = item:GetAttribute("PodcastEmissiveMaterial")
				if typeof(originalColor) == "Color3" then item.Color = originalColor end
				if type(originalMaterial) == "string" and Enum.Material[originalMaterial] then item.Material = Enum.Material[originalMaterial] end
				continue
			end
			local circuit = item:GetAttribute("StudioLightCircuit") or item:GetAttribute("PodcastEmissiveCircuit") or circuitFor(item)
			if circuit then
				if item:GetAttribute("PodcastEmissiveCircuit") == nil then
					item:SetAttribute("PodcastEmissiveCircuit", circuit)
					item:SetAttribute("PodcastEmissiveColor", item.Color)
					item:SetAttribute("PodcastEmissiveMaterial", item.Material.Name)
				end
				local groupScale = groupPower(item)
				emissive(item, enabled(circuit) and groupScale > 0, circuit == "Accent" and accent or white,
					(circuit == "Accent" and state.AccentIntensity or 0.8) * groupScale)
				if groupScale > 0 and groupScale < 1 then
					local color = item.Color
					item.Color = Color3.new(color.R * groupScale, color.G * groupScale, color.B * groupScale)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local overrideAttributes = {
	"StudioOverrideEnabled", "StudioOverrideIntensity", "StudioOverrideColor", "StudioOverrideRange",
}

local function indexedPath(instance, root)
	local names = {}
	local node = instance
	while node and node ~= root do
		local ordinal = 0
		if node.Parent then
			for _, sibling in ipairs(node.Parent:GetChildren()) do
				if sibling.Name == node.Name and sibling.ClassName == node.ClassName then ordinal += 1 end
				if sibling == node then break end
			end
		end
		table.insert(names, 1, node.ClassName .. ":" .. node.Name .. "[" .. ordinal .. "]")
		node = node.Parent
	end
	return table.concat(names, "/")
end

local function fixtureGuid(seed)
	-- Deterministic GUID-format IDs, persisted on the light so renaming/reparenting preserves identity.
	local chunks = {}
	for index, multiplier in ipairs({ 31, 131, 8191, 65599 }) do
		local hash = 2166136261 + index * 7919
		for offset = 1, #seed do hash = (hash * multiplier + seed:byte(offset) + offset) % 4294967296 end
		chunks[index] = string.format("%08x", hash)
	end
	local hex = table.concat(chunks)
	return hex:sub(1, 8) .. "-" .. hex:sub(9, 12) .. "-" .. hex:sub(13, 16) .. "-" .. hex:sub(17, 20) .. "-" .. hex:sub(21, 32)
end

local function cachePrefix(sceneId)
	return "StudioRigSaved_" .. fixtureGuid(tostring(sceneId)):gsub("%-", "") .. "_"
end

local function switchRigScene(light, sceneId)
	local previous = light:GetAttribute("StudioSceneId")
	if type(previous) == "string" and previous ~= sceneId then
		local previousPrefix = cachePrefix(previous)
		for index, attribute in ipairs(overrideAttributes) do
			light:SetAttribute(previousPrefix .. index, light:GetAttribute(attribute))
		end
		light:SetAttribute(previousPrefix .. "Present", true)
		local nextPrefix = cachePrefix(sceneId)
		for index, attribute in ipairs(overrideAttributes) do
			light:SetAttribute(attribute, light:GetAttribute(nextPrefix .. index))
		end
	end
	light:SetAttribute("StudioSceneId", sceneId)
end

local function fixtureEmitter(light)
	local part = light:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
	if not part or part.Transparency >= 1 then return nil end
	local dimensions = { part.Size.X, part.Size.Y, part.Size.Z }
	table.sort(dimensions)
	if dimensions[3] > 4 or dimensions[2] * dimensions[3] > 12 then return nil end
	local count = 0
	for _, child in ipairs(part:GetDescendants()) do if child:IsA("Light") then count += 1 end end
	if count ~= 1 then return nil end
	local material = part:GetAttribute("StudioBaseVisualMaterial") or part:GetAttribute("PodcastEmissiveMaterial")
	if part.Material ~= Enum.Material.Neon and material ~= "Neon" and part.Name ~= "Pendant diffuser"
		and part:GetAttribute("StudioFixtureEmitter") ~= true then return nil end
	local ancestor = part
	while ancestor and ancestor ~= workspace do
		local name = string.lower(ancestor.Name)
		if name == "tv" or name:find("television", 1, true) or name:find("display", 1, true)
			or name:find("monitor", 1, true) or name:find("screen", 1, true) then return nil end
		ancestor = ancestor.Parent
	end
	return part
end

local function captureFixtureVisual(light)
	local part = fixtureEmitter(light)
	if part then
		part:SetAttribute("StudioFixtureEmitter", true)
		part:SetAttribute("StudioBaseVisualColor", part.Color)
		part:SetAttribute("StudioBaseVisualMaterial", part.Material.Name)
	end
end

local function restoreFixtureVisual(light)
	local part = fixtureEmitter(light)
	if not part then return end
	local color = part:GetAttribute("StudioBaseVisualColor")
	local material = part:GetAttribute("StudioBaseVisualMaterial")
	if typeof(color) == "Color3" then part.Color = color end
	if type(material) == "string" then part.Material = Enum.Material[material] end
end

local function captureFixtureBase(light)
	light:SetAttribute("StudioBaseEnabled", light.Enabled)
	light:SetAttribute("StudioBaseBrightness", light.Brightness)
	light:SetAttribute("StudioBaseColor", light.Color)
	light:SetAttribute("StudioBaseRange", light.Range)
	captureFixtureVisual(light)
end

local function restoreFixtureBase(light)
	local enabled = light:GetAttribute("StudioBaseEnabled")
	local brightness = light:GetAttribute("StudioBaseBrightness")
	local color = light:GetAttribute("StudioBaseColor")
	local range = light:GetAttribute("StudioBaseRange")
	if type(enabled) == "boolean" then light.Enabled = enabled end
	if type(brightness) == "number" then light.Brightness = brightness end
	if typeof(color) == "Color3" then light.Color = color end
	if type(range) == "number" then light.Range = range end
	restoreFixtureVisual(light)
end

local function selectablePart(part)
	if not part or part.Transparency >= 1 or not part.CanQuery then return false end
	local size = { part.Size.X, part.Size.Y, part.Size.Z }
	table.sort(size)
	return size[2] <= 0.75 or (size[3] <= 12 and size[2] * size[3] <= 64)
end

-- Registers all physical fixtures; rig identity is physical while its scene membership follows Apply.
function StudioLighting.RefreshFixtures(activeSceneId)
	local studio = workspace:FindFirstChild("PodcastStudio")
	local rig = studio and studio:FindFirstChild("LightingRig")
	local settings = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("PodcastSettings")
	activeSceneId = activeSceneId or (rig and rig:GetAttribute("StudioSceneId"))
		or (settings and settings:GetAttribute("SceneSet")) or "Custom"
	if rig then rig:SetAttribute("StudioSceneId", activeSceneId) end
	local records, usedIds = {}, {}
	local function registerRoot(root, sceneId, identityScene, isRig)
		if not root then return end
		local lights = {}
		for _, descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant:IsA("Light") and (isRig or not rig or not descendant:IsDescendantOf(rig)) then
				table.insert(lights, { Light = descendant, Path = indexedPath(descendant, root) })
			end
		end
		table.sort(lights, function(a, b) return a.Path < b.Path end)
		local nameCounts = {}
		for _, entry in ipairs(lights) do
			local light = entry.Light
			local part = light:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
			local id = light:GetAttribute("StudioFixtureId")
			if type(id) ~= "string" or id == "" or (usedIds[id] and usedIds[id] ~= light) then
				local salt = identityScene .. "/" .. entry.Path
				id = fixtureGuid(salt)
				local collision = 0
				while usedIds[id] and usedIds[id] ~= light do collision += 1; id = fixtureGuid(salt .. ":" .. collision) end
				light:SetAttribute("StudioFixtureId", id)
			end
			usedIds[id] = light
			if isRig then switchRigScene(light, sceneId) else light:SetAttribute("StudioSceneId", sceneId) end
			light:SetAttribute("StudioFixtureRig", isRig)
			if light:GetAttribute("StudioFixtureOriginalEnabled") == nil then
				light:SetAttribute("StudioFixtureOriginalEnabled", light.Enabled)
			end
			if light:GetAttribute("StudioBaseBrightness") == nil then captureFixtureBase(light) end
			local label = part and part.Name or light.Name
			if isRig then
				label = label:gsub("^SeatKey(%d+)$", "Seat %1 face light")
					:gsub("^SoftFill(%d+)$", "Room fill %1"):gsub("^BackdropWash(%d+)$", "Backdrop wash %1")
			else
				local groupKey = light:GetAttribute("StudioLightGroup")
				local catalog = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("PodcastRooms")
				local config = catalog and catalog:FindFirstChild(sceneId)
				local groups = config and config:FindFirstChild("LightingGroups")
				if groups and groupKey then
					for _, group in ipairs(groups:GetChildren()) do
						if group:GetAttribute("Key") == groupKey then label = group:GetAttribute("Label") or label; break end
					end
				end
				nameCounts[label] = (nameCounts[label] or 0) + 1
				label = label .. " " .. nameCounts[label]
			end
			light:SetAttribute("StudioFixtureName", label)
			if part then
				local selectable = selectablePart(part)
				part:SetAttribute("StudioSelectableLight", selectable)
				-- Only a part with one light gets an unambiguous direct-click ID.
				local count = 0
				for _, child in ipairs(part:GetDescendants()) do if child:IsA("Light") then count += 1 end end
				if count == 1 and selectable then
					part:SetAttribute("StudioFixtureId", id); part:SetAttribute("StudioSceneId", sceneId)
				elseif part:GetAttribute("StudioFixtureId") == id then
					part:SetAttribute("StudioFixtureId", nil); part:SetAttribute("StudioSceneId", nil)
				end
			end
			table.insert(records, { Id = id, Name = label, Light = light, Part = part, SceneId = sceneId,
				GroupKey = light:GetAttribute("StudioLightGroup"), IsRig = isRig })
		end
	end
	registerRoot(studio, "Custom", "Custom", false)
	local _, rooms = collectRooms()
	for _, room in ipairs(rooms) do registerRoot(room.Model, room.Id, room.Id, false) end
	registerRoot(rig, activeSceneId, "SharedRig", true)
	table.sort(records, function(a, b) return a.Name == b.Name and a.Id < b.Id or a.Name < b.Name end)
	return records
end

function StudioLighting.GetFixtures(sceneId)
	local result = {}
	local runService = game:GetService("RunService")
	if runService:IsRunning() and runService:IsClient() then
		-- Client selectors read the authoritative saved registry without changing lighting metadata.
		for _, light in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if light:IsA("Light") and light:GetAttribute("StudioSceneId") == sceneId then
				local id = light:GetAttribute("StudioFixtureId")
				if type(id) == "string" then table.insert(result, { Id = id,
					Name = light:GetAttribute("StudioFixtureName") or light.Name, Light = light,
					Part = light:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart"), SceneId = sceneId,
					GroupKey = light:GetAttribute("StudioLightGroup"), IsRig = light:GetAttribute("StudioFixtureRig") == true }) end
			end
		end
		table.sort(result, function(a, b) return a.Name == b.Name and a.Id < b.Id or a.Name < b.Name end)
		return result
	end
	for _, record in ipairs(StudioLighting.RefreshFixtures()) do
		if record.SceneId == sceneId then table.insert(result, record) end
	end
	return result
end

function StudioLighting.ApplyFixtureOverrides(light)
	assert(typeof(light) == "Instance" and light:IsA("Light"), "Expected a Light")
	if light:GetAttribute("StudioBaseBrightness") == nil then captureFixtureBase(light) end
	restoreFixtureBase(light)
	local enabled = light:GetAttribute("StudioOverrideEnabled")
	local intensity = light:GetAttribute("StudioOverrideIntensity")
	local color = light:GetAttribute("StudioOverrideColor")
	local range = light:GetAttribute("StudioOverrideRange")
	intensity = type(intensity) == "number" and intensity == intensity and math.clamp(intensity, 0, 2) or 1
	light.Enabled = light.Enabled and enabled ~= false and intensity > 0
	light.Brightness = light.Brightness * intensity
	if type(color) == "string" then
		color = color:gsub("^#", "")
		if #color == 6 and color:match("^%x+$") then light.Color = Color3.fromHex(color) end
	end
	if type(range) == "number" and range == range and range > 0 then light.Range = math.clamp(range, 0, 60) end
	local part = fixtureEmitter(light)
	local hasColor = type(color) == "string" and #color == 6 and color:match("^%x+$") ~= nil
	if part and (type(enabled) == "boolean" or intensity ~= 1 or hasColor) then
		local baseColor = part:GetAttribute("StudioBaseVisualColor") or part.Color
		if not light.Enabled then
			part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			part.Color = baseColor:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.85)
		else
			local tint = hasColor and Color3.fromHex(color) or baseColor
			local scale = hasColor and math.max(baseColor.R, baseColor.G, baseColor.B) * intensity or intensity
			part.Color = Color3.new(math.clamp(tint.R * scale, 0, 1), math.clamp(tint.G * scale, 0, 1), math.clamp(tint.B * scale, 0, 1))
		end
	end
end

function StudioLighting.ResetFixtureOverrides(light)
	assert(typeof(light) == "Instance" and light:IsA("Light"), "Expected a Light")
	for _, attribute in ipairs(overrideAttributes) do light:SetAttribute(attribute, nil) end
	if light:GetAttribute("StudioFixtureRig") then
		local prefix = cachePrefix(light:GetAttribute("StudioSceneId") or "Custom")
		for index in ipairs(overrideAttributes) do light:SetAttribute(prefix .. index, nil) end
		light:SetAttribute(prefix .. "Present", true)
	end
	StudioLighting.ApplyFixtureOverrides(light)
end

function StudioLighting.Apply(studio, input)
	assert(typeof(studio) == "Instance" and studio:IsA("Model"), "StudioLighting.Apply expects the PodcastStudio model")
	local state = sanitize(input)
	local white = temperatureColor(state.Temperature)
	local accent = Color3.fromHex(state.AccentColor)
	local accentPower = state.AccentLights and state.AccentIntensity or 0
	local rig = ensure(studio, "Model", "LightingRig")
	-- Undo the previous override pass before recalculating scene/group base lighting.
	for _, record in ipairs(StudioLighting.RefreshFixtures(state.SceneSet)) do restoreFixtureBase(record.Light) end
	local byScene, allRooms = collectRooms()
	local selectedRoom = state.SceneSet ~= "Custom" and byScene[state.SceneSet] or nil
	local usingFreeRoom = selectedRoom ~= nil -- Includes every imported catalog room.
	local function insideRoom(position)
		if not usingFreeRoom then return position end
		local low, high = selectedRoom.Min, selectedRoom.Max
		local yMargin = math.min(1, (high.Y - low.Y) * 0.2)
		return Vector3.new(math.clamp(position.X, low.X + 1, high.X - 1),
			math.clamp(position.Y, low.Y + yMargin, high.Y - yMargin),
			math.clamp(position.Z, low.Z + 1, high.Z - 1))
	end

	-- Position the rig from the existing seats, so it follows a moved studio.
	local seats = {}
	local seatsFolder = studio:FindFirstChild("Seats")
	if seatsFolder then
		for _, child in ipairs(seatsFolder:GetDescendants()) do
			if child:IsA("Seat") or child:IsA("VehicleSeat") then table.insert(seats, child) end
		end
	end
	table.sort(seats, function(a, b) return a.Name < b.Name end)
	local center = studio:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0)
	if #seats > 0 then
		center = Vector3.new()
		for _, seat in ipairs(seats) do center += seat.Position end
		center /= #seats
	elseif selectedRoom then
		center = selectedRoom.Center
	end
	local retained = {}
	for index, seat in ipairs(seats) do
		local head = seat.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.35, 0)
		local towardCenter = Vector3.new(center.X - seat.Position.X, 0, center.Z - seat.Position.Z)
		if usingFreeRoom then
			-- Imported sets include presenter rows and sofas; light the direction the avatar faces.
			local forward = seat.CFrame.LookVector
			towardCenter = Vector3.new(forward.X, 0, forward.Z)
		end
		if towardCenter.Magnitude < 0.1 then towardCenter = seat.CFrame.LookVector end
		towardCenter = towardCenter.Unit
		local side = Vector3.new(-towardCenter.Z, 0, towardCenter.X)
		local name = "SeatKey" .. index
		retained[name] = true
		fixture(rig, name, insideRoom(head + towardCenter * 5 + side * 2.5 + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)), head,
			1.15 * state.KeyIntensity, white, "SpotLight", 14, true)
	end
	for _, part in ipairs(rig:GetChildren()) do
		if part.Name:match("^SeatKey%d+$") and not retained[part.Name] then part:Destroy() end
	end
	local pivot = studio:GetPivot()
	local right = pivot.RightVector
	local back = -pivot.LookVector
	local fillSpacing = 8
	if selectedRoom then
		fillSpacing = math.clamp(math.min(selectedRoom.Max.X - selectedRoom.Min.X,
			selectedRoom.Max.Z - selectedRoom.Min.Z) * 0.2, 4, 8)
	end
	for index, direction in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		fixture(rig, "SoftFill" .. index, insideRoom(center + right * (direction * fillSpacing) + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)), center,
			0.48 * state.FillIntensity, white:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.65), "PointLight", usingFreeRoom and math.min(fillSpacing * 2.5, 20) or 22, false)
		if usingFreeRoom then
			local low, high = selectedRoom.Min, selectedRoom.Max
			local wide = selectedRoom.Entry and selectedRoom.Entry:GetAttribute("Wide")
			local view = typeof(wide) == "CFrame" and wide.LookVector or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
			if state.SceneSet == "FreeModels" then view = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
			local normal, tangent, edge, spread
			if math.abs(view.X) > math.abs(view.Z) then
				normal = Vector3.new(view.X >= 0 and 1 or -1, 0, 0)
				tangent = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
				edge = Vector3.new(view.X >= 0 and high.X - 0.6 or low.X + 0.6,
					center.Y + 4, selectedRoom.Center.Z)
				spread = math.min(6, (high.Z - low.Z) * 0.25)
			else
				normal = Vector3.new(0, 0, view.Z >= 0 and 1 or -1)
				tangent = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
				edge = Vector3.new(selectedRoom.Center.X, center.Y + 4,
					view.Z >= 0 and high.Z - 0.6 or low.Z + 0.6)
				spread = math.min(6, (high.X - low.X) * 0.25)
			end
			local target = insideRoom(edge + tangent * (direction * spread))
			local source = insideRoom(target - normal * 3.5 + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
			fixture(rig, "BackdropWash" .. index, source, target, 0.5 * accentPower, accent, "SpotLight", 10, false)
		else
			fixture(rig, "BackdropWash" .. index, center + right * (direction * 11) - back * 12 + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0),
				center - back * 17 + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), 0.7 * accentPower, accent, "SpotLight", 12, false)
		end
	end

	-- Decorative lights retain their original locations and use independent circuit switches.
	local dressing = studio:FindFirstChild("SetDressing")
	if dressing then
		for _, item in ipairs(dressing:GetDescendants()) do
			if item:IsA("BasePart") then
				if item.Name == "Pendant diffuser" or item.Name == "Ceiling glow" then
					emissive(item, not usingFreeRoom and state.CeilingLights, white, 1)
				elseif item.Name == "Shelf light" then
					emissive(item, not usingFreeRoom and state.PracticalLights, white, 0.7)
				elseif item.Name == "Vertical light" then
					emissive(item, not usingFreeRoom and accentPower > 0, accent, accentPower)
				end
			elseif item:IsA("Light") and item.Parent then
				if item.Parent.Name == "Pendant diffuser" then
					item.Enabled = not usingFreeRoom and state.CeilingLights
					item.Color = white
					item.Brightness = 0.55
					item.Range = 20
					item.Shadows = false
				elseif item.Parent.Name == "Teal bounce" then
					item.Enabled = not usingFreeRoom and accentPower > 0
					item.Color = accent
					item.Brightness = 0.35 * accentPower
					item.Range = 18
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, room in ipairs(allRooms) do
		importedRoomLights(room, selectedRoom ~= nil and room.Model == selectedRoom.Model, state, white, accent)
	end
	for _, record in ipairs(StudioLighting.RefreshFixtures(state.SceneSet)) do
		if record.SceneId == "Custom" and not record.IsRig then
			local parentName = record.Part and record.Part.Name
			if parentName ~= "Pendant diffuser" and parentName ~= "Teal bounce" then
				record.Light.Enabled = not usingFreeRoom and record.Light:GetAttribute("StudioFixtureOriginalEnabled") ~= false
			end
		end
		captureFixtureBase(record.Light)
		StudioLighting.ApplyFixtureOverrides(record.Light)
	end

	Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
	Lighting.Brightness = 0.65
	Lighting.ClockTime = 0
	Lighting.ExposureCompensation = state.Exposure
	Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0.35
	Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0.2
	local ambientValue = 0.10 + 0.075 * state.FillIntensity
	local ambientWhite = white:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.8)
	Lighting.Ambient = Color3.new(ambientWhite.R * ambientValue, ambientWhite.G * ambientValue, ambientWhite.B * ambientValue)
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(28, 32, 40)
	Lighting.ColorShift_Top = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local bloom = ensure(Lighting, "BloomEffect", "PodcastBloom")
	bloom.Enabled = state.Bloom > 0
	bloom.Intensity = state.Bloom
	bloom.Size = 20
	bloom.Threshold = 1.8
	local grade = ensure(Lighting, "ColorCorrectionEffect", "PodcastGrade")
	grade.Enabled = true
	grade.Brightness = 0
	grade.Contrast = state.Contrast
	grade.Saturation = -0.035
	grade.TintColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	return state
end

return StudioLighting

--[[
	Catalog: stable item and collection IDs.

	* Item IDs are permanent: saved builds store them, so never rename or reuse one.
	  Retire an item by removing it; saved copies are preserved, not deleted.
	* Each item maps to a curated template Model named exactly like the item ID in
	  ServerStorage.StudioBuilderTemplates (see server/Adapters/TemplateCatalog).
	  Nothing here is an asset ID, and nothing is ever loaded by ID.
	* `sourceRef` is documentation only: the staging path the template was
	  prepared from, per docs/assets/Studio_Asset_Guide_2026-10-25.json.
	* Collections are tags; an item may carry several. Every collection is free
	  today. `entitlement` is metadata for a future unlock hook
	  (server/Adapters/Entitlements); there is no paywall.
]]

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)
local Validate = require(script.Parent.Validate)

local Catalog = {}

Catalog.ITEM_ID_PATTERN = "^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$"
Catalog.COLLECTION_ID_PATTERN = "^[a-z0-9_]+$"

Catalog.Collections = {

-- Tags follow the proposed collections in the asset guide.
Catalog.Items = {

-- Returns ok, errors (list of strings). Pure; used by tests and server startup.
function Catalog.validateData(collections, items)
	local errors = {}
	local function fail(message)
		errors[#errors + 1] = message
	end

	local collectionIds = {}
	if Validate.sequenceLength(collections, 64) == nil then
		fail("collections must be a sequence")
		collections = {}
	end
	for i, c in ipairs(collections) do
		if type(c) ~= "table" or not Validate.isBoundedString(c.id, 32, Catalog.COLLECTION_ID_PATTERN) then
			fail("collection #" .. i .. " has an invalid id")
		elseif collectionIds[c.id] then
			fail("duplicate collection id " .. c.id)
		else
			collectionIds[c.id] = true
			if not Validate.isBoundedString(c.displayName, 32) then
				fail("collection " .. c.id .. " needs a displayName")
			end
			if c.entitlement ~= nil then
				local e = c.entitlement
				if type(e) ~= "table" or not Validate.isBoundedString(e.kind, 32, "^[%a_]+$") then
					fail("collection " .. c.id .. " has malformed entitlement metadata")
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local itemIds = {}
	if Validate.sequenceLength(items, 1000) == nil then
		fail("items must be a sequence")
		items = {}
	end
	for i, item in ipairs(items) do
		if type(item) ~= "table" or not Validate.isBoundedString(item.id, Config.MaxCatalogIdLength, Catalog.ITEM_ID_PATTERN) then
			fail("item #" .. i .. " has an invalid id")
		elseif itemIds[item.id] then
			fail("duplicate item id " .. item.id)
		else
			itemIds[item.id] = true
			if not Validate.isBoundedString(item.displayName, 48) then
				fail("item " .. item.id .. " needs a displayName")
			end
			local tags = item.collections
			local n = Validate.sequenceLength(tags, 16)
			if n == nil or n == 0 then
				fail("item " .. item.id .. " needs at least one collection tag")
			else
				local seen = {}
				for _, tag in ipairs(tags) do
					if type(tag) ~= "string" or not collectionIds[tag] then
						fail("item " .. item.id .. " has unknown collection tag " .. tostring(tag))
					elseif seen[tag] then
						fail("item " .. item.id .. " repeats collection tag " .. tag)
					end
					seen[tag] = true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return #errors == 0, errors
end

function Catalog.validate()
	return Catalog.validateData(Catalog.Collections, Catalog.Items)
end

local itemsById = {}
local collectionsById = {}
for _, c in ipairs(Catalog.Collections) do
	collectionsById[c.id] = c
end
for _, item in ipairs(Catalog.Items) do
	itemsById[item.id] = item
end

-- Lookups accept untrusted values; anything that is not a known string ID is nil.
function Catalog.getItem(id)
	if type(id) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	return itemsById[id]
end

function Catalog.getCollection(id)
	if type(id) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end
	return collectionsById[id]
end

function Catalog.getCollectionsSorted()
	local list = {}
	for _, c in ipairs(Catalog.Collections) do
		list[#list + 1] = c
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		return a.order < b.order
	end)
	return list
end

-- Items tagged with collectionId, in declaration order (a filter, not ownership).
function Catalog.getItemsTagged(collectionId)
	local list = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(Catalog.Items) do
		for _, tag in ipairs(item.collections) do
			if tag == collectionId then
				list[#list + 1] = item
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return list
end

return Catalog

--[[
	Config: shared constants for the Studio Builder sandbox.

	The server enforces these values itself; the client only reads them to
	pre-validate. Written in the Lua 5.1-compatible subset of Luau so the pure
	modules can be exercised by tests/run.lua outside Roblox.
]]

local Config = {}

-- Identifiers
Config.MaxCatalogIdLength = 48
Config.MaxBuildIdLength = 11 -- "i" + up to 10 digits

-- Build limits
Config.MaxItems = 150
Config.MaxCoordinate = 1024 -- absolute sanity bound on any stored local coordinate

-- Placement (server enforces; client preview mirrors via shared Transform)
Config.GridSize = 1 -- studs; client snapping step, also the duplicate offset step
Config.RotationStep = 15 -- degrees; yaw must be a multiple of this
Config.PositionPrecision = 0.01 -- server quantizes positions to this step
Config.BoundsEpsilon = 0.001

-- Server-side undo history depth (per current host; cleared on host transfer)
Config.HistoryLimit = 50

-- Per-player token buckets
Config.RateLimits = {
	edit = { capacity = 12, refillPerSecond = 6 },
	status = { capacity = 6, refillPerSecond = 2 },
}

-- Build save payload: an additive `Build` section inside a StudioPresets snapshot
-- ({Version=1, Settings, Fixtures, Items, Build}). The preset entry/top-level

--[[
	Protocol: the closed vocabulary between the builder client and server.

	Requests go through ReplicatedStorage.StudioBuilder.Remotes.BuilderRequest
	(RemoteFunction) as a single table. The server accepts only the ops below
	and only the listed fields for each; any other key is rejected.

		{ op = "Place",     itemId = "<catalog id>", transform = { x, y, z, yaw } }
		{ op = "Move",      id = "i12", transform = { x, y, z, yaw } }
		{ op = "Rotate",    id = "i12", direction = 1 | -1 }   -- direction optional, default 1
		{ op = "Duplicate", id = "i12" }
		{ op = "Delete",    id = "i12" }
		{ op = "Undo",      expectedRevision = n? }  -- refused with StaleRevision if n is stale
		{ op = "Redo",      expectedRevision = n? }
		{ op = "Status" }                            -- read-only; allowed for anyone

	Transforms are local to the sandbox origin: studs, yaw in degrees (a
	multiple of Config.RotationStep). Responses
	(every response carries status):
		{ ok = true,  id = "i12", buildRevision = n, recoveryNeeded = true?, status }
		{ ok = false, code = "<Code>", reason = "<Code>"?, buildRevision = n, recoveryNeeded = true?, status }
		status = { state = "ready" | "busy" | "recovery", canUndo, canRedo, revision }
	recoveryNeeded means the world could not be reconciled yet; further edits
	return RecoveryNeeded until the server recovers.
]]

local Protocol = {}

Protocol.Ops = {
	Place = "Place",
	Move = "Move",
	Rotate = "Rotate",
	Duplicate = "Duplicate",
	Delete = "Delete",
	Undo = "Undo",
	Redo = "Redo",
	Status = "Status",
}

-- Fields each op may carry besides `op`, and whether they are required.
Protocol.OpFields = {
	Place = { itemId = true, transform = true },
	Move = { id = true, transform = true },
	Rotate = { id = true, direction = false },
	Duplicate = { id = true },
	Delete = { id = true },
	Undo = { expectedRevision = false },
	Redo = { expectedRevision = false },
	Status = {},
}

Protocol.Codes = {
	BadRequest = "BadRequest",
	UnknownOp = "UnknownOp",
	RateLimited = "RateLimited",
	NotHost = "NotHost",
	AuthorityLost = "AuthorityLost",
	Busy = "Busy",
	Unavailable = "Unavailable",
	UnknownItem = "UnknownItem",
	NotInstalled = "NotInstalled",
	NotEntitled = "NotEntitled",
	BadTransform = "BadTransform",
	OutOfBounds = "OutOfBounds",
	ItemCap = "ItemCap",
	NotFound = "NotFound",
	RecoveryNeeded = "RecoveryNeeded",
	NothingToUndo = "NothingToUndo",
	NothingToRedo = "NothingToRedo",
	HistoryConflict = "HistoryConflict",
	StaleRevision = "StaleRevision",
	ApplyFailed = "ApplyFailed",
	Internal = "Internal",
}

Protocol.Messages = {
	BadRequest = "That request wasn't understood.",
	UnknownOp = "That request wasn't understood.",
	RateLimited = "Slow down a little and try again.",
	NotHost = "Only the host can build.",
	AuthorityLost = "Host changed before the edit finished; nothing was changed.",
	Busy = "Still applying the last change. Try again.",
	Unavailable = "The build area isn't set up.",
	UnknownItem = "That item isn't in the catalog.",
	NotInstalled = "That item isn't installed yet.",
	NotEntitled = "That collection isn't unlocked.",
	BadTransform = "Couldn't place the item there.",
	OutOfBounds = "That spot is outside the build area.",
	ItemCap = "The item limit has been reached.",
	NotFound = "That item no longer exists.",
	RecoveryNeeded = "The build area is resynchronizing; edits are paused for a moment.",
	NothingToUndo = "Nothing to undo.",
	NothingToRedo = "Nothing to redo.",
	HistoryConflict = "That step can't be undone anymore, so it was skipped.",
	StaleRevision = "The studio changed; check it and try again.",
	ApplyFailed = "The change couldn't be applied; nothing was changed.",
	Internal = "Something went wrong.",
}

function Protocol.message(code)
	return Protocol.Messages[code] or Protocol.Messages.Internal
end

return Protocol

--[[
	Transform: placement maths shared by the server (authoritative) and the
	client preview (advisory). Pure; no Roblox types.

	A transform is { x, y, z, yaw }: studs from the sandbox origin (floor
	centre, +Y up) to the item's bottom-centre pivot, and yaw in degrees.
	Bounds are { halfX, halfZ, height }. Item size is the template's measured
	bounding box { sx, sy, sz } in its own axes. The footprint used for the
	bounds check is the axis-aligned box of the yawed item, so a long item
	that fits along one wall may not fit after a 90 degree turn.
]]

local Validate = require(script.Parent.Validate)

local Transform = {}

local YAW_TOLERANCE = 1e-6
local MAX_ABS_YAW = 3600

local function round(v, step)
	return math.floor(v / step + 0.5) * step
end
Transform.round = round

-- Returns the yaw normalized to [0, 360) on the rotation grid, or nil when it
-- is not (within tolerance) a multiple of step.
function Transform.normalizeYaw(yaw, step)
	local steps = (yaw % 360) / step
	local nearest = math.floor(steps + 0.5)
	if math.abs(steps - nearest) > YAW_TOLERANCE then
		return nil
	end
	local normalized = (nearest * step) % 360
	if normalized >= 360 - YAW_TOLERANCE then
		normalized = 0
	end
	return normalized
end

-- Half extents on the room X and Z axes of a size rotated by yaw degrees.
function Transform.halfExtents(size, yaw)
	local r = math.rad(yaw)
	local c, s = math.abs(math.cos(r)), math.abs(math.sin(r))
	return (c * size[1] + s * size[3]) / 2, (s * size[1] + c * size[3]) / 2
end

function Transform.fits(t, size, bounds, epsilon)
	local hx, hz = Transform.halfExtents(size, t.yaw)
	return math.abs(t.x) + hx <= bounds.halfX + epsilon
		and math.abs(t.z) + hz <= bounds.halfZ + epsilon
		and t.y >= -epsilon
		and t.y + size[2] <= bounds.height + epsilon
end

-- Validates an untrusted transform table. Returns a fresh clean transform, or
-- nil and "BadTransform" (malformed) / "OutOfBounds" (well-formed but outside).
-- Only the four fields are read; key-set strictness is the request validator's job.
function Transform.sanitize(raw, size, bounds, config)
	if type(raw) ~= "table" then
		return nil, "BadTransform"
	end
	local x, y, z, yaw = rawget(raw, "x"), rawget(raw, "y"), rawget(raw, "z"), rawget(raw, "yaw")
	local limit = config.MaxCoordinate
	for _, v in ipairs({ x, y, z }) do
		if not Validate.isFiniteNumber(v) or math.abs(v) > limit then
			return nil, "BadTransform"
		end
	end
	if not Validate.isFiniteNumber(yaw) or math.abs(yaw) > MAX_ABS_YAW then
		return nil, "BadTransform"
	end
	local cleanYaw = Transform.normalizeYaw(yaw, config.RotationStep)
	if cleanYaw == nil then
		return nil, "BadTransform"
	end
	local p = config.PositionPrecision
	local t = { x = round(x, p), y = round(y, p), z = round(z, p), yaw = cleanYaw }
	if not Transform.fits(t, size, bounds, config.BoundsEpsilon) then
		return nil, "OutOfBounds"
	end
	return t
end

return Transform

--[[
	Validate: small type guards for untrusted values (remote payloads, stored
	records, adapter return values). Pure; no Roblox APIs.
]]

local Validate = {}

local HUGE = math.huge

function Validate.isFiniteNumber(v)
	return type(v) == "number" and v == v and v ~= HUGE and v ~= -HUGE
end

function Validate.isInteger(v)
	return Validate.isFiniteNumber(v) and v == math.floor(v)
end

function Validate.isPositiveInteger(v)
	return Validate.isInteger(v) and v >= 1
end

-- Non-empty string no longer than maxLength that fully matches pattern (optional).
function Validate.isBoundedString(v, maxLength, pattern)
	if type(v) ~= "string" or #v == 0 or #v > maxLength then
		return false
	end
	if pattern ~= nil and string.match(v, pattern) == nil then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

-- Returns the length of t if it is a proper sequence (1..n, no other keys) of at
-- most maxLength entries, otherwise nil. Stops counting early on oversized tables.
function Validate.sequenceLength(t, maxLength)
	if type(t) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local n = 0
	for _ in pairs(t) do
		n = n + 1
		if n > maxLength then
			return nil
		end
	end
	for i = 1, n do
		if t[i] == nil then
			return nil
		end
	end
	return n
end

return Validate

-- Editable set dressing. Seated furniture stays linked to the seating system.
local M={}
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Http=game:GetService("HttpService")
local isClient=game:GetService("RunService"):IsRunning() and game:GetService("RunService"):IsClient()
local categories={Mugs=true,Notes=true,Headphones=true,Microphones=true,Mixer=true,Plants=true,Library=true,PracticalDecor=true,SoftFurnishings=true,Furniture=true}
local function rootFor(scene)
 if scene=="Custom" then return workspace.PodcastStudio end
 local c=RS.PodcastRooms:FindFirstChild(scene)
 if not c then return end
 return workspace:FindFirstChild(c:GetAttribute("ModelName"),true)
end
function M.GetItems(scene)
 local root=rootFor(scene);local result={};if not root then return result end
 -- The original studio uses its coordinated table/layout controls.
 if scene=="Custom" then return result end
 for _,d in root:GetDescendants() do
  local category=d:GetAttribute("PropCategory")
  if categories[category] and (d:IsA("Model") or d:IsA("BasePart")) then
   local parent=d.Parent;local nested=false
   while parent and parent~=root do if categories[parent:GetAttribute("PropCategory")] then nested=true;break end;parent=parent.Parent end
   if not nested and not d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Seat",true) then
    if not d:GetAttribute("StudioItemId") and not isClient then d:SetAttribute("StudioItemId",Http:GenerateGUID(false)) end
    if not d:GetAttribute("StudioBasePivot") and not isClient then
     d:SetAttribute("StudioBasePivot",d:GetPivot())
     if d:IsA("Model") then d:SetAttribute("StudioBaseScale",d:GetScale()) else d:SetAttribute("StudioBaseSize",d.Size) end
    end
    if not isClient then d:SetAttribute("StudioItemScene",scene) end
    if d:GetAttribute("StudioItemId") then table.insert(result,{Id=d:GetAttribute("StudioItemId"),Name=d.Name,Object=d,SceneId=scene}) end
   end
  end
 end
 table.sort(result,function(a,b) return a.Name==b.Name and a.Id<b.Id or a.Name<b.Name end)
 return result
end
function M.Apply(scene)
 for _,item in M.GetItems(scene) do
  local d=item.Object;local base=d:GetAttribute("StudioBasePivot")
  local shift=Vector3.new(d:GetAttribute("StudioMoveX") or 0,d:GetAttribute("StudioMoveY") or 0,d:GetAttribute("StudioMoveZ") or 0)
  local scale=d:GetAttribute("StudioItemScale") or 1
  if d:IsA("Model") then d:ScaleTo(d:GetAttribute("StudioBaseScale")*scale) else d.Size=d:GetAttribute("StudioBaseSize")*scale end
  d:PivotTo(CFrame.new(base.Position+shift)*CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(d:GetAttribute("StudioItemYaw") or 0),0)*base.Rotation)
 end
end
function M.Reset(d)
 for _,key in {"StudioMoveX","StudioMoveY","StudioMoveZ","StudioItemYaw","StudioItemScale","StudioItemVisible"} do d:SetAttribute(key,nil) end
end
return M

--[[
	DirectorPersistence (STUDIO BUILDER, task 5 corrections) — a ModuleScript
	installed next to PodcastDirector. It replaces the Director's snapshot(),
	restoreSnapshot() and persistentAction() with the same logic, moved here
	so it can be tested, plus these fixes:

	1. Compound load is one transaction. After validation, staging and the
	   (yielding) text filter, the builder's edit lock is held for the whole
	   room + build restore (builder edits and saves get Busy). The trusted
	   previous room state is captured before any mutation. Any failure, or
	   lost authority after the final yield, rolls back the room (without
	   re-filtering text: the captured values are the live ones) and the
	   build. If a rollback fails, saving is latched and the builder stays in
	   recovery (edits and saves refused).
	2. The staged load is bound to the host session and build revision at
	   preparation; A -> B -> A during text filtering is refused before any
	   mutation (legacy room-only loads included).
	3. Save-block latch: after any failed Load/LoadCode (corrupt, newer,
	   backend read failure, rollback failure), Save and Share are refused
	   for that host until a successful load or the explicit
	   "DiscardLoadBlock" action.
	4. Save feedback: the write and the slot-list refresh are separate; a
	   refresh failure no longer reports a successful save as failed.

	Room code below is the live Director code (2026-10-25) with `for k in t`
	written as `for k in pairs(t)` and math.clamp as a local clamp; no other
	behaviour change. rememberLighting is NOT called during rollback (its
	semantics were provided later; the cache entry is restored instead).

	deps (all existing Director locals, passed in): settings, defaults,
	groupKeys, textLengths, bounds, layoutBounds, atmosphereBounds,
	atmosphereKeys, fixtureAttributes, itemAttributes, itemBounds, finite,
	lighting, customization, rememberLighting, applyAll, applyDecor,
	getState, studio, RS, TextService, presets, remote, feedback,
	setLayoutBusy(bool) (closure over the Director's layoutBusy),
	builderPersistence (BuilderService.getPersistence()), clock (os.clock),
	warn, getRoomLook(scene) / setRoomLook(scene, look) (closures over the
	Director's roomLooks cache, so a failed load restores the entry exactly).

	Recovery checkpoint (review of e30e8be):
	* a room rollback that fails joins the builder's shared compound recovery
	  (captured room + build): edits, saves, loads and Discard are refused for
	  every host until recovery restores both; nothing else clears it;
	* a build finalize failure after the room loaded is reported as an
	  incomplete load (latched) until reconciliation succeeds;
	* rememberLighting's roomLooks entry is captured and restored exactly.

	Room-mutation gate (review of ce59b1d):
	* M.roomMutationBlocked() is true while any restoreSnapshot is in flight
	  and while the builder's recovery is unresolved. The core stays in
	  recovery for the whole of every recovery attempt (the background retry
	  in BuilderService, a Persist-triggered retry, or a direct recover()),
	  including while the outside room restore yields inside applyAll, and
	  only leaves it once room and build are both restored. The gate is
	  derived from that state, never from a flag toggled around an attempt.
	* The Director refuses every non-Persist room command while it is true,
	  and re-checks it after an in-flight Text filter returns (see
	  integration/PodcastDirector.persistence.luau). Persist stays open:
	  List works and every Persist action retries recovery first.
]]

local DirectorPersistence = {}

local RECOVERY_MESSAGE = "The studio is still being restored after a failed load. Saving and loading are paused until that finishes."
local ROOM_MUTATION_MESSAGE = "The studio is still being restored after a failed load. Room changes are paused until that finishes."
local LATCH_MESSAGE = "Your last load didn't complete, so saving is paused to protect your saved studios. Load a studio again, or discard to save the current room anyway."

local function clamp(v, lo, hi)
	return math.min(math.max(v, lo), hi)
end

function DirectorPersistence.new(d)
	local M = {}
	local settings = d.settings
	local latched = {} -- [userId] = reason
	local loadsInFlight = 0

	local function currentScene()
		return settings:GetAttribute("SceneSet") or "Custom"
	end

	-- Live snapshot() body (room part).
	local function roomSnapshot()
		local data = { Version = 1, Settings = {}, Fixtures = {}, Items = {} }
		local scene = currentScene()
		for key in pairs(d.defaults) do
			if key ~= "Phase" and (not d.groupKeys[key] or key:sub(1, #scene + 1) == scene .. "_") then
				data.Settings[key] = settings:GetAttribute(key)
			end
		end
		data.Settings.CustomLighting = settings:GetAttribute("CustomLighting") == true
		for _, record in pairs(d.lighting.GetFixtures(scene)) do
			local values = {}
			for key, attribute in pairs(d.fixtureAttributes) do
				values[key] = record.Light:GetAttribute(attribute)
			end
			data.Fixtures[record.Id] = values
		end
		for _, record in pairs(d.customization.GetItems(scene)) do
			local values = {}
			for key, attribute in pairs(d.itemAttributes) do
				values[key] = record.Object:GetAttribute(attribute)
			end
			data.Items[record.Id] = values
		end
		return data
	end

	function M.snapshot()
		-- BUILDER: additive Build section; errors (visible failed save) if the builder can't capture now.
		return d.builderPersistence:attachBuild(roomSnapshot())
	end

	-- Trusted pre-load state: every setting key (all scene groups), and the
	-- fixture/item overrides of both the current and the target scene.
	local function captureRoom(targetScene)
		local settingsValues = {}
		for key in pairs(d.defaults) do
			if key ~= "Phase" then
				settingsValues[key] = settings:GetAttribute(key)
			end
		end
		settingsValues.CustomLighting = settings:GetAttribute("CustomLighting") == true
		local scenes = {}
		for _, scene in ipairs({ currentScene(), targetScene }) do
			if scenes[scene] == nil then
				local fixtures, items = {}, {}
				for _, record in pairs(d.lighting.GetFixtures(scene)) do
					local values = {}
					for key, attribute in pairs(d.fixtureAttributes) do
						values[key] = record.Light:GetAttribute(attribute)
					end
					fixtures[record.Id] = values
				end
				for _, record in pairs(d.customization.GetItems(scene)) do
					local values = {}
					for key, attribute in pairs(d.itemAttributes) do
						values[key] = record.Object:GetAttribute(attribute)
					end
					items[record.Id] = values
				end
				scenes[scene] = { Fixtures = fixtures, Items = items }
			end
		end
		-- rememberLighting's cache entry for the current scene (nil = absent).
		local look = nil
		if d.getRoomLook then
			local entry = d.getRoomLook(currentScene())
			if type(entry) == "table" then
				look = {}
				for k, v in pairs(entry) do
					look[k] = v
				end
			end
		end
		return { scene = currentScene(), Settings = settingsValues, scenes = scenes, look = look, hasLookApi = d.setRoomLook ~= nil }
	end

	-- Live restore body: settings, applyAll, fixture and item overrides.
	-- textValues: filtered strings for a load, or the captured live strings for
	-- a rollback (never re-filtered). remember=false skips rememberLighting.
	local function applyRoom(values, textValues, fixturesBy, itemsBy, scene, remember)
		if remember then
			d.rememberLighting(currentScene())
		end
		for key, default in pairs(d.defaults) do
			local value = values[key]
			if key ~= "Phase" and type(value) == type(default) and (type(value) ~= "number" or d.finite(value)) then
				if d.textLengths[key] then
					value = textValues[key]
				elseif d.bounds[key] then
					value = clamp(value, d.bounds[key][1], d.bounds[key][2])
				elseif d.layoutBounds[key] then
					value = clamp(value, d.layoutBounds[key][1], d.layoutBounds[key][2])
				elseif d.atmosphereBounds[key] then
					value = clamp(value, d.atmosphereBounds[key][1], d.atmosphereBounds[key][2])
				elseif key == "Ambience" and value ~= "Off" and value ~= "Rain" and value ~= "Air" then
					value = "Off"
				end
				if value ~= nil then
					settings:SetAttribute(key, value)
				end
			end
		end
		for _, key in pairs(d.atmosphereKeys) do
			if values[key] == nil then
				settings:SetAttribute(key, d.defaults[key])
			end
		end
		settings:SetAttribute("CustomLighting", values.CustomLighting == true)
		d.applyAll()
		for _, record in pairs(d.lighting.GetFixtures(scene)) do
			d.lighting.ResetFixtureOverrides(record.Light)
			local patch = type(fixturesBy) == "table" and fixturesBy[record.Id]
			if type(patch) == "table" then
				for key, attribute in pairs(d.fixtureAttributes) do
					local value = patch[key]
					if (key == "Enabled" and type(value) == "boolean") or ((key == "Intensity" or key == "Range") and d.finite(value)) or (key == "Color" and type(value) == "string" and #value == 6 and value:match("^%x+$")) then
						record.Light:SetAttribute(attribute, value)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		for _, record in pairs(d.customization.GetItems(scene)) do
			d.customization.Reset(record.Object)
			local patch = type(itemsBy) == "table" and itemsBy[record.Id]
			if type(patch) == "table" then
				for key, limit in pairs(d.itemBounds) do
					if d.finite(patch[key]) then
						record.Object:SetAttribute(d.itemAttributes[key], clamp(patch[key], limit[1], limit[2]))
					end
				end
				if type(patch.Visible) == "boolean" then
					record.Object:SetAttribute(d.itemAttributes.Visible, patch.Visible)
				end
			end
		end
		d.customization.Apply(scene)
		d.lighting.Apply(d.studio, d.getState())
		d.applyDecor(d.getState())
	end

	-- Restores the captured pre-load state, raw attribute values included.
	local function rollbackRoom(captured)
		local current = captured.scenes[captured.scene]
		applyRoom(captured.Settings, captured.Settings, current.Fixtures, current.Items, captured.scene, false)
		-- Restore rememberLighting's cache entry exactly, including absence.
		if captured.hasLookApi then
			local look = nil
			if captured.look ~= nil then
				look = {}
				for k, v in pairs(captured.look) do
					look[k] = v
				end
			end
			d.setRoomLook(captured.scene, look)
		end
		-- The load's target scene (if different) also had its overrides reset.
		for scene, state in pairs(captured.scenes) do
			if scene ~= captured.scene then
				for _, record in pairs(d.lighting.GetFixtures(scene)) do
					d.lighting.ResetFixtureOverrides(record.Light)
					for key, attribute in pairs(d.fixtureAttributes) do
						local value = state.Fixtures[record.Id] and state.Fixtures[record.Id][key]
						if value ~= nil then
							record.Light:SetAttribute(attribute, value)
						end
					end
				end
				for _, record in pairs(d.customization.GetItems(scene)) do
					d.customization.Reset(record.Object)
					for key, attribute in pairs(d.itemAttributes) do
						local value = state.Items[record.Id] and state.Items[record.Id][key]
						if value ~= nil then
							record.Object:SetAttribute(attribute, value)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function isHost(p)
		return p.Parent ~= nil and p.UserId == settings:GetAttribute("HostUserId")
	end

	local function restoreBody(p, data)
		assert(type(data) == "table" and data.Version == 1 and type(data.Settings) == "table", "Unsupported studio preset.")
		local values = data.Settings
		local scene = values.SceneSet
		assert(type(scene) == "string" and (scene == "Custom" or d.RS.PodcastRooms:FindFirstChild(scene)), "This room is unavailable.")
		-- BUILDER: validate + stage + bind (host epoch, build revision) before any yield or mutation.
		local staged = d.builderPersistence:prepareLoad(p.UserId, data)
		local filtered = {}
		for key in pairs(d.textLengths) do
			if type(values[key]) == "string" then
				filtered[key] = d.TextService:FilterStringAsync(values[key], p.UserId, Enum.TextFilterContext.PublicChat):GetNonChatStringForBroadcastAsync()
			end
		end
		assert(isHost(p), "Host controls changed while loading.")
		-- BUILDER: one transaction for room + build. begin() re-checks the binding
		-- and holds the builder lock until commit/rollback.
		local captured = captureRoom(scene)
		local txn = d.builderPersistence:begin(p.UserId, staged)
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			txn:applyBuild()
			applyRoom(values, filtered, data.Fixtures, data.Items, scene, true)
			-- Final authority after every yield (applyAll, world swap).
			assert(isHost(p) and txn:stillAuthorized(), "Host controls changed while loading.")
		end)
		if ok then
			local result = txn:commit()
			if result.recoveryNeeded then
				-- The room loaded but the build's finalize failed: not a successful load.
				latched[p.UserId] = "BuildRecovery"
				error("The room loaded, but the build is still being restored. Saving is paused until that finishes.")
			end
			return
		end
		local roomRestored = pcall(rollbackRoom, captured)
		-- A failed room rollback becomes part of the shared compound recovery,
		-- retried (with the build) until both are restored.
		local external = nil
		if not roomRestored then
			external = function()
				rollbackRoom(captured)
				return true
			end
		end
		if not txn:rollback(external) then
			latched[p.UserId] = "RollbackFailed"
			error("The studio couldn't be fully restored after a failed load. Saving is paused until a studio loads successfully.")
		end
		error(err, 0)
	end

	-- Counted for the room-mutation gate for its whole duration, whoever calls it.
	function M.restoreSnapshot(p, data)
		loadsInFlight = loadsInFlight + 1
		local ok, err = pcall(restoreBody, p, data)
		loadsInFlight = loadsInFlight - 1
		if not ok then
			error(err, 0)
		end
	end

	-- Shared room-mutation gate: true while a load is in flight or a failed
	-- load's recovery (room + build) is unresolved, including during every
	-- yielding recovery attempt. Fails closed if the state can't be read.
	function M.roomMutationBlocked()
		if loadsInFlight > 0 then
			return true
		end
		local ok, recovering = pcall(function()
			return d.builderPersistence:recovering()
		end)
		return not ok or recovering == true
	end
	M.ROOM_MUTATION_MESSAGE = ROOM_MUTATION_MESSAGE

	-- Live persistentAction with the latch and the separated list refresh.
	local persistenceBusy, persistenceLast = {}, {}
	function M.persistentAction(p, action, args)
		if type(action) ~= "string" or type(args) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		if persistenceBusy[p] or d.clock() - (persistenceLast[p] or -100) < 2 then
			d.feedback(p, false, "Please wait a moment before another save request.")
			return
		end
		if not ({ List = true, Save = true, Load = true, Share = true, LoadCode = true, DiscardLoadBlock = true })[action] then
			return
		end
		-- BUILDER: a failed compound load that is still unrestored blocks every
		-- host's Save, Share, Load and Discard until recovery really succeeds.
		local persistence = d.builderPersistence
		if persistence:recovering() then
			persistence:recover()
		end
		local recovering = persistence:recovering()
		local reason = latched[p.UserId]
		if (reason == "RollbackFailed" or reason == "BuildRecovery") and not recovering then
			latched[p.UserId] = nil -- cleared only by successful recovery
			reason = nil
		end
		if recovering and action ~= "List" then
			d.feedback(p, false, RECOVERY_MESSAGE)
			return
		end
		-- BUILDER: explicit discard of the save block.
		if action == "DiscardLoadBlock" then
			latched[p.UserId] = nil
			d.remote:FireClient(p, true, "Saving is available again.")
			return
		end
		-- BUILDER: no Save/Share of unrelated or empty state after a failed load.
		if (action == "Save" or action == "Share") and reason then
			d.feedback(p, false, LATCH_MESSAGE)
			return
		end
		persistenceBusy[p] = true
		persistenceLast[p] = d.clock()
		local loading = action == "Load" or action == "LoadCode"
		if loading then
			d.setLayoutBusy(true)
		end
		local ok, message, payload = pcall(function()
			if action == "List" then
				return "Saved studios refreshed.", { Slots = d.presets.List(p.UserId) }
			end
			if action == "Save" then
				local name = d.presets.Save(p.UserId, args.Slot, args.Name, M.snapshot())
				return "Saved “" .. name .. "” for future sessions."
			end
			if action == "Share" then
				return "Share this code with another host.", { Code = d.presets.Share(p.UserId, args.Slot) }
			end
			local entry = action == "Load" and d.presets.Load(p.UserId, args.Slot) or d.presets.LoadCode(args.Code)
			M.restoreSnapshot(p, entry.Data)
			return "Loaded “" .. entry.Name .. "”."
		end)
		if loading then
			d.setLayoutBusy(false)
			if ok then
				latched[p.UserId] = nil
			elseif latched[p.UserId] == nil then
				latched[p.UserId] = "LoadFailed" -- includes backend read failures
			end
		end
		-- BUILDER: refresh the slot list separately; a refresh failure must not turn a successful save into a failure.
		if ok and action == "Save" then
			local listed, slots = pcall(d.presets.List, p.UserId)
			if listed then
				payload = { Slots = slots }
			else
				message = message .. " (The slot list couldn't refresh; reopen saved studios to see it.)"
			end
		end
		persistenceBusy[p] = nil
		if ok then
			d.remote:FireClient(p, true, message, payload)
		else
			d.warn("Studio preset:", message)
			local detail = tostring(message)
			if detail:lower():find("publish") or detail:lower():find("api") or detail:lower():find("403") or detail:lower():find("datastore") then
				d.feedback(p, false, "Persistent saves are unavailable here. Use a published experience with data-store access; your current room is still active.")
			else
				d.feedback(p, false, detail:match(":%d+: (.+)$") or "The preset could not be processed. Please try again.")
			end
		end
	end

	-- Read-only view for the panel/tests.
	function M.saveBlocked(userId)
		return latched[userId]
	end

	return M
end

return DirectorPersistence

--[[
	Entitlements: future unlock hook for collections. Everything is free today.

	* `kind = "free"` (or no entitlement metadata) is always unlocked.
	* Any other kind needs a resolver injected via `resolvers[kind]`. Unknown
	  kinds fail closed, so tagging a collection with a paid kind before a real
	  ownership check exists can never unlock it by accident. No game-pass or
	  developer-product checks are implemented here, and no purchase prompts.
	* An item is usable when ANY of its collection tags is unlocked, so a future
	  paid-only item must be tagged with paid collections only.
]]

local Entitlements = {}
Entitlements.__index = Entitlements

-- options.resolvers: { [kind] = function(userId, entitlement) -> boolean } (optional)
function Entitlements.new(options)
	local resolvers = {}
	if type(options) == "table" and type(options.resolvers) == "table" then
		for kind, resolver in pairs(options.resolvers) do
			if type(kind) == "string" and type(resolver) == "function" then
				resolvers[kind] = resolver
			end
		end
	end
	-- "free" cannot be overridden.
	resolvers.free = function()
		return true
	end
	return setmetatable({ resolvers = resolvers }, Entitlements)
end

function Entitlements:isCollectionUnlocked(userId, collection)
	if type(collection) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	local entitlement = collection.entitlement
	local kind
	if entitlement == nil then
		kind = "free"
	elseif type(entitlement) == "table" then
		kind = entitlement.kind
	end
	local resolver = type(kind) == "string" and self.resolvers[kind] or nil
	if resolver == nil then
		return false
	end
	local ok, unlocked = pcall(resolver, userId, entitlement)
	return ok and unlocked == true
end

-- catalog must provide getCollection(id).
function Entitlements:isItemUnlocked(userId, item, catalog)
	if type(item) ~= "table" or type(item.collections) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	for _, tag in ipairs(item.collections) do
		if self:isCollectionUnlocked(userId, catalog.getCollection(tag)) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

return Entitlements

--[[
	HostAuthority: decides whether a user may edit the build sandbox.

	Contract (Codex, 2026-10-25): the authoritative host is
	ReplicatedStorage.PodcastSettings:GetAttribute("HostUserId"), checked
	server-side on every edit. The source is injected so tests and future
	integrations can supply it; the authority itself never caches, so a host
	change applies to the very next request.

	Fails closed: a missing PodcastSettings, missing/non-integer attribute or an
	erroring source all deny. A string-typed attribute is denied rather than
	coerced (attribute type not yet confirmed in Studio).

	Usage:
		local authority = HostAuthority.new({ getHostUserId = HostAuthority.podcastSettingsSource() })
		local allowed, reason = authority:check(player.UserId)
]]

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("StudioBuilder")
local Validate = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Validate"))

local HostAuthority = {}
HostAuthority.__index = HostAuthority

HostAuthority.Reasons = {
	BadUserId = "BadUserId",
	HostUnavailable = "HostUnavailable",
	NoHost = "NoHost",
	HostIdInvalid = "HostIdInvalid",
	NotHost = "NotHost",
}

-- options.getHostUserId: function() -> number|nil
function HostAuthority.new(options)
	assert(type(options) == "table" and type(options.getHostUserId) == "function", "HostAuthority.new requires getHostUserId")
	return setmetatable({ getHostUserId = options.getHostUserId }, HostAuthority)
end

-- Returns allowed (boolean), reason (string, only when denied).
function HostAuthority:check(userId)
	local Reasons = HostAuthority.Reasons
	if not Validate.isPositiveInteger(userId) then
		return false, Reasons.BadUserId
	end
	local ok, hostUserId = pcall(self.getHostUserId)
	if not ok then
		return false, Reasons.HostUnavailable
	end
	if hostUserId == nil then
		return false, Reasons.NoHost
	end
	if not Validate.isPositiveInteger(hostUserId) then
		return false, Reasons.HostIdInvalid
	end
	if hostUserId ~= userId then
		return false, Reasons.NotHost
	end
	return true
end

-- The current host's UserId when valid, else nil (used to detect host changes).
function HostAuthority:currentHostUserId()
	local ok, hostUserId = pcall(self.getHostUserId)
	if ok and Validate.isPositiveInteger(hostUserId) then
		return hostUserId
	end
	return nil
end

-- Default live source. Studio integration pending: verifies nothing beyond the
-- documented attribute name.
function HostAuthority.podcastSettingsSource()
	return function()
		local settings = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PodcastSettings")
		if settings == nil then
			return nil
		end
		return settings:GetAttribute("HostUserId")
	end
end

return HostAuthority

--[[
	RoomProvider: resolves the editable sandbox for a player.

	The prototype builds only in a separate sandbox; the six existing rooms are
	never offered. The resolver is injected:

		resolve(player) -> {
			id = "sandbox_main",          -- stable string ID
			origin = CFrame,              -- floor centre, +Y up (opaque to pure code)
			bounds = { halfX = 20, halfZ = 20, height = 16 },  -- studs
		} or nil

	Results are validated before use; anything malformed means "no sandbox".
	Default live source: RoomProvider.markerSource() reads an anchored marker
	part named Config.SandboxMarkerName at the top level of Workspace (its
	volume is the build volume). Studio integration pending.
]]
