local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("StudioBuilder")
local Config = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Config"))
local Validate = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Validate"))

local RoomProvider = {}
RoomProvider.__index = RoomProvider

local function defaultIsOrigin(value)
	return typeof ~= nil and typeof(value) == "CFrame"
end

-- options.resolve: function(player) -> descriptor|nil
-- options.isOrigin: function(value) -> boolean (optional; defaults to a CFrame check)
function RoomProvider.new(options)
	assert(type(options) == "table" and type(options.resolve) == "function", "RoomProvider.new requires resolve")
	return setmetatable({
		resolver = options.resolve,
		isOrigin = options.isOrigin or defaultIsOrigin,
	}, RoomProvider)
end

local function validBounds(b)
	if type(b) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	for _, key in ipairs({ "halfX", "halfZ", "height" }) do
		local v = b[key]
		if not Validate.isFiniteNumber(v) or v <= 0 or v > Config.MaxCoordinate then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

-- Returns a clean descriptor or nil, reason.
function RoomProvider:resolve(player)
	local ok, d = pcall(self.resolver, player)
	if not ok then
		return nil, "ResolverError"
	end
	if d == nil then
		return nil, "NoSandbox"
	end
	if type(d) ~= "table" or not Validate.isBoundedString(d.id, 64) or not validBounds(d.bounds) or not self.isOrigin(d.origin) then
		return nil, "InvalidSandbox"
	end
	return {
		id = d.id,
		origin = d.origin,
		bounds = { halfX = d.bounds.halfX, halfZ = d.bounds.halfZ, height = d.bounds.height },
	}
end

-- Default live source (Roblox only; Studio integration pending).
function RoomProvider.markerSource()
	local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
	return function()
		local marker = Workspace:FindFirstChild(Config.SandboxMarkerName)
		if marker == nil or not marker:IsA("BasePart") then
			return nil
		end
		local size = marker.Size
		return {
			id = "marker:" .. marker.Name,
			origin = marker.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -size.Y / 2, 0),
			bounds = { halfX = size.X / 2, halfZ = size.Z / 2, height = size.Y },
		}
	end
end

return RoomProvider

--[[
	SaveBackends: storage for Build snapshots.

	Contract every backend implements:
		backend.kind               string, e.g. "memory"
		backend:load(userId)       -> record or nil (nil = nothing saved yet);
		                              raises an error on failure
		backend:save(userId, record)  raises an error on failure

	Only the in-memory backend exists so far. It is process-local and lost
	when the server shuts down: NOT persistence. A DataStore backend is planned
	for task 5 and will be documented as untested until Codex verifies it.
]]

local SaveBackends = {}

local function deepCopy(value, depth)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return value
	end
	assert(depth < 8, "record nested too deeply")
	local copy = {}
	for k, v in pairs(value) do
		copy[k] = deepCopy(v, depth + 1)
	end
	return copy
end

function SaveBackends.memory()
	local store = {}
	local backend = { kind = "memory" }
	function backend:load(userId)
		return deepCopy(store[userId], 0)
	end
	function backend:save(userId, record)
		store[userId] = deepCopy(record, 0)
	end
	return backend
end

-- Returns ok, reason. Used at startup to reject a misconfigured backend.
function SaveBackends.check(backend)
	if type(backend) ~= "table" then
		return false, "backend must be a table"
	end
	if type(backend.kind) ~= "string" or #backend.kind == 0 then
		return false, "backend.kind must be a non-empty string"
	end
	if type(backend.load) ~= "function" or type(backend.save) ~= "function" then
		return false, "backend needs load and save functions"
	end
	return true
end

return SaveBackends

--[[
	SaveSnapshot: the versioned Build save payload.

	Verified contract (2026-10-25): StudioPresets entries hold a Director
	snapshot {Version=1, Settings, Fixtures, Items}. The builder adds one
	section beside them, leaving the preset entry and top-level Version at 1:

		Build = {
			Version = 1,
			NextId = 4,
			Items = {
				{ Id = "i1", CatalogId = "cozy_armchair_01",
				  Transform = { X = 0, Y = 0, Z = -4, Yaw = 90 } },
				...
			},
		}

	Transforms are room-relative (studs from the sandbox origin, yaw in
	degrees). Only catalog IDs and bounded numbers are stored: no Instances,
	asset IDs or attribute bags. A preset without a Build section is a legacy
	preset; readFromPreset() reports NoBuild so callers keep legacy behaviour.

	decode() is strict about structure: bad types, non-finite numbers,
	duplicate IDs or too many items fail the whole section, so the caller can
	refuse to save over data it could not read. Sections newer than VERSION
	fail with UnsupportedVersion (never downgraded); older ones run through
	Migrations in order. Entries that are structurally fine but not placeable
	right now (retired item, out of bounds, locked collection) come back in
	`preserved` and are written back by encode(), never silently dropped.

	Internally the builder uses plain entries { id, itemId, x, y, z, yaw }.
]]

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("StudioBuilder")
local Config = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Config"))
local Catalog = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Catalog"))
local Validate = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Validate"))

local SaveSnapshot = {}

SaveSnapshot.SECTION_KEY = Config.BuildSectionKey
SaveSnapshot.VERSION = Config.BuildSectionVersion

SaveSnapshot.Codes = {
	Corrupt = "Corrupt",
	UnsupportedVersion = "UnsupportedVersion",
	TooLarge = "TooLarge",
	NoBuild = "NoBuild",
}

-- Migrations[n](section) returns a NEW version n+1 section. Empty while only v1 exists.
SaveSnapshot.Migrations = {}

local MAX_ID_NUMBER = 1000000000
local MAX_YAW = 3600

function SaveSnapshot.parseBuildId(id)
	if type(id) ~= "string" or #id < 2 or #id > Config.MaxBuildIdLength then
		return nil
	end
	local digits = string.match(id, "^i([1-9]%d*)$")
	local n = digits and tonumber(digits) or nil
	if n == nil or n > MAX_ID_NUMBER then
		return nil
	end
	return n
end

function SaveSnapshot.formatBuildId(n)
	return string.format("i%d", n)
end

local function copyEntry(e)
	return { id = e.id, itemId = e.itemId, x = e.x, y = e.y, z = e.z, yaw = e.yaw }
end

local function toStored(e)
	return { Id = e.id, CatalogId = e.itemId, Transform = { X = e.x, Y = e.y, Z = e.z, Yaw = e.yaw } }
end

-- Structural check of one stored item. Returns an internal entry and its id number, or nil.
local function checkStored(s)
	if type(s) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local idNumber = SaveSnapshot.parseBuildId(s.Id)
	if idNumber == nil then
		return nil
	end
	if not Validate.isBoundedString(s.CatalogId, Config.MaxCatalogIdLength, Catalog.ITEM_ID_PATTERN) then
		return nil
	end
	local t = s.Transform
	if type(t) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local limit = Config.MaxCoordinate
	for _, key in ipairs({ "X", "Y", "Z" }) do
		local v = t[key]
		if not Validate.isFiniteNumber(v) or math.abs(v) > limit then
			return nil
		end
	end
	if not Validate.isFiniteNumber(t.Yaw) or math.abs(t.Yaw) > MAX_YAW then
		return nil
	end
	return { id = s.Id, itemId = s.CatalogId, x = t.X, y = t.Y, z = t.Z, yaw = t.Yaw }, idNumber
end

local function byIdNumber(a, b)
	return SaveSnapshot.parseBuildId(a.Id) < SaveSnapshot.parseBuildId(b.Id)
end

-- build: { nextId = integer, items = { entry }, preserved = { entry }? }
-- Returns the Build section.
function SaveSnapshot.encode(build)
	local items = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(build.items) do
		items[#items + 1] = toStored(e)
	end
	for _, e in ipairs(build.preserved or {}) do
		items[#items + 1] = toStored(e)
	end
	table.sort(items, byIdNumber)
	return { Version = SaveSnapshot.VERSION, NextId = build.nextId, Items = items }
end

local function migrate(section)
	local current = section
	while current.Version < SaveSnapshot.VERSION do
		local step = SaveSnapshot.Migrations[current.Version]
		if step == nil then
			return nil, SaveSnapshot.Codes.UnsupportedVersion
		end
		local ok, upgraded = pcall(step, current)
		if not ok or type(upgraded) ~= "table" or upgraded.Version ~= current.Version + 1 then
			return nil, SaveSnapshot.Codes.Corrupt
		end
		current = upgraded
	end
	return current
end

-- options.classify(entry) -> true when placeable now (optional; default true)
-- options.maxItems (optional; default Config.MaxItems)
-- Returns { nextId, items, preserved } or nil, code.
function SaveSnapshot.decode(section, options)
	local Codes = SaveSnapshot.Codes
	options = options or {}
	if type(section) ~= "table" or not Validate.isPositiveInteger(section.Version) then
		return nil, Codes.Corrupt
	end
	if section.Version > SaveSnapshot.VERSION then
		return nil, Codes.UnsupportedVersion
	end
	local migrated, migrateCode = migrate(section)
	if migrated == nil then
		return nil, migrateCode
	end

	local n = Validate.sequenceLength(migrated.Items, options.maxItems or Config.MaxItems)
	if n == nil then
		return nil, Codes.Corrupt
	end
	local nextId = migrated.NextId
	if not Validate.isPositiveInteger(nextId) or nextId > MAX_ID_NUMBER + 1 then
		return nil, Codes.Corrupt
	end

	local result = { nextId = nextId, items = {}, preserved = {} }
	local seen = {}
	local highest = 0
	for i = 1, n do
		local entry, idNumber = checkStored(migrated.Items[i])
		if entry == nil or seen[entry.id] then
			return nil, Codes.Corrupt
		end
		seen[entry.id] = true
		if idNumber > highest then
			highest = idNumber
		end
		local placeable = true
		if options.classify then
			local ok, verdict = pcall(options.classify, copyEntry(entry))
			placeable = ok and verdict == true
		end
		if placeable then
			result.items[#result.items + 1] = entry
		else
			result.preserved[#result.preserved + 1] = entry
		end
	end
	-- Never hand out an ID that already exists in the section.
	if result.nextId <= highest then
		result.nextId = highest + 1
	end
	return result
end

-- Returns a shallow copy of a Director preset snapshot with the Build section
-- attached. Version, Settings, Fixtures and Items are passed through untouched.
function SaveSnapshot.attachToPreset(presetData, section)
	assert(type(presetData) == "table", "preset snapshot must be a table")
	local copy = {}
	for k, v in pairs(presetData) do
		copy[k] = v
	end
	copy[SaveSnapshot.SECTION_KEY] = section
	return copy
end

-- Reads the Build section out of a preset snapshot. A missing section returns
-- nil, NoBuild (legacy preset); everything else goes through decode().
function SaveSnapshot.readFromPreset(presetData, options)
	if type(presetData) ~= "table" then
		return nil, SaveSnapshot.Codes.Corrupt
	end
	local section = presetData[SaveSnapshot.SECTION_KEY]
	if section == nil then
		return nil, SaveSnapshot.Codes.NoBuild
	end
	return SaveSnapshot.decode(section, options)
end

-- Conservative upper bound of the JSON size in bytes, so the cap can be
-- checked without HttpService.
function SaveSnapshot.estimateBytes(section)
	local bytes = 64
	for _, s in ipairs(section.Items or {}) do
		bytes = bytes + 96 + #tostring(s.Id) + #tostring(s.CatalogId) + 4 * 24
	end
	return bytes
end

function SaveSnapshot.checkSize(section, maxBytes)
	if SaveSnapshot.estimateBytes(section) > (maxBytes or Config.MaxBuildSectionBytes) then
		return false, SaveSnapshot.Codes.TooLarge
	end
	return true
end

return SaveSnapshot

--[[
	TemplateCatalog: maps stable catalog IDs to curated templates.

	Pure core: TemplateCatalog.build(catalog, probe) where
		probe(itemId) -> nil                      template not installed
		              -> { size = { x, y, z } }   installed (measured bounds, studs)
		              (raising an error marks the entry invalid)
	Each item ends up "installed", "not_installed" or "invalid". Only installed
	items may be placed; the UI shows the others as disabled "not installed" cards.

	Default live probe: TemplateCatalog.serverStorageProbe() looks for a Model
	named exactly like the item ID in ServerStorage.StudioBuilderTemplates.
	Templates are curated by Codex; nothing is ever loaded from an asset ID, and
	client input only ever selects among these catalog IDs. Test fixtures are
	read only in Studio and only when Config.Dev.UseTestFixtures is true.
	Studio integration pending.
]]

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("StudioBuilder")
local Config = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Config"))
local Validate = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Validate"))

local TemplateCatalog = {}
TemplateCatalog.__index = TemplateCatalog

TemplateCatalog.Status = {
	Installed = "installed",
	NotInstalled = "not_installed",
	Invalid = "invalid",
}

local MAX_TEMPLATE_EXTENT = 256

local function cleanSize(size)
	if Validate.sequenceLength(size, 3) ~= 3 then
		return nil
	end
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local v = size[i]
		if not Validate.isFiniteNumber(v) or v <= 0 or v > MAX_TEMPLATE_EXTENT then
			return nil
		end
	end
	return { size[1], size[2], size[3] }
end

function TemplateCatalog.build(catalog, probe)
	assert(type(probe) == "function", "TemplateCatalog.build requires a probe function")
	local Status = TemplateCatalog.Status
	local entries = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(catalog.Items) do
		local ok, result = pcall(probe, item.id)
		local entry
		if not ok then
			entry = { status = Status.Invalid, reason = tostring(result) }
		elseif result == nil then
			entry = { status = Status.NotInstalled }
		else
			local size = type(result) == "table" and cleanSize(result.size) or nil
			if size then
				entry = { status = Status.Installed, size = size }
			else
				entry = { status = Status.Invalid, reason = "bad size" }
			end
		end
		entries[item.id] = entry
	end
	return setmetatable({ catalog = catalog, entries = entries }, TemplateCatalog)
end

function TemplateCatalog:status(itemId)
	local entry = type(itemId) == "string" and self.entries[itemId] or nil
	return entry and entry.status or nil
end

function TemplateCatalog:isInstalled(itemId)
	return self:status(itemId) == TemplateCatalog.Status.Installed
end

-- Copy of the measured size, or nil when not installed.
function TemplateCatalog:getSize(itemId)
	if not self:isInstalled(itemId) then
		return nil
	end
	local s = self.entries[itemId].size
	return { s[1], s[2], s[3] }
end

-- Client-safe drawer listing: IDs, names, tags, status and size only. No
-- Instances, paths, source refs or asset IDs are exposed.
function TemplateCatalog:clientListing()
	local list = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(self.catalog.Items) do
		local tags = {}
		for i, tag in ipairs(item.collections) do
			tags[i] = tag
		end
		list[#list + 1] = {
			id = item.id,
			displayName = item.displayName,
			collections = tags,
			status = self:status(item.id),
			size = self:getSize(item.id),
		}
	end
	return list
end

-- Default live probe (Roblox only; Studio integration pending).
function TemplateCatalog.serverStorageProbe()
	local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	return function(itemId)
		local folder = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(Config.TemplateFolderName)
		local template = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(itemId) or nil
		if template == nil and Config.Dev.UseTestFixtures == true and RunService:IsStudio() then
			local fixtures = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(Config.Dev.TestFixtureFolderName)
			template = fixtures and fixtures:FindFirstChild(itemId) or nil
		end
		if template == nil then
			return nil
		end
		if not template:IsA("Model") then
			error("template is not a Model")
		end
		for _, descendant in ipairs(template:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
				error("template contains scripts")
			end
		end
		-- Placement assumes an upright template whose pivot is its bottom centre.
		local boxCFrame, size = template:GetBoundingBox()
		local pivot = template:GetPivot()
		if pivot.UpVector:Dot(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)) < 0.999 then
			error("template pivot is not upright")
		end
		local bottomCentre = boxCFrame * CFrame.new(0, -size.Y / 2, 0)
		if (pivot.Position - bottomCentre.Position).Magnitude > 0.05 then
			error("template pivot is not at the bottom centre")
		end
		return { size = { size.X, size.Y, size.Z } }
	end
end

return TemplateCatalog

--[[
	AssetYardGuard: removes the editor-only asset yard when a server starts.

	Workspace.StudioAssetYard holds display copies Codex uses while curating
	assets in Edit mode. It is not a build template source (those live in
	ServerStorage.StudioBuilderTemplates) and must not exist during play.
	Only the exact top-level child is removed; nothing else in Workspace (the
	six rooms included) is searched or touched.
]]

local AssetYardGuard = {}

-- workspace: anything with FindFirstChild (injected for tests).
-- Returns true when a yard was found and destroyed.
function AssetYardGuard.run(workspace, yardName)
	local yard = workspace:FindFirstChild(yardName)
	if yard == nil then
		return false
	end
	yard:Destroy()
	return true
end

return AssetYardGuard

--[[
	BuildHistory: server-side undo/redo stacks for the shared sandbox.

	Entries describe committed world effects with exact logical IDs:
		{ kind = "spawn",  id, record }          undo = remove id, redo = spawn id again
		{ kind = "remove", id, record }          undo = spawn id again, redo = remove id
		{ kind = "move",   id, before, after }   undo = move to before, redo = move to after

	History is valid only for the user who made it, in the host session
	(epoch) it was made in, and only at the build revision it last recorded.
	sync() clears it when any differs: a host transfer (even A -> B -> A,
	which bumps the epoch), or a revision change that history did not make
	(recovery, reconcile or a future load). Pure.
]]

local BuildHistory = {}
BuildHistory.__index = BuildHistory

function BuildHistory.new(limit)
	return setmetatable({ limit = limit, undoStack = {}, redoStack = {}, ownerUserId = nil, revision = 0, epoch = nil }, BuildHistory)
end

function BuildHistory:clear(revision)
	self.undoStack = {}
	self.redoStack = {}
	self.ownerUserId = nil
	self.epoch = nil
	self.revision = revision
end

function BuildHistory:_valid(userId, revision, epoch)
	return self.ownerUserId == userId and self.revision == revision and self.epoch == epoch
end

-- Clears the stacks unless they belong to userId in epoch at revision.
-- Returns true if cleared.
function BuildHistory:sync(userId, revision, epoch)
	if self:_valid(userId, revision, epoch) then
		return false
	end
	self:clear(revision)
	self.ownerUserId = userId
	self.epoch = epoch
	return true
end

function BuildHistory:canUndo(userId, revision, epoch)
	return self:_valid(userId, revision, epoch) and #self.undoStack > 0
end

function BuildHistory:canRedo(userId, revision, epoch)
	return self:_valid(userId, revision, epoch) and #self.redoStack > 0
end

-- A new edit: push it and drop the redo stack.
function BuildHistory:record(entry, revision)
	local stack = self.undoStack
	stack[#stack + 1] = entry
	while #stack > self.limit do
		table.remove(stack, 1)
	end
	self.redoStack = {}
	self.revision = revision
end

function BuildHistory:peek(direction)
	local stack = direction == "undo" and self.undoStack or self.redoStack
	return stack[#stack]
end

-- Moves the applied entry to the opposite stack.
function BuildHistory:commitStep(direction, revision)
	local from = direction == "undo" and self.undoStack or self.redoStack
	local to = direction == "undo" and self.redoStack or self.undoStack
	to[#to + 1] = table.remove(from)
	self.revision = revision
end

-- Discards an entry that can no longer be applied.
function BuildHistory:drop(direction)
	local stack = direction == "undo" and self.undoStack or self.redoStack
	table.remove(stack)
end

return BuildHistory

--[[
	BuildPersistence: the Director-facing API for saving and loading the
	builder's Build section inside existing StudioPresets snapshots (5 slots,
	250000-byte cap, entry Version 1). No separate save profile, no autosave.

	getCore() -> PlacementCore | nil (nil when the builder is disabled here).

	Save:  data = persistence:attachBuild(snapshot())
	       Errors (visible failed save) when the builder can't capture now:
	       Busy, RecoveryNeeded, TooLarge. With the builder disabled the
	       snapshot is returned unchanged and PresetSlotGuard refuses to
	       overwrite a slot whose Build has entries.
	Load:  staged = persistence:prepareLoad(userId, data)   -- before any yield/mutation
	       ... text filtering (yields) and host check ...
	       txn = persistence:begin(userId, staged)          -- holds the builder lock
	       txn:applyBuild(); <room restore>; txn:stillAuthorized()
	       txn:commit()   or, on any failure: <room rollback>; txn:rollback()
	       (integration/DirectorPersistence.luau drives this.)
	* prepareLoad validates and stages without mutating: Corrupt or newer
	  (UnsupportedVersion) Build sections error, so nothing changes.
	  Unplaceable entries are preserved and written back on the next save.
	  A preset without Build (legacy) leaves the build untouched.
	* prepareLoad binds the staged load to the host epoch and build revision;
	  begin() refuses if either moved (A -> B -> A during text filtering).
	* The transaction holds PlacementCore's edit lock across the whole room +
	  build load, so builder edits and saves get Busy until it ends. A failed
	  world rollback leaves the builder in recovery (edits and saves refused).
	Error messages are player-facing; errors are raised with a position
	prefix so the Director's existing ":%d+: (.+)$" extraction shows them.
]]

local SaveSnapshot = require(script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Adapters"):WaitForChild("SaveSnapshot"))

local BuildPersistence = {}
BuildPersistence.__index = BuildPersistence

BuildPersistence.Messages = {
	Busy = "The builder is still applying a change. Try again in a moment.",
	RecoveryNeeded = "The builder is resynchronizing. Try again in a moment; nothing was changed.",
	TooLarge = "This studio's build is too large to save.",
	Corrupt = "This saved studio's build data can't be read. Nothing was changed.",
	UnsupportedVersion = "This saved studio was made by a newer version and can't be loaded here. Nothing was changed.",
	NotHost = "Host controls changed while loading. Nothing was changed.",
	AuthorityLost = "Host controls changed while loading. Nothing was changed.",
	StaleRevision = "The build changed while loading. Nothing was changed.",
	ApplyFailed = "The build couldn't be applied. Nothing was changed.",
	Unavailable = "The builder isn't available here.",
	Internal = "The build couldn't be processed. Nothing was changed.",
}

function BuildPersistence.new(getCore)
	assert(type(getCore) == "function", "BuildPersistence.new requires getCore")
	return setmetatable({ getCore = getCore, pendingExternal = nil }, BuildPersistence)
end

-- True while a failed compound load still has to be restored (builder
-- recovery, or a pending room restore when the builder is disabled). Edits,
-- saves and loads are refused meanwhile.
function BuildPersistence:recovering()
	local core = self.getCore()
	if core ~= nil then
		return core:inRecovery()
	end
	return self.pendingExternal ~= nil
end

-- One recovery attempt. Returns true when nothing is pending any more.
function BuildPersistence:recover()
	local core = self.getCore()
	if core ~= nil then
		return core:recover()
	end
	if self.pendingExternal ~= nil then
		local called, restored = pcall(self.pendingExternal)
		if called and restored ~= false then
			self.pendingExternal = nil
		end
	end
	return self.pendingExternal == nil
end

local function fail(code)
	error(BuildPersistence.Messages[code] or BuildPersistence.Messages.Internal, 2)
end

function BuildPersistence:attachBuild(snapshot)
	local core = self.getCore()
	if core == nil then
		return snapshot
	end
	local section, code = core:captureBuild()
	if section == nil then
		fail(code)
	end
	return SaveSnapshot.attachToPreset(snapshot, section)
end

-- Validates and stages a preset's Build section before any yield or
-- mutation, and binds it to the current host session and build revision.
-- Corrupt or newer sections error. Returns staged = { legacy?, plan?, binding? }.
function BuildPersistence:prepareLoad(userId, data)
	local core = self.getCore()
	if core == nil then
		-- Builder disabled here: the room loads; any Build section stays in the preset.
		return { legacy = true, skipped = true }
	end
	if not core:_isHost(userId) then
		fail("NotHost")
	end
	local binding = core:binding()
	if type(data) ~= "table" or data[SaveSnapshot.SECTION_KEY] == nil then
		-- Legacy (room-only): still bound to the host session.
		return { legacy = true, binding = { epoch = binding.epoch } }
	end
	local plan, code = core:prepareLoad(userId, data[SaveSnapshot.SECTION_KEY])
	if plan == nil then
		fail(code)
	end
	return { plan = plan, binding = binding }
end

local LoadTransaction = {}
LoadTransaction.__index = LoadTransaction

-- Starts the compound load: holds the builder's edit lock until commit() or
-- rollback(). Errors (nothing changed) if the host session or build revision
-- moved since prepareLoad. With the builder disabled, returns an inert
-- transaction so the Director code has one shape.
function BuildPersistence:begin(userId, staged)
	local core = self.getCore()
	if core == nil or staged.skipped then
		if not self:recover() then
			fail("RecoveryNeeded")
		end
		return setmetatable({ inert = true, owner = self }, LoadTransaction)
	end
	local txn, code = core:beginTransaction(userId, staged.binding)
	if txn == nil then
		fail(code)
	end
	return setmetatable({ txn = txn, staged = staged }, LoadTransaction)
end

-- Applies the staged build to the world (legacy loads: no-op). Errors on failure;
-- the caller must then call rollback().
function LoadTransaction:applyBuild()
	if self.inert or self.staged.legacy then
		return
	end
	local ok, code = self.txn:applyBuild(self.staged.plan)
	if not ok then
		fail(code)
	end
end

-- Final authority check after yields (host and host session).
function LoadTransaction:stillAuthorized()
	if self.inert then
		return true
	end
	return self.txn:stillAuthorized()
end

-- Returns { ok, buildRevision?, recoveryNeeded? }.
function LoadTransaction:commit()
	if self.inert then
		return { ok = true }
	end
	return self.txn:commit()
end

-- external (optional): function() -> ok restoring the room, when its own
-- rollback failed; it is retried by recovery until it succeeds.
-- Returns true only when nothing is pending (false = recovery: edits and saves
-- refused for every host until it completes).
function LoadTransaction:rollback(external)
	if self.inert then
		if external ~= nil then
			self.owner.pendingExternal = external
			return false
		end
		return true
	end
	return self.txn:rollback(external)
end

return BuildPersistence

--[[
	PlacementCore: server-authoritative place / move / rotate / duplicate /
	delete for the single editable sandbox. Pure: every Roblox touch point is
	injected, and any injected call may yield.

	deps = {
		config, catalog,
		templates     = { isInstalled(itemId), getSize(itemId) },   -- TemplateCatalog
		entitlements  = { isItemUnlocked(userId, item, catalog) },  -- Entitlements
		authority     = { check(userId) -> allowed, reason,          -- HostAuthority
		                  currentHostUserId() -> id? (optional) },
		bounds        = { halfX, halfZ, height },                   -- RoomProvider sandbox
		world         = { apply(effect) -> token, rollback(token), commit(token),
		                  reconcile(entries)?, publishRevision(n) }, -- PlacedItemsWorld
		clock         = function() -> seconds,
		log           = function(message) (optional),
	}
	world.apply must leave no change behind when it raises.

	States: "ready" | "busy" | "recovery".
	Per request: rate limit -> strict payload (pure) -> recovery check ->
	take the edit lock (Busy if held) -> host check -> plan (catalog,
	template, entitlement, bounds, cap; no mutation) -> host re-check ->
	world.apply -> host re-check -> commit model + BuildRevision ->
	world.commit (finalize) -> release the lock.
	* The lock is taken before any injected (possibly yielding) dependency and
	  released in exactly one place, for every outcome.
	* Rejections before world.apply leave state, world and revision untouched.
	* After world.apply, a lost host or a model commit error rolls the world
	  back. If that rollback fails, or finalize fails, the core fails closed:
	  it keeps the operation and token, enters "recovery", answers
	  recoveryNeeded=true, and refuses edits until recover() succeeds (retry
	  the operation, then world.reconcile from the model as a fallback).
	* Shared studio: the current host may edit any placed item, whoever placed
	  it (placedByUserId is metadata only).
	* Undo/Redo are planners like any other op: same lock, host checks,
	  validation (catalog, template, entitlement, bounds, cap), world
	  apply/rollback and recovery. They restore exact logical IDs. A step that
	  no longer applies (item changed, template removed, collection locked) is
	  dropped with HistoryConflict and never touches the world. History is
	  cleared on host transfer, on any revision change it did not make, and on
	  entering recovery. Undo/Redo may carry expectedRevision (StaleRevision).
	* Host sessions: onHostChanged() (wired to PodcastSettings.HostUserId)
	  bumps a host epoch and clears history at once, so A -> B -> A ends A's
	  old history even with no edit in between. Every request also compares
	  authority.currentHostUserId() with the last seen host, in case a signal
	  was missed. The epoch is captured with the lock and re-checked with the
	  host after every possibly-yielding step; a change aborts (rollback) with
	  AuthorityLost. Status offers undo/redo only to the current host.
]]

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("StudioBuilder")
local Protocol = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Protocol"))
local Transform = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Transform"))
local Validate = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Validate"))

local SaveSnapshot = require(script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Adapters"):WaitForChild("SaveSnapshot"))
local BuildHistory = require(script.Parent.BuildHistory)
local BuildModel = require(script.Parent.BuildModel)
local RateLimiter = require(script.Parent.RateLimiter)
local RequestValidator = require(script.Parent.RequestValidator)

local Codes = Protocol.Codes

local PlacementCore = {}
PlacementCore.__index = PlacementCore

local READY, BUSY, RECOVERY = "ready", "busy", "recovery"

local REQUIRED = { "config", "catalog", "templates", "entitlements", "authority", "bounds", "world", "clock" }

function PlacementCore.new(deps)
	assert(type(deps) == "table", "PlacementCore.new requires deps")
	for _, name in ipairs(REQUIRED) do
		assert(deps[name] ~= nil, "PlacementCore missing dependency: " .. name)
	end
	local self = setmetatable({}, PlacementCore)
	for k, v in pairs(deps) do
		self[k] = v
	end
	self.model = BuildModel.new(deps.config.MaxItems)
	self.preserved = {} -- saved entries that can't be placed right now; written back on save
	self.history = BuildHistory.new(deps.config.HistoryLimit or 50)
	self.limiter = RateLimiter.new(deps.config.RateLimits, deps.clock)
	self.revision = 0
	self.state = READY
	self.pending = nil -- { token, effect } between world.apply and the model commit
	self.recovery = nil -- { kind = "rollback" | "finalize", token, effect }
	self.recovering = false
	self.hostEpoch = 0
	self.lastSeenHost = self:_currentHost()
	return self
end

function PlacementCore:_currentHost()
	if self.authority.currentHostUserId == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, hostUserId = pcall(self.authority.currentHostUserId, self.authority)
	return ok and hostUserId or nil
end

-- Runtime notification that PodcastSettings.HostUserId changed.
function PlacementCore:onHostChanged()
	self.hostEpoch = self.hostEpoch + 1
	self.lastSeenHost = self:_currentHost()
	self.history:clear(self.revision)
end

-- Fallback for a missed notification: compare with the last seen host.
function PlacementCore:_observeHost()
	if self.authority.currentHostUserId == nil then
		return
	end
	if self:_currentHost() ~= self.lastSeenHost then
		self:onHostChanged()
	end
end

-- Host check bound to the host session captured when the lock was taken.
-- Authority reads may yield, so the epoch is compared LAST, after every
-- possibly-yielding read; a transfer during those reads (A -> B -> A) bumps
-- the epoch and is caught.
function PlacementCore:_stillAuthorized(userId, epoch)
	local allowed = self:_isHost(userId)
	self:_observeHost()
	return allowed and self.hostEpoch == epoch
end

function PlacementCore:_log(message)
	if self.log then
		pcall(self.log, message)
	end
end

function PlacementCore:_reject(code)
	return { ok = false, code = code, buildRevision = self.revision }
end

function PlacementCore:_isHost(userId)
	local ok, allowed = pcall(self.authority.check, self.authority, userId)
	return ok and allowed == true
end

function PlacementCore:getRevision()
	return self.revision
end

function PlacementCore:getState()
	return self.state
end

function PlacementCore:getRecovery()
	return self.recovery
end

function PlacementCore:list()
	return self.model:list()
end

-- Status for userId; attached to every response.
function PlacementCore:status(userId)
	local authorized = self:_isHost(userId)
	return {
		state = self.state,
		canUndo = authorized and self.history:canUndo(userId, self.revision, self.hostEpoch),
		canRedo = authorized and self.history:canRedo(userId, self.revision, self.hostEpoch),
		revision = self.revision,
	}
end

-- Catalog, install and entitlement checks for creating an instance of itemId.
function PlacementCore:_checkCreatable(userId, itemId)
	local item = self.catalog.getItem(itemId)
	if item == nil then
		return nil, Codes.UnknownItem
	end
	if not self.templates.isInstalled(itemId) then
		return nil, Codes.NotInstalled
	end
	if not self.entitlements:isItemUnlocked(userId, item, self.catalog) then
		return nil, Codes.NotEntitled
	end
	return item
end

function PlacementCore:_clean(itemId, raw)
	local size = self.templates.getSize(itemId)
	if size == nil then
		return nil, Codes.NotInstalled
	end
	return Transform.sanitize(raw, size, self.bounds, self.config)
end

-- Resolves an existing item. Returns id, record or nil, code.
function PlacementCore:_existing(rawId)
	local id, code = RequestValidator.buildId(rawId)
	if id == nil then
		return nil, code
	end
	local record = self.model:get(id)
	if record == nil then
		return nil, Codes.NotFound
	end
	return id, record
end

local function withTransform(record, t)
	return { itemId = record.itemId, placedByUserId = record.placedByUserId, x = t.x, y = t.y, z = t.z, yaw = t.yaw }
end

local function sameTransform(a, b)
	return a.x == b.x and a.y == b.y and a.z == b.z and a.yaw == b.yaw
end

local function sameRecord(a, b)
	return a.itemId == b.itemId and sameTransform(a, b)
end

-- History entry describing a committed effect (exact logical ID).
local function entryFromEffect(effect)
	if effect.kind == "move" then
		return { kind = "move", id = effect.id, before = BuildModel.copyRecord(effect.from), after = BuildModel.copyRecord(effect.to) }
	end
	return { kind = effect.kind, id = effect.id, record = BuildModel.copyRecord(effect.record) }
end

-- id is optional: a new ID is allocated unless an exact one is restored (redo/undo).
function PlacementCore:_spawnPlan(record, id)
	if not self.model:hasCapacity() then
		return nil, Codes.ItemCap
	end
	id = id or self.model:peekNextId()
	local model = self.model
	return {
		id = id,
		effect = { kind = "spawn", id = id, record = BuildModel.copyRecord(record) },
		commit = function()
			model:add(id, record)
		end,
	}
end

function PlacementCore:_movePlan(id, before, raw)
	local t, code = self:_clean(before.itemId, raw)
	if t == nil then
		return nil, code
	end
	local after = withTransform(before, t)
	if sameTransform(before, after) then
		return { id = id, noop = true }
	end
	local model = self.model
	return {
		id = id,
		effect = { kind = "move", id = id, from = before, to = BuildModel.copyRecord(after) },
		commit = function()
			model:set(id, after)
		end,
	}
end

local planners = {}

function planners.Place(self, userId, payload)
	local itemId, code = RequestValidator.catalogId(rawget(payload, "itemId"))
	if itemId == nil then
		return nil, code
	end
	local _, itemCode = self:_checkCreatable(userId, itemId)
	if itemCode then
		return nil, itemCode
	end
	local shape, shapeCode = RequestValidator.transformShape(rawget(payload, "transform"))
	if shape == nil then
		return nil, shapeCode
	end
	local t, tCode = self:_clean(itemId, shape)
	if t == nil then
		return nil, tCode
	end
	return self:_spawnPlan({ itemId = itemId, placedByUserId = userId, x = t.x, y = t.y, z = t.z, yaw = t.yaw })
end

function planners.Move(self, _, payload)
	local id, record = self:_existing(rawget(payload, "id"))
	if id == nil then
		return nil, record
	end
	local shape, code = RequestValidator.transformShape(rawget(payload, "transform"))
	if shape == nil then
		return nil, code
	end
	return self:_movePlan(id, record, shape)
end

function planners.Rotate(self, _, payload)
	local id, record = self:_existing(rawget(payload, "id"))
	if id == nil then
		return nil, record
	end
	local direction, code = RequestValidator.direction(rawget(payload, "direction"))
	if direction == nil then
		return nil, code
	end
	local raw = { x = record.x, y = record.y, z = record.z, yaw = record.yaw + direction * self.config.RotationStep }
	return self:_movePlan(id, record, raw)
end

function planners.Duplicate(self, userId, payload)
	local id, source = self:_existing(rawget(payload, "id"))
	if id == nil then
		return nil, source
	end
	local _, itemCode = self:_checkCreatable(userId, source.itemId)
	if itemCode then
		return nil, itemCode
	end
	local size = self.templates.getSize(source.itemId)
	if size == nil then
		return nil, Codes.NotInstalled
	end
	-- Server picks the spot: next to the source on a free side, grid-aligned.
	local hx, hz = Transform.halfExtents(size, source.yaw)
	local grid = self.config.GridSize
	local dx = math.ceil(hx * 2 / grid) * grid
	local dz = math.ceil(hz * 2 / grid) * grid
	for _, offset in ipairs({ { dx, 0 }, { -dx, 0 }, { 0, dz }, { 0, -dz } }) do
		local t = self:_clean(source.itemId, { x = source.x + offset[1], y = source.y, z = source.z + offset[2], yaw = source.yaw })
		if t then
			return self:_spawnPlan({ itemId = source.itemId, placedByUserId = userId, x = t.x, y = t.y, z = t.z, yaw = t.yaw })
		end
	end
	return nil, Codes.OutOfBounds
end

function planners.Delete(self, _, payload)
	local id, record = self:_existing(rawget(payload, "id"))
	if id == nil then
		return nil, record
	end
	local model = self.model
	return {
		id = id,
		effect = { kind = "remove", id = id, record = record },
		commit = function()
			model:remove(id)
		end,
	}
end

-- Plans one undo or redo step. A step that no longer applies comes back as
-- { conflict = code } so the caller drops it without touching the world.
function PlacementCore:_historyPlan(userId, direction)
	local entry = self.history:peek(direction)
	if entry == nil then
		return nil, direction == "undo" and Codes.NothingToUndo or Codes.NothingToRedo
	end
	local current = self.model:get(entry.id)
	local removing = (entry.kind == "spawn" and direction == "undo") or (entry.kind == "remove" and direction == "redo")
	local creating = (entry.kind == "remove" and direction == "undo") or (entry.kind == "spawn" and direction == "redo")
	local plan, code
	if removing then
		if current == nil or not sameRecord(current, entry.record) then
			return { conflict = Codes.NotFound }
		end
		plan = planners.Delete(self, userId, { id = entry.id })
	elseif creating then
		if current ~= nil then
			return { conflict = Codes.HistoryConflict }
		end
		local _, itemCode = self:_checkCreatable(userId, entry.record.itemId)
		if itemCode then
			return { conflict = itemCode }
		end
		local t, tCode = self:_clean(entry.record.itemId, entry.record)
		if t == nil then
			return { conflict = tCode }
		end
		plan, code = self:_spawnPlan(withTransform(entry.record, t), entry.id)
	else
		local expected = direction == "undo" and entry.after or entry.before
		local target = direction == "undo" and entry.before or entry.after
		if current == nil or not sameRecord(current, expected) then
			return { conflict = Codes.NotFound }
		end
		plan, code = self:_movePlan(entry.id, current, target)
	end
	if plan == nil then
		return { conflict = code }
	end
	local history = self.history
	plan.afterCommit = function(revision)
		history:commitStep(direction, revision)
	end
	return plan
end

function planners.Undo(self, userId)
	return self:_historyPlan(userId, "undo")
end

function planners.Redo(self, userId)
	return self:_historyPlan(userId, "redo")
end

function PlacementCore:_enterRecovery(kind, token, effect)
	self.recovery = { kind = kind, token = token, effect = effect }
	-- The world may differ from what history describes.
	self.history:clear(self.revision)
	self:_log("entering recovery after failed " .. kind .. " of " .. tostring(effect and effect.kind) .. " " .. tostring(effect and effect.id))
end

-- Rolls back the pending world change. Returns a response for `code`.
function PlacementCore:_undoPending(code)
	local pending = self.pending
	self.pending = nil
	local ok, err = pcall(self.world.rollback, self.world, pending.token)
	if ok then
		return self:_reject(code)
	end
	self:_log("world rollback failed: " .. tostring(err))
	self:_enterRecovery("rollback", pending.token, pending.effect)
	local response = self:_reject(code)
	response.recoveryNeeded = true
	return response
end

-- Runs with the edit lock held. Every exit returns a response.
function PlacementCore:_locked(userId, op, payload)
	if not self:_isHost(userId) then
		return self:_reject(Codes.NotHost)
	end
	local epoch = self.hostEpoch
	if op == "Undo" or op == "Redo" then
		local valid, expected = RequestValidator.optionalRevision(rawget(payload, "expectedRevision"))
		if not valid then
			return self:_reject(Codes.BadRequest)
		end
		if expected ~= nil and expected ~= self.revision then
			return self:_reject(Codes.StaleRevision)
		end
	end
	-- History belongs to one host at one revision (host transfer, recovery or
	-- a future load invalidate it).
	self.history:sync(userId, self.revision, epoch)
	local plan, planCode = planners[op](self, userId, payload)
	if plan == nil then
		return self:_reject(planCode)
	end
	if plan.conflict then
		self.history:drop(op == "Undo" and "undo" or "redo")
		local response = self:_reject(Codes.HistoryConflict)
		response.reason = plan.conflict
		return response
	end
	if plan.noop then
		return { ok = true, id = plan.id, buildRevision = self.revision }
	end
	return self:_executePlan(userId, epoch, plan)
end

-- Shared tail for every mutation (edits, undo/redo, build loads): host + epoch
-- re-check, world apply, re-check, model commit, revision, finalize. Runs with
-- the edit lock held.
function PlacementCore:_executePlan(userId, epoch, plan)
	-- Planning dependencies may have yielded.
	if not self:_stillAuthorized(userId, epoch) then
		return self:_reject(Codes.AuthorityLost)
	end

	local applied, token = pcall(self.world.apply, self.world, plan.effect)
	if not applied then
		self:_log("world apply failed: " .. tostring(token))
		return self:_reject(Codes.ApplyFailed)
	end
	self.pending = { token = token, effect = plan.effect }

	-- world.apply may yield.
	if not self:_stillAuthorized(userId, epoch) then
		return self:_undoPending(Codes.AuthorityLost)
	end
	local committed, commitErr = pcall(plan.commit)
	if not committed then
		self:_log("model commit failed: " .. tostring(commitErr))
		return self:_undoPending(Codes.Internal)
	end
	self.pending = nil
	self.revision = self.revision + 1
	if plan.afterCommit then
		plan.afterCommit(self.revision)
	else
		self.history:record(entryFromEffect(plan.effect), self.revision)
	end

	local response = { ok = true, id = plan.id, buildRevision = self.revision }
	local finalized, finalizeErr = pcall(self.world.commit, self.world, token)
	if not finalized then
		self:_log("world finalize failed: " .. tostring(finalizeErr))
		self:_enterRecovery("finalize", token, plan.effect)
		response.recoveryNeeded = true
	end
	pcall(self.world.publishRevision, self.world, self.revision)
	return response
end

-- Deterministic reconciliation: retry the retained operation, then fall back
-- to rebuilding the world from the model. Returns true when back to ready.
function PlacementCore:recover()
	if self.state ~= RECOVERY then
		return true
	end
	if self.recovering then
		return false
	end
	self.recovering = true
	local r = self.recovery
	if r.kind == "compound" then
		return self:_recoverCompound(r)
	end
	local method = r.kind == "finalize" and self.world.commit or self.world.rollback
	local ok = pcall(method, self.world, r.token)
	if not ok and self.world.reconcile then
		local reconciled, err = pcall(self.world.reconcile, self.world, self.model:list())
		ok = reconciled
		if not reconciled then
			self:_log("world reconcile failed: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
	self.recovering = false
	if not ok then
		return false
	end
	self.recovery = nil
	self.state = READY
	pcall(self.world.publishRevision, self.world, self.revision)
	self:_log("recovered")
	return true
end

-- Compound recovery: retry the outside restore (room) and the world rollback
-- (falling back to reconcile from the unchanged model). Each part is cleared
-- once it succeeds; the state lifts only when both are done.
function PlacementCore:_recoverCompound(r)
	if r.external ~= nil then
		local called, restored = pcall(r.external)
		if called and restored ~= false then
			r.external = nil
		else
			self:_log("compound recovery: outside restore still failing")
		end
	end
	if r.token ~= nil then
		local rolledBack = pcall(self.world.rollback, self.world, r.token)
		if not rolledBack and self.world.reconcile then
			rolledBack = pcall(self.world.reconcile, self.world, self.model:list())
		end
		if rolledBack then
			r.token = nil
		end
	end
	self.recovering = false
	if r.external ~= nil or r.token ~= nil then
		return false
	end
	self.recovery = nil
	self.state = READY
	pcall(self.world.publishRevision, self.world, self.revision)
	self:_log("compound recovery complete")
	return true
end

-- True while edits and saves are refused until reconciliation.
function PlacementCore:inRecovery()
	return self.state == RECOVERY
end

-- Entry point for one BuilderRequest. Never throws for any payload.
function PlacementCore:handle(userId, payload)
	if not Validate.isPositiveInteger(userId) then
		return self:_reject(Codes.BadRequest)
	end
	self:_observeHost()
	local op, code = RequestValidator.op(payload)
	local category = op == "Status" and "status" or "edit"
	if not self.limiter:allow(userId, category) then
		return self:_respond(userId, self:_reject(Codes.RateLimited))
	end
	if op == nil then
		return self:_respond(userId, self:_reject(code))
	end
	if op == "Status" then
		return self:_respond(userId, { ok = true, buildRevision = self.revision })
	end
	return self:_respond(userId, self:_handleEdit(userId, op, payload))
end

function PlacementCore:_respond(userId, response)
	response.status = self:status(userId)
	return response
end

function PlacementCore:_handleEdit(userId, op, payload)
	return self:_exclusive(function()
		return self:_locked(userId, op, payload)
	end)
end

-- Runs body with the edit lock held; every mutation goes through here.
function PlacementCore:_exclusive(body)
	if self.state == RECOVERY and not self:recover() then
		return self:_reject(Codes.RecoveryNeeded)
	end
	if self.state ~= READY then
		return self:_reject(Codes.Busy)
	end

	self.state = BUSY
	local ok, response = pcall(body)
	if not ok then
		self:_log("edit failed: " .. tostring(response))
		if self.pending ~= nil then
			-- Unexpected error after a world change: the world state is unknown.
			self:_enterRecovery("rollback", self.pending.token, self.pending.effect)
			self.pending = nil
		end
		response = self:_reject(Codes.Internal)
		if self.recovery ~= nil then
			response.recoveryNeeded = true
		end
	end
	self.state = self.recovery ~= nil and RECOVERY or READY
	return response
end

-- Persistence (task 5) -------------------------------------------------------

local function entryOf(id, r)
	return { id = id, itemId = r.itemId, x = r.x, y = r.y, z = r.z, yaw = r.yaw }
end

-- The current build as a Build section (SaveSnapshot shape), preserved
-- entries included. Synchronous; refuses while an edit or load is in flight
-- (Busy) or the world is unreconciled (RecoveryNeeded), so a save never
-- captures a half-applied build.
function PlacementCore:captureBuild()
	if self.state == RECOVERY then
		return nil, Codes.RecoveryNeeded
	end
	if self.state ~= READY then
		return nil, Codes.Busy
	end
	local items = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(self.model:list()) do
		items[#items + 1] = entryOf(e.id, e.record)
	end
	local section = SaveSnapshot.encode({ nextId = self.model.nextId, items = items, preserved = self.preserved })
	local fits, code = SaveSnapshot.checkSize(section)
	if not fits then
		return nil, code
	end
	return section
end

-- Validates and stages a Build section without mutating anything. Entries
-- that can't be placed now (unknown/retired/uninstalled/locked item, outside
-- the current bounds) are preserved, never dropped. Returns a plan or nil, code
-- (Corrupt, UnsupportedVersion).
function PlacementCore:prepareLoad(userId, section)
	local decoded, code = SaveSnapshot.decode(section, {
		maxItems = self.config.MaxItems,
		classify = function(entry)
			local _, itemCode = self:_checkCreatable(userId, entry.itemId)
			if itemCode then
				return false
			end
			return self:_clean(entry.itemId, entry) ~= nil
		end,
	})
	if decoded == nil then
		return nil, code
	end
	local entries = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(decoded.items) do
		local t = self:_clean(e.itemId, e)
		if t == nil then
			return nil, Codes.OutOfBounds -- classify accepted it; defensive
		end
		entries[#entries + 1] = { id = e.id, record = { itemId = e.itemId, x = t.x, y = t.y, z = t.z, yaw = t.yaw } }
	end
	return { entries = entries, preserved = decoded.preserved, nextId = decoded.nextId }
end

-- Replaces the whole build with a staged plan through the same exclusive path
-- as edits: lock, host + epoch re-checks after every yield, two-phase world
-- "replace" with rollback, recovery on failed rollback/finalize. History is
-- cleared on success. expectedRevision (optional) is checked under the lock.
-- Returns { ok, code?, buildRevision }. Single-shot build-only load; compound
-- room + build loads use beginTransaction instead.
function PlacementCore:loadBuild(userId, plan, expectedRevision)
	if not Validate.isPositiveInteger(userId) or type(plan) ~= "table" then
		return self:_reject(Codes.BadRequest)
	end
	self:_observeHost()
	return self:_exclusive(function()
		if not self:_isHost(userId) then
			return self:_reject(Codes.NotHost)
		end
		if expectedRevision ~= nil and expectedRevision ~= self.revision then
			return self:_reject(Codes.StaleRevision)
		end
		local epoch = self.hostEpoch
		local previous = { entries = self.model:list() }
		local model = BuildModel.new(self.config.MaxItems)
		model:setReserved(#plan.preserved)
		for _, e in ipairs(plan.entries) do
			local r = e.record
			model:add(e.id, { itemId = r.itemId, placedByUserId = r.placedByUserId or userId, x = r.x, y = r.y, z = r.z, yaw = r.yaw })
		end
		-- IDs are never reused within a server, even across loads.
		model:reserveIdsThrough(math.max(plan.nextId, self.model.nextId) - 1)
		local core = self
		local response = self:_executePlan(userId, epoch, {
			effect = { kind = "replace", id = "*", entries = model:list(), previous = previous.entries },
			commit = function()
				core.model = model
				core.preserved = plan.preserved
			end,
			afterCommit = function(revision)
				core.history:clear(revision)
			end,
		})
		return response
	end)
end

-- Binding captured when a load is prepared: the host session and build
-- revision it was validated against.
function PlacementCore:binding()
	return { epoch = self.hostEpoch, revision = self.revision }
end

-- Compound loads (room + build) hold the edit lock for their whole duration.
-- beginTransaction refuses unless the host, host epoch and (when given) build
-- revision still match the preparation binding. The returned transaction must
-- end with exactly one commit() or rollback(); until then edits and saves get
-- Busy. Returns txn or nil, code.
local Transaction = {}
Transaction.__index = Transaction

function PlacementCore:beginTransaction(userId, binding)
	if self.state == RECOVERY and not self:recover() then
		return nil, Codes.RecoveryNeeded
	end
	if self.state ~= READY then
		return nil, Codes.Busy
	end
	-- Take the lock BEFORE any possibly-yielding authority read; release it on
	-- every refusal or error.
	self.state = BUSY
	local ok, code = pcall(function()
		self:_observeHost()
		if not self:_isHost(userId) then
			return Codes.NotHost
		end
		if type(binding) ~= "table" or binding.epoch ~= self.hostEpoch then
			return Codes.AuthorityLost
		end
		if binding.revision ~= nil and binding.revision ~= self.revision then
			return Codes.StaleRevision
		end
		return nil
	end)
	if not ok or code ~= nil then
		self.state = self.recovery ~= nil and RECOVERY or READY
		return nil, ok and code or Codes.Internal
	end
	return setmetatable({ core = self, userId = userId, epoch = self.hostEpoch, done = false }, Transaction)
end

-- Final authority check after any yield: same host and same host session.
function Transaction:stillAuthorized()
	return self.core:_stillAuthorized(self.userId, self.epoch)
end

-- Swaps the world to the staged build (two-phase; may yield). The model is
-- committed only by commit(). Returns ok, code.
function Transaction:applyBuild(plan)
	assert(not self.done and self.token == nil, "transaction already applied or ended")
	local core = self.core
	local model = BuildModel.new(core.config.MaxItems)
	model:setReserved(#plan.preserved)
	for _, e in ipairs(plan.entries) do
		local r = e.record
		model:add(e.id, { itemId = r.itemId, placedByUserId = r.placedByUserId or self.userId, x = r.x, y = r.y, z = r.z, yaw = r.yaw })
	end
	model:reserveIdsThrough(math.max(plan.nextId, core.model.nextId) - 1)
	local effect = { kind = "replace", id = "*", entries = model:list(), previous = core.model:list() }
	local ok, token = pcall(core.world.apply, core.world, effect)
	if not ok then
		core:_log("world replace failed: " .. tostring(token))
		return false, Codes.ApplyFailed
	end
	self.token, self.effect, self.model, self.preserved = token, effect, model, plan.preserved
	return true
end

function Transaction:_release()
	self.done = true
	local core = self.core
	core.state = core.recovery ~= nil and RECOVERY or READY
end

-- Commits the applied build (if any) and releases the lock. Never throws.
-- Returns { ok = true, buildRevision, recoveryNeeded? }.
function Transaction:commit()
	assert(not self.done, "transaction already ended")
	local core = self.core
	local response = { ok = true, buildRevision = core.revision }
	if self.token ~= nil then
		core.model = self.model
		core.preserved = self.preserved
		core.revision = core.revision + 1
		core.history:clear(core.revision)
		response.buildRevision = core.revision
		local finalized, err = pcall(core.world.commit, core.world, self.token)
		if not finalized then
			core:_log("world finalize failed: " .. tostring(err))
			core:_enterRecovery("finalize", self.token, self.effect)
			response.recoveryNeeded = true
		end
		pcall(core.world.publishRevision, core.world, core.revision)
	end
	self:_release()
	return response
end

-- Restores the world to the previous build (the model was never changed) and
-- releases the lock. external (optional): function() -> ok that still has to
-- restore something outside the builder (the room, when its rollback failed).
-- If the world rollback fails or external is given, the core enters a
-- "compound" recovery: edits and saves stay refused for every host until
-- recover() completes BOTH parts. Returns true only when nothing is pending.
function Transaction:rollback(external)
	assert(not self.done, "transaction already ended")
	local core = self.core
	local pendingToken = nil
	if self.token ~= nil then
		local rolledBack, err = pcall(core.world.rollback, core.world, self.token)
		if not rolledBack then
			core:_log("world rollback failed: " .. tostring(err))
			pendingToken = self.token
		end
	end
	if pendingToken ~= nil or external ~= nil then
		core.recovery = { kind = "compound", token = pendingToken, effect = self.effect, external = external }
		core.history:clear(core.revision)
		core:_log("entering compound recovery (world=" .. tostring(pendingToken ~= nil) .. ", external=" .. tostring(external ~= nil) .. ")")
	end
	self:_release()
	return core.recovery == nil
end

return PlacementCore

--[[
	PresetSlotGuard: overwrite rules for StudioPresets slot saves. Pure; used
	inside the UpdateAsync transform of the patched StudioPresets.Save
	(integration/StudioPresets.luau).

	A save into a slot is refused (nothing written) when:
	* CorruptProfile   the stored profile or its Slots table isn't a table
	                   (the unpatched code would replace the whole profile,
	                   losing all five slots);
	* NewerRecord      the slot's entry Version or snapshot (Data) Version is
	                   newer than 1;
	* InvalidRecord    the slot holds something that isn't a readable v1 entry
	                   (non-table entry, non-number Version, non-table Data or
	                   Settings);
	* NewerBuild       the slot holds a Build section from a newer version;
	* InvalidBuild     the slot holds a Build section that doesn't decode;
	* BuildWouldBeLost the new snapshot has no Build section (builder
	                   unavailable in this server) but the slot's Build has
	                   entries.
	Legacy slots (no Build) and readable same-version Builds may be replaced.

	transform() is retry-safe: UpdateAsync may call it several times with
	different `old` values. Each call recomputes the outcome from `old` alone,
	never mutates `old` or the entry, and getRefusal() reports the last call.
]]

local SaveSnapshot = require(script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Adapters"):WaitForChild("SaveSnapshot"))

local PresetSlotGuard = {}

PresetSlotGuard.Messages = {
	CorruptProfile = "Your saved studios couldn't be read, so nothing was overwritten.",
	NewerBuild = "That slot was saved by a newer version of the builder. Choose another slot.",
	NewerRecord = "That slot was saved by a newer version of the game. Choose another slot.",
	InvalidRecord = "That slot's saved data can't be read, so it wasn't overwritten. Choose another slot.",
	InvalidBuild = "That slot's build data can't be read, so it wasn't overwritten. Choose another slot.",
	BuildWouldBeLost = "The builder isn't available here, so saving would remove that slot's build. Choose another slot.",
}

-- Returns ok, reason.
function PresetSlotGuard.checkOverwrite(old, slot, entry)
	if old == nil then
		return true
	end
	if type(old) ~= "table" then
		return false, "CorruptProfile"
	end
	local slots = rawget(old, "Slots")
	if slots == nil then
		return true
	end
	if type(slots) ~= "table" then
		return false, "CorruptProfile"
	end
	local existing = slots[tostring(slot)]
	if existing == nil then
		return true -- empty slot
	end
	if type(existing) ~= "table" or type(existing.Version) ~= "number" then
		return false, "InvalidRecord"
	end
	if existing.Version > 1 then
		return false, "NewerRecord"
	end
	if existing.Version ~= 1 then
		return false, "InvalidRecord"
	end
	local data = existing.Data
	if type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.Version) ~= "number" then
		return false, "InvalidRecord"
	end
	if data.Version > 1 then
		return false, "NewerRecord"
	end
	if data.Version ~= 1 or type(data.Settings) ~= "table" then
		return false, "InvalidRecord"
	end
	local build = data[SaveSnapshot.SECTION_KEY]
	if build == nil then
		return true -- legacy slot
	end
	local decoded, code = SaveSnapshot.decode(build)
	if decoded == nil then
		return false, code == SaveSnapshot.Codes.UnsupportedVersion and "NewerBuild" or "InvalidBuild"
	end
	local newData = type(entry) == "table" and entry.Data or nil
	local newBuild = type(newData) == "table" and newData[SaveSnapshot.SECTION_KEY] or nil
	if newBuild == nil and #decoded.items + #decoded.preserved > 0 then
		return false, "BuildWouldBeLost"
	end
	return true
end

-- A new profile with slot set to entry; `old` is never mutated.
function PresetSlotGuard.withSlot(old, slot, entry)
	local profile = {}
	if type(old) == "table" then
		for k, v in pairs(old) do
			profile[k] = v
		end
	end
	local slots = {}
	if type(profile.Slots) == "table" then
		for k, v in pairs(profile.Slots) do
			slots[k] = v
		end
	end
	slots[tostring(slot)] = entry
	profile.Slots = slots
	return profile
end

-- Returns transform(old) for UpdateAsync and getRefusal() -> reason | nil.
-- transform returns nil (cancel the write) when refused.
function PresetSlotGuard.transform(slot, entry)
	local refusal = nil
	local function transform(old)
		refusal = nil
		local ok, reason = PresetSlotGuard.checkOverwrite(old, slot, entry)
		if not ok then
			refusal = reason
			return nil
		end
		return PresetSlotGuard.withSlot(old, slot, entry)
	end
	return transform, function()
		return refusal
	end
end

function PresetSlotGuard.message(reason)
	return PresetSlotGuard.Messages[reason] or "That slot couldn't be saved."
end

return PresetSlotGuard

--[[
	RateLimiter: per-key token buckets. Pure; the clock is injected.
	rules = { [category] = { capacity = n, refillPerSecond = r } }
]]

local RateLimiter = {}
RateLimiter.__index = RateLimiter

function RateLimiter.new(rules, clock)
	assert(type(rules) == "table" and type(clock) == "function", "RateLimiter.new requires rules and clock")
	return setmetatable({ rules = rules, clock = clock, buckets = {} }, RateLimiter)
end

-- Spends one token; returns false when the bucket is empty or the category unknown.
function RateLimiter:allow(key, category)
	local rule = self.rules[category]
	if rule == nil then
		return false
	end
	local now = self.clock()
	local perKey = self.buckets[key]
	if perKey == nil then
		perKey = {}
		self.buckets[key] = perKey
	end
	local bucket = perKey[category]
	if bucket == nil then
		bucket = { tokens = rule.capacity, at = now }
		perKey[category] = bucket
	end
	local elapsed = now - bucket.at
	if elapsed > 0 then
		bucket.tokens = math.min(rule.capacity, bucket.tokens + elapsed * rule.refillPerSecond)
	end
	bucket.at = now
	if bucket.tokens >= 1 then
		bucket.tokens = bucket.tokens - 1
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function RateLimiter:forget(key)
	self.buckets[key] = nil
end

return RateLimiter

--[[
	RequestValidator: strict shape checks for untrusted BuilderRequest payloads.

	Only plain tables with string keys from Protocol.OpFields are accepted.
	Instances, CFrames, colours, scales, paths or any extra field are rejected
	before any lookup happens. Pure; reads with rawget/pairs only.
]]

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("StudioBuilder")
local Config = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Config"))
local Catalog = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Catalog"))
local Protocol = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Protocol"))
local Validate = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Validate"))

local SaveSnapshot = require(script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Adapters"):WaitForChild("SaveSnapshot"))

local Codes = Protocol.Codes
local RequestValidator = {}

local MAX_FIELDS = 4
local TRANSFORM_KEYS = { x = true, y = true, z = true, yaw = true }

-- Returns op, or nil and a code. Checks the op and the exact key set.
function RequestValidator.op(payload)
	if type(payload) ~= "table" then
		return nil, Codes.BadRequest
	end
	local op = rawget(payload, "op")
	if type(op) ~= "string" or #op > 16 then
		return nil, Codes.BadRequest
	end
	local fields = rawget(Protocol.OpFields, op)
	if fields == nil then
		return nil, Codes.UnknownOp
	end
	local n = 0
	for key in pairs(payload) do
		n = n + 1
		if n > MAX_FIELDS then
			return nil, Codes.BadRequest
		end
		if key ~= "op" and (type(key) ~= "string" or rawget(fields, key) == nil) then
			return nil, Codes.BadRequest
		end
	end
	for key, required in pairs(fields) do
		if required and rawget(payload, key) == nil then
			return nil, Codes.BadRequest
		end
	end
	return op
end

function RequestValidator.catalogId(v)
	if not Validate.isBoundedString(v, Config.MaxCatalogIdLength, Catalog.ITEM_ID_PATTERN) then
		return nil, Codes.BadRequest
	end
	return v
end

function RequestValidator.buildId(v)
	if SaveSnapshot.parseBuildId(v) == nil then
		return nil, Codes.BadRequest
	end
	return v
end

-- Exactly the keys x, y, z, yaw; values are checked by Transform.sanitize.
function RequestValidator.transformShape(v)
	if type(v) ~= "table" then
		return nil, Codes.BadTransform
	end
	local n = 0
	for key in pairs(v) do
		n = n + 1
		if n > 4 or rawget(TRANSFORM_KEYS, key) == nil then
			return nil, Codes.BadTransform
		end
	end
	if n ~= 4 then
		return nil, Codes.BadTransform
	end
	return v
end

-- Optional revision the client last saw: nil, or a non-negative integer.
-- Returns ok, value.
function RequestValidator.optionalRevision(v)
	if v == nil then
		return true, nil
	end
	if not Validate.isInteger(v) or v < 0 or v > 1000000000 then
		return false
	end
	return true, v
end

-- Optional rotation direction: nil -> 1; otherwise exactly 1 or -1.
function RequestValidator.direction(v)
	if v == nil then
		return 1
	end
	if v == 1 or v == -1 then
		return v
	end
	return nil, Codes.BadRequest
end

return RequestValidator

--[[
	BuilderService: wires PlacementCore to Roblox. Studio integration pending.

	start():
	1. validates the catalog and probes ServerStorage.StudioBuilderTemplates;
	2. resolves the sandbox from the StudioBuilderSandbox marker part. With no
	   marker the builder stays disabled and every request returns Unavailable.
	   Nothing is created in, or searched for inside, the six rooms;
	3. creates Workspace.StudioBuilderPlacedItems (dedicated; BuildRevision,
	   SandboxOrigin and SandboxSize attributes for the client preview);
	4. publishes sanitized preview copies of installed templates to
	   ReplicatedStorage.StudioBuilder.PreviewTemplates for the client ghost and cards;
	5. creates Remotes.BuilderRequest (RemoteFunction) -> PlacementCore:handle.

	Host authority comes from PodcastSettings.HostUserId, checked on every edit
	and again after the world change. Never touches LayoutRevision.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("StudioBuilder")
local Config = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Config"))
local Catalog = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Catalog"))
local Protocol = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Protocol"))

local Server = script.Parent.Parent
local PlacementCore = require(Server:WaitForChild("Core"):WaitForChild("PlacementCore"))
local Adapters = Server:WaitForChild("Adapters")
local HostAuthority = require(Adapters:WaitForChild("HostAuthority"))
local Entitlements = require(Adapters:WaitForChild("Entitlements"))
local TemplateCatalog = require(Adapters:WaitForChild("TemplateCatalog"))
local RoomProvider = require(Adapters:WaitForChild("RoomProvider"))
local PlacedItemsWorld = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("PlacedItemsWorld"))
local TemplateSanitizer = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("TemplateSanitizer"))

local BuildPersistence = require(Server:WaitForChild("Core"):WaitForChild("BuildPersistence"))

local BuilderService = {}
local started = false
local core = nil

local function log(message)
	warn("[StudioBuilder] " .. message)
end

local function getOrCreate(parent, className, name)
	local existing = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing and existing:IsA(className) then
		return existing
	end
	local instance = Instance.new(className)
	instance.Name = name
	instance.Parent = parent
	return instance
end

local function curatedTemplate(itemId)
	local folder = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(Config.TemplateFolderName)
	local template = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(itemId) or nil
	if template and template:IsA("Model") then
		return template
	end
	return nil
end

local function publishPreviews(templates)
	local folder = getOrCreate(Shared, "Folder", Config.PreviewTemplatesFolderName)
	folder:ClearAllChildren()
	for _, item in ipairs(Catalog.Items) do
		local template = templates:isInstalled(item.id) and curatedTemplate(item.id) or nil
		local clone = template and template:Clone() or nil
		if clone then
			TemplateSanitizer.forPreview(clone)
			clone.Name = item.id
			clone:SetAttribute("BuildCatalogId", item.id)
			clone.Parent = folder
		end
	end
end

function BuilderService.start()
	if started then
		return
	end
	started = true

	local remotes = getOrCreate(Shared, "Folder", Config.RemotesFolderName)
	local request = getOrCreate(remotes, "RemoteFunction", Config.RequestRemoteName)
	request.OnServerInvoke = function()
		return { ok = false, code = Protocol.Codes.Unavailable }
	end

	local catalogOk, errors = Catalog.validate()
	if not catalogOk then
		log("catalog invalid, builder disabled: " .. table.concat(errors, "; "))
		return
	end

	local templates = TemplateCatalog.build(Catalog, TemplateCatalog.serverStorageProbe())
	for _, item in ipairs(Catalog.Items) do
		if not templates:isInstalled(item.id) then
			log(item.id .. " template " .. tostring(templates:status(item.id)) .. "; card shows as not installed")
		end
	end

	local sandbox, reason = RoomProvider.new({ resolve = RoomProvider.markerSource() }):resolve(nil)
	if sandbox == nil then
		log("no sandbox (" .. tostring(reason) .. "): place a " .. Config.SandboxMarkerName .. " part in Workspace; builder disabled")
		return
	end

	local placedFolder = getOrCreate(Workspace, "Folder", Config.PlacedItemsFolderName)
	placedFolder:SetAttribute(Config.BuildRevisionAttribute, 0)
	-- Read by the client preview (advisory only; the server re-validates).
	placedFolder:SetAttribute("SandboxOrigin", sandbox.origin)
	placedFolder:SetAttribute("SandboxSize", Vector3.new(sandbox.bounds.halfX * 2, sandbox.bounds.height, sandbox.bounds.halfZ * 2))
	publishPreviews(templates)

	core = PlacementCore.new({
		config = Config,
		catalog = Catalog,
		templates = {
			isInstalled = function(id)
				return templates:isInstalled(id)
			end,
			getSize = function(id)
				return templates:getSize(id)
			end,
		},
		entitlements = Entitlements.new(),
		authority = HostAuthority.new({ getHostUserId = HostAuthority.podcastSettingsSource() }),
		bounds = sandbox.bounds,
		world = PlacedItemsWorld.new(placedFolder, sandbox.origin, curatedTemplate),
		clock = os.clock,
		log = log,
	})

	request.OnServerInvoke = function(player, payload)
		local ok, response = pcall(core.handle, core, player.UserId, payload)
		if not ok then
			log("request error: " .. tostring(response))
			return { ok = false, code = Protocol.Codes.Internal }
		end
		return response
	end

	-- Host sessions: invalidate history the moment HostUserId changes (A -> B -> A included).
	local function watchSettings(settings)
		settings:GetAttributeChangedSignal("HostUserId"):Connect(function()
			core:onHostChanged()
		end)
	end
	local settings = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PodcastSettings")
	if settings then
		watchSettings(settings)
	else
		local added
		added = ReplicatedStorage.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			if child.Name == "PodcastSettings" then
				added:Disconnect()
				watchSettings(child)
				core:onHostChanged()
			end
		end)
	end

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		core.limiter:forget(player.UserId)
	end)

	-- If a rollback or finalize failed, edits stay refused (RecoveryNeeded)
	-- until reconciliation succeeds; keep retrying in the background too.
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(2)
			if core:getState() == "recovery" then
				core:recover()
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Director integration (task 5): save/load the Build section inside StudioPresets.
-- Safe to call before start(); the core is looked up on every call.
function BuilderService.getPersistence()
	return BuildPersistence.new(function()
		return core
	end)
end

-- For later tasks (save/load, UI): read-only access to the core, nil when disabled.
function BuilderService.getCore()
	return core
end

return BuilderService

--[[
	PlacedItemsWorld: applies PlacementCore effects to Instances in the
	dedicated Workspace.StudioBuilderPlacedItems folder. Studio integration pending.

	Two-phase, so PlacementCore can undo a change if the host is lost while
	it ran:
		apply(effect) -> token     visible change, reversible
		rollback(token)            undo it
		commit(token)              finalize (only removal does work here)
		reconcile(entries)         recovery fallback: rebuild the folder from the model
	* spawn:  clone the curated template, sanitize, tag, pivot, parent LAST.
	          rollback destroys the clone.
	* move:   PivotTo the new transform; rollback restores the previous pivot.
	* remove: unparent; rollback re-parents; commit destroys.
	* replace (build load): build all new models unparented first (failure
	  leaves the world untouched), then swap; rollback restores the old set;
	  commit destroys the old set.

	Streaming: every model built here (spawn, build-load replace, reconcile
	respawn) gets ModelStreamingMode = Persistent after sanitizing and before
	parenting, and reconcile re-applies it to models it keeps. This is a
	deliberate choice for the bounded 150-item sandbox prototype under
	StreamingEnabled (the build camera can be far from the avatar); the
	sandbox Model and the 7 ServerStorage templates are made persistent in
	Studio by Codex. Existing room assets keep normal streaming.

	Templates have bottom-centre pivots (verified by TemplateCatalog's probe),
	so the world pivot is origin * (x, y, z) * yaw. Each model is tagged with
	BuildItemId / BuildCatalogId / BuildPlacedByUserId. StudioCustomization must
	skip BuildItemId-tagged models (pending a live-script change, see docs/adapters.md).
]]

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("StudioBuilder"):WaitForChild("Config"))
local TemplateSanitizer = require(script.Parent.TemplateSanitizer)

local PlacedItemsWorld = {}
PlacedItemsWorld.__index = PlacedItemsWorld

-- folder: the dedicated placed-items Folder
-- origin: sandbox origin CFrame (floor centre)
-- getTemplate(itemId) -> curated template Model or nil
function PlacedItemsWorld.new(folder, origin, getTemplate)
	return setmetatable({ folder = folder, origin = origin, getTemplate = getTemplate, models = {} }, PlacedItemsWorld)
end

function PlacedItemsWorld:_cframe(record)
	return self.origin * CFrame.new(record.x, record.y, record.z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(record.yaw), 0)
end

-- Clones, sanitizes, tags and pivots a model for id/record; returns it UNPARENTED.
function PlacedItemsWorld:_build(id, record)
	local template = self.getTemplate(record.itemId)
	if template == nil then
		error("template missing for " .. record.itemId)
	end
	local model = template:Clone()
	if model == nil then
		error("template is not Archivable: " .. record.itemId)
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		TemplateSanitizer.forPlacement(model)
		model.Name = id
		model:SetAttribute(Config.BuildItemIdAttribute, id)
		model:SetAttribute("BuildCatalogId", record.itemId)
		model:SetAttribute("BuildPlacedByUserId", record.placedByUserId)
		-- Bounded prototype (<= 150 items): placed models stay streamed in
		-- regardless of avatar distance (StreamingEnabled; the build camera can
		-- be far from the avatar). Set before parenting. Existing rooms keep
		-- their normal streaming.
		model.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent
		model:PivotTo(self:_cframe(record))
	end)
	if not ok then
		model:Destroy()
		error(err, 0)
	end
	return model
end

function PlacedItemsWorld:apply(effect)
	if effect.kind == "spawn" then
		local model = self:_build(effect.id, effect.record)
		model.Parent = self.folder
		self.models[effect.id] = model
		return { kind = "spawn", id = effect.id, model = model }
	elseif effect.kind == "replace" then
		-- Build loads: build every new model first; any failure leaves the world untouched.
		local created = {}
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			for _, entry in ipairs(effect.entries) do
				created[entry.id] = self:_build(entry.id, entry.record)
			end
		end)
		if not ok then
			for _, model in pairs(created) do
				model:Destroy()
			end
			error(err, 0)
		end
		local old = self.models
		for _, model in pairs(old) do
			model.Parent = nil
		end
		for _, model in pairs(created) do
			model.Parent = self.folder
		end
		self.models = created
		return { kind = "replace", id = "*", old = old, new = created }
	elseif effect.kind == "move" then
		local model = self.models[effect.id]
		if model == nil then
			error("no placed model for " .. effect.id)
		end
		local previous = model:GetPivot()
		model:PivotTo(self:_cframe(effect.to))
		return { kind = "move", id = effect.id, model = model, previous = previous }
	elseif effect.kind == "remove" then
		local model = self.models[effect.id]
		if model == nil then
			error("no placed model for " .. effect.id)
		end
		model.Parent = nil
		return { kind = "remove", id = effect.id, model = model }
	end
	error("unknown effect kind " .. tostring(effect.kind))
end

function PlacedItemsWorld:rollback(token)
	if token.kind == "replace" then
		for _, model in pairs(token.new) do
			model:Destroy()
		end
		for _, model in pairs(token.old) do
			model.Parent = self.folder
		end
		self.models = token.old
	elseif token.kind == "spawn" then
		self.models[token.id] = nil
		token.model:Destroy()
	elseif token.kind == "move" then
		token.model:PivotTo(token.previous)
	elseif token.kind == "remove" then
		token.model.Parent = self.folder
	end
end

function PlacedItemsWorld:commit(token)
	if token.kind == "replace" then
		for _, model in pairs(token.old) do
			model:Destroy()
		end
	elseif token.kind == "remove" then
		self.models[token.id] = nil
		token.model:Destroy()
	end
end

-- Recovery fallback: make the folder match the model exactly. entries is
-- PlacementCore's model:list() ({ { id, record } }). Destroys anything not in
-- the model (including stray or detached models), respawns missing ones and
-- re-pivots the rest. Raises if any step fails, so the core stays in recovery.
function PlacedItemsWorld:reconcile(entries)
	local wanted = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
		wanted[entry.id] = entry.record
	end
	for id, model in pairs(self.models) do
		if wanted[id] == nil or model.Parent ~= self.folder then
