			self.models[id] = nil
			model:Destroy()
		end
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(self.folder:GetChildren()) do
		local id = child:GetAttribute(Config.BuildItemIdAttribute)
		if id == nil or self.models[id] ~= child then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
	for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
		local model = self.models[entry.id]
		if model then
			model.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Persistent
			model:PivotTo(self:_cframe(entry.record))
		else
			self:apply({ kind = "spawn", id = entry.id, record = entry.record })
		end
	end
end

function PlacedItemsWorld:publishRevision(revision)
	self.folder:SetAttribute(Config.BuildRevisionAttribute, revision)
end

return PlacedItemsWorld

--[[
	TemplateSanitizer: makes clones of curated templates safe to place or preview.

	The curated templates are audited (no code, Seats disabled), but clones
	are sanitized again so legacy behaviour can never ride along:
	* removes all code (LuaSourceContainer) and legacy interaction objects
	  (ClickDetector, ProximityPrompt, DragDetector, remotes, bindables);
	* disables Seat / VehicleSeat (decorative furniture is not a participant
	  seat until the seat-anchor adapter exists) and turns off their touch;
	* anchors every BasePart.
	Previews additionally lose collision, query, touch, shadows, sounds,
	lights and particle effects.

	Uses only GetDescendants / IsA / Destroy and property writes, so tests can
	drive it with fake instances. Returns counts of what was changed.
]]

local TemplateSanitizer = {}

local REMOVE_ALWAYS = {
	"LuaSourceContainer",
	"ClickDetector",
	"ProximityPrompt",
	"DragDetector",
	"RemoteEvent",
	"UnreliableRemoteEvent",
	"RemoteFunction",
	"BindableEvent",
	"BindableFunction",
}

local REMOVE_FOR_PREVIEW = { "Sound", "Light", "ParticleEmitter", "Fire", "Smoke", "Sparkles", "Beam", "Trail" }

local function isAny(instance, classNames)
	for _, className in ipairs(classNames) do
		if instance:IsA(className) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function sanitize(model, preview)
	local counts = { removed = 0, seatsDisabled = 0, parts = 0 }
	for _, d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if isAny(d, REMOVE_ALWAYS) or (preview and isAny(d, REMOVE_FOR_PREVIEW)) then
			d:Destroy()
			counts.removed = counts.removed + 1
		elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
			counts.parts = counts.parts + 1
			d.Anchored = true
			if d:IsA("Seat") or d:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
				d.Disabled = true
				d.CanTouch = false
				counts.seatsDisabled = counts.seatsDisabled + 1
			end
			if preview then
				d.CanCollide = false
				d.CanQuery = false
				d.CanTouch = false
				d.CastShadow = false
			end
		end
	end
	return counts
end

function TemplateSanitizer.forPlacement(model)
	return sanitize(model, false)
end

function TemplateSanitizer.forPreview(model)
	return sanitize(model, true)
end

return TemplateSanitizer

-- Named presets persist across servers; immutable share codes are explicitly created by the host.
--[[
	STUDIO BUILDER PATCH (task 5) — replaces ServerScriptService.StudioPresets.
	Based on the live source read 2026-10-25. Only M.Save changed:
	* the UpdateAsync transform comes from StudioBuilder's PresetSlotGuard: it
	  refuses (writes nothing) to overwrite a corrupt profile, a slot whose
	  Build section is newer or unreadable, or a slot whose Build would be
	  dropped by a snapshot without one; it is pure and retry-safe, never
	  mutates `old`, and reports the refusal of the last invocation;
	* a refusal raises a visible error (with a position prefix so the
	  Director's existing ":%d+: (.+)$" extraction shows the message).
	List, Load, Share, LoadCode, the 5 slots, the 250000-byte cap, the
	DataStore name, keys and entry Version 1 are unchanged. Not run against
	a real DataStore in this environment.
]]
local M={}
local function store() return game:GetService("DataStoreService"):GetDataStore("PodcastStudioPresets_v1") end
local Http=game:GetService("HttpService")
local Text=game:GetService("TextService")
local SlotGuard=require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):WaitForChild("StudioBuilder"):WaitForChild("Core"):WaitForChild("PresetSlotGuard"))
local function cleanName(value,userId)
 if type(value)~="string" then return nil end
 value=value:gsub("[%c]"," "):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
 local n=utf8.len(value);if not n or n<1 or n>32 then return nil end
 return Text:FilterStringAsync(value,userId,Enum.TextFilterContext.PublicChat):GetNonChatStringForBroadcastAsync()
end
local function validSlot(slot) return type(slot)=="number" and slot%1==0 and slot>=1 and slot<=5 end
local function key(userId) return "user:"..userId end
function M.List(userId)
 local profile=store():GetAsync(key(userId)) or {Slots={}}
 local result={}
 for i=1,5 do local entry=profile.Slots and profile.Slots[tostring(i)];result[i]=entry and {Name=entry.Name,Scene=entry.Data.Settings.SceneSet,Updated=entry.Updated} or {Name="Empty slot"} end
 return result
end
function M.Save(userId,slot,name,snapshot)
 assert(validSlot(slot),"Choose a slot from 1 to 5.")
 name=cleanName(name,userId);assert(name,"Use a preset name with 1–32 characters.")
 assert(#Http:JSONEncode(snapshot)<250000,"This preset is too large.")
 local entry={Name=name,Data=snapshot,Owner=userId,Updated=os.time(),Version=1}
 -- BUILDER PATCH: guarded, retry-safe transform (was: mutate old and return it).
 local transform,refusal=SlotGuard.transform(slot,entry)
 store():UpdateAsync(key(userId),transform)
 if refusal() then error(SlotGuard.message(refusal())) end
 return name
end
function M.Load(userId,slot)
 assert(validSlot(slot),"Choose a slot from 1 to 5.")
 local profile=store():GetAsync(key(userId));local entry=profile and profile.Slots and profile.Slots[tostring(slot)]
 assert(entry and entry.Version==1,"That save slot is empty.")
 return entry
end
function M.Share(userId,slot)
 local entry=M.Load(userId,slot)
 local code=Http:GenerateGUID(false):gsub("-",""):sub(1,16):upper()
 store():UpdateAsync("share:"..code,function(old) assert(old==nil,"Please retry creating a share code.");return entry end)
 return code
end
function M.LoadCode(code)
 assert(type(code)=="string","Enter a share code.")
 code=code:gsub("%s",""):upper();assert(#code==16 and code:match("^%x+$"),"Use a 16-character share code.")
 local entry=store():GetAsync("share:"..code);assert(entry and entry.Version==1,"Share code not found.")
 return entry
end
return M

local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")

local tracked={}
local function restore(entry)
 for _,joint in entry.Joints do if joint.Applied and joint.Motor.Parent then joint.Motor.Transform=joint.BaseTransform end; joint.Applied=false end
end
local function track(player,character)
 local previous=tracked[player];if previous then restore(previous);if previous.Connection then previous.Connection:Disconnect() end end
 local humanoid=character:WaitForChild("Humanoid",10);if not humanoid then return end
 character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart",10)
 local joints={}
 local function addJoint(d)
  if (d:IsA("Motor6D") or d:IsA("AnimationConstraint")) and ({Root=true,Waist=true,RootJoint=true,Neck=true,RightShoulder=true,LeftShoulder=true,RightElbow=true,LeftElbow=true,["Right Shoulder"]=true,["Left Shoulder"]=true})[d.Name] then
   if not joints[d.Name] then joints[d.Name]={Motor=d,BaseTransform=d.Transform,Offset=CFrame.identity,Applied=false} end
  end
 end
 local connection=character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)task.defer(addJoint,d)end)
 for _,d in character:GetDescendants() do addJoint(d) end
 tracked[player]={Character=character,Humanoid=humanoid,Joints=joints,Connection=connection,WasSeated=false,R15=humanoid.RigType==Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15}
end
local function added(player)
 player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)task.spawn(track,player,c)end)
 player.CharacterAppearanceLoaded:Connect(function(c)task.spawn(track,player,c)end)
 if player.Character then task.spawn(track,player,player.Character)end
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(added);for _,p in Players:GetPlayers() do added(p)end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)local e=tracked[p];if e then restore(e);if e.Connection then e.Connection:Disconnect() end end;tracked[p]=nil end)
local function angle(x,y,z) return CFrame.Angles(math.rad(x or 0),math.rad(y or 0),math.rad(z or 0)) end
-- Remove our previous offset before the Animator evaluates the next frame.
RunService.PreAnimation:Connect(function() for _,e in tracked do restore(e) end end)
RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
 local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
 for player,e in tracked do
  local seated=e.Humanoid.Health>0 and e.Humanoid.SeatPart and e.Humanoid.SeatPart:IsDescendantOf(seats)
  if seated then
   e.WasSeated=true
   local pose=player:GetAttribute("PodcastSeatedPose") or "Natural"
   local target={};local breath=math.sin(now*1.5)*.7;local sway=math.sin(now*2.1)
   local torso=e.R15 and "Waist" or "RootJoint"
   local right=e.R15 and "RightShoulder" or "Right Shoulder"
   local left=e.R15 and "LeftShoulder" or "Left Shoulder"
   if pose=="Relaxed" then target[torso]=angle(-7+breath,0,-3);target.Neck=angle(3,3,2);target[right]=e.R15 and angle(-8,0,8) or angle(0,0,8)
   elseif pose=="Lean" then target[torso]=angle(10+breath,0,0);target.Neck=angle(-7,0,0);target[right]=e.R15 and angle(-25,0,4) or angle(0,0,-25);target[left]=e.R15 and angle(-25,0,-4) or angle(0,0,25)
   elseif pose=="CouchSide" then
    target[e.R15 and "Root" or "RootJoint"]=angle(0,22,0)
    if e.R15 then target.Waist=angle(-4+breath,-5,-3) end
    target.Neck=angle(4,-15,2)
    target[right]=e.R15 and angle(-14,0,12) or angle(0,0,12)
    target[left]=e.R15 and angle(-12,0,-8) or angle(0,0,-8)
    target.RightElbow=angle(-25,0,0);target.LeftElbow=angle(-20,0,0)
   elseif pose=="CouchRecline" then
    target[torso]=angle(-13+breath,0,-3);target.Neck=angle(9,0,2)
    target[right]=e.R15 and angle(-5,0,15) or angle(0,0,15)
    target[left]=e.R15 and angle(-5,0,-15) or angle(0,0,-15)
    target.RightElbow=angle(-18,0,0);target.LeftElbow=angle(-18,0,0)
   elseif pose=="Thinking" then target[torso]=angle(3,0,2);target.Neck=angle(3,-8,-4);target[right]=e.R15 and angle(-38,-15,18) or angle(0,-15,-62);target.RightElbow=angle(-105,0,0)
   elseif pose=="Talking" then target[torso]=angle(2+breath,sway*2,0);target.Neck=angle(math.sin(now*2.7)*2,0,0);target[right]=e.R15 and angle(-24+sway*10,0,12) or angle(0,0,-24+sway*10);target.LeftElbow=angle(-18-sway*8,0,0);target.RightElbow=angle(-42-sway*12,0,0)
   end
   local waveAge=now-(player:GetAttribute("PodcastWaveAt") or 0)
   if waveAge>=0 and waveAge<2.2 then
    local envelope=math.min(1,waveAge/.25,(2.2-waveAge)/.3)
    target[right]=e.R15 and angle(-95*envelope,0,(35+math.sin(waveAge*12)*12)*envelope) or angle(0,0,(-120+math.sin(waveAge*12)*12)*envelope)
    target.RightElbow=angle(-55*envelope,0,0)
   end
   local alpha=1-math.exp(-math.min(dt,.1)*9)
   for name,joint in e.Joints do
    joint.Offset=joint.Offset:Lerp(target[name] or CFrame.identity,alpha)
    if joint.Motor.Parent then joint.BaseTransform=joint.Motor.Transform;joint.Motor.Transform=joint.BaseTransform*joint.Offset;joint.Applied=true end
   end
  elseif e.WasSeated then
   restore(e);for _,j in e.Joints do j.Offset=CFrame.identity end;e.WasSeated=false
  end
 end
end)

-- Local, opt-in speaker camera. Reads volume only; creates no audio output or recording.
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local gui=player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("PodcastCameraUI")
local control=gui:WaitForChild("StudioCameraControl")
local seats=workspace:WaitForChild("PodcastStudio"):WaitForChild("Seats")
local meters={}
local enabled=false
local threshold=.035
local hold=3
local silenceDelay=6
local candidate,candidateSince,lastSwitch,lastVoice=nil,0,0,0
local scans=0
local function clear()
 for _,entry in meters do entry.Analyzer:Destroy() end
 table.clear(meters)
end
local function scan()
 for p,entry in meters do
  if not p.Parent or not entry.Input.Parent then entry.Analyzer:Destroy();meters[p]=nil end
 end
 for _,p in Players:GetPlayers() do
  if not meters[p] then
   local input=p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AudioDeviceInput",true)
   if input then
    local analyzer=Instance.new("AudioAnalyzer");analyzer.Name="PodcastVoiceLevel";analyzer.SpectrumEnabled=false;analyzer.Parent=gui
    local wire=Instance.new("Wire");wire.SourceInstance=input;wire.TargetInstance=analyzer;wire.Parent=analyzer
    meters[p]={Input=input,Analyzer=analyzer,Level=0}
   end
  end
 end
end
gui:SetAttribute("AutoSpeaker",false)
gui:SetAttribute("VoiceThreshold",threshold)
gui:SetAttribute("SpeakerHold",hold)
gui:SetAttribute("SilenceDelay",silenceDelay)
gui:SetAttribute("VoiceStatus","Off — choose a camera manually.")
control.Event:Connect(function(action,value)
 if action=="AutoSpeaker" then
  enabled=value==true;gui:SetAttribute(action,enabled)
  candidate=nil;lastSwitch=0;lastVoice=os.clock()
  if enabled then scan() else clear();gui:SetAttribute("VoiceStatus","Off — choose a camera manually.") end
 elseif action=="VoiceThreshold" and type(value)=="number" then threshold=math.clamp(value,.005,.15);gui:SetAttribute(action,threshold)
 elseif action=="SpeakerHold" and type(value)=="number" then hold=math.clamp(value,1,8);gui:SetAttribute(action,hold)
 elseif action=="SilenceDelay" and type(value)=="number" then silenceDelay=math.clamp(value,3,15);gui:SetAttribute(action,silenceDelay)
 elseif action=="Reset" then enabled=false;clear();gui:SetAttribute("AutoSpeaker",false);gui:SetAttribute("VoiceStatus","Off — choose a camera manually.") end
end)
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
 if not enabled then return end
 scans+=dt
 if scans>=1 then scans=0;scan() end
 local now=os.clock()
 local best,bestLevel=nil,threshold
 local count=0
 for p,entry in meters do
  count+=1
  entry.Level+=(entry.Analyzer.RmsLevel-entry.Level)*(1-math.exp(-dt*10))
  local character=p.Character
  local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local seat=humanoid and humanoid.SeatPart
  if seat and seat.Parent==seats and seat:GetAttribute("Active")~=false and not entry.Input.Muted then
   local id=tonumber(seat.Name:match("Seat(%d)"))
   local bias=gui:GetAttribute("SelectedShot")==id and 1.25 or 1
   if entry.Level*bias>bestLevel then best=id;bestLevel=entry.Level*bias end
  end
 end
 if count==0 then gui:SetAttribute("VoiceStatus","No voice input yet. Join a voice-enabled server to use this.");return end
 if (gui:GetAttribute("SelectedShot") or 0)<0 then gui:SetAttribute("VoiceStatus","Paused while walking.");return end
 if now<(gui:GetAttribute("ManualCameraUntil") or 0) then gui:SetAttribute("VoiceStatus","Manual camera override — auto resumes shortly.");return end
 if best then
  lastVoice=now
  if candidate~=best then candidate=best;candidateSince=now end
  gui:SetAttribute("VoiceStatus","Listening: "..(seats["Seat"..best]:GetAttribute("DisplayName") or "guest"))
  if now-candidateSince>=.45 and now-lastSwitch>=hold and gui:GetAttribute("SelectedShot")~=best then
   control:Fire("AutoShot",best);lastSwitch=now
  end
 else
  candidate=nil;gui:SetAttribute("VoiceStatus","Listening for a seated speaker…")
  if now-lastVoice>=silenceDelay and now-lastSwitch>=hold and gui:GetAttribute("SelectedShot")~=0 then control:Fire("AutoShot",0);lastSwitch=now end
 end
end)

local function slider(parent,key,title,minimum,maximum,step,format,personal)
 local r=row(parent,key,65)
 text(r,title,UDim2.fromOffset(3,0),UDim2.new(.68,0,0,24),12)
 local valueLabel=text(r,"",UDim2.new(.68,0,0,0),UDim2.new(.32,-3,0,24),12,C.teal); valueLabel.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
 local minus=button(r,"Minus","−",UDim2.fromOffset(2,29),UDim2.fromOffset(30,29))
 local plus=button(r,"Plus","+",UDim2.new(1,-32,0,29),UDim2.fromOffset(30,29))
 local hit=new("TextButton",{Name="Track",Position=UDim2.fromOffset(43,28),Size=UDim2.new(1,-86,0,31),Text="",BackgroundTransparency=1,AutoButtonColor=false},r)
 local track=new("Frame",{Position=UDim2.new(0,0,.5,-3),Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,6),BackgroundColor3=C.card,BorderSizePixel=0},hit); round(track,3)
 local fill=new("Frame",{Size=UDim2.new(.5,0,1,0),BackgroundColor3=C.teal,BorderSizePixel=0},track); round(fill,3)
 local thumb=new("Frame",{AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5),Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,.5,0),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(15,15),BackgroundColor3=C.white,BorderSizePixel=0},track); round(thumb,8)
 local currentValue=minimum
 local dragging=false
 local touch
 local queued
 local sending=false
 local function readValue()
  local source=personal and cameraUI or settings
  local value=source:GetAttribute(key)
  return type(value)=="number" and value or minimum
 end
 local function paint(value)
  currentValue=math.clamp(value,minimum,maximum)
  local fraction=(currentValue-minimum)/(maximum-minimum)
  fill.Size=UDim2.new(fraction,0,1,0)
  thumb.Position=UDim2.new(fraction,0,.5,0)
  valueLabel.Text=format and format(currentValue) or string.format("%.2f",currentValue)
 end
 local function reconcile()
  if not dragging and not sending then paint(readValue()) end
 end
 local function commit(value)
  if personal then cameraControl:Fire(key,value) else send("Set",key,value) end
 end
 local function change(value)
  if not personal and not isHost then
   notice("Only the host can adjust shared lighting.",false)
   paint(readValue())
   return
  end
  value=math.clamp(math.floor((value-minimum)/step+.5)*step+minimum,minimum,maximum)
  paint(value)
  queued={Value=value,Generation=sharedEditGeneration}
  if sending then return end
  sending=true
  task.spawn(function()
   while queued~=nil do
    local nextEdit=queued
    queued=nil
    if personal or nextEdit.Generation==sharedEditGeneration then commit(nextEdit.Value) end
    task.wait(.14)
   end
   sending=false
   reconcile()
  end)
 end
 if not personal then
  table.insert(sharedSliderCancels,function()
   dragging=false
   touch=nil
   queued=nil
   -- An existing worker finishes its wait, then reconciles to the latest server state.
   reconcile()
  end)
 end
 local function pointer(x)
  if hit.AbsoluteSize.X<=0 then return end
  change(minimum+math.clamp((x-hit.AbsolutePosition.X)/hit.AbsoluteSize.X,0,1)*(maximum-minimum))
 end
 hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
  if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
   if not personal and not isHost then notice("Only the host can adjust shared lighting.",false); return end
   dragging=true
   touch=input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input or nil
   pointer(input.Position.X)
  end
 end)
 UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
  if dragging and ((touch and input==touch) or (not touch and input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement)) then pointer(input.Position.X) end
 end)
 UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
  if dragging and ((touch and input==touch) or (not touch and input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)) then
   dragging=false
   touch=nil
   change(currentValue)
  end
 end)
 minus.Activated:Connect(function() change(currentValue-step) end)
 plus.Activated:Connect(function() change(currentValue+step) end)
 watch(reconcile)
end

--[[
	BuildModeHandoff: enters and leaves build mode through injected hooks.

	The live owners (PodcastCamera, the host drawer, host hotkeys, world click
	handlers) are reached only through hooks, one per slot:

		hook = { enter = function(context) ... end, exit = function() ... end }

	Slots, entered in this order and exited in reverse:
		camera              PodcastCamera hands the camera to build mode and takes
		                    it back (see PodcastCameraHook). The builder never sets
		                    the camera itself.
		hostControls        suppress 1-5, V, F, auto-shot and seat controls. Must
		                    leave E/Q (free-camera vertical), Escape and
		                    right-mouse cursor release working.
		hostDrawer          hide the host drawer, show it again on exit.
		worldClickHandlers  disable existing world item/light click handlers.

	Required slots (default: camera, hostControls) must be bound, otherwise
	enter() refuses, so the builder never fights PodcastCamera for the camera.

	State machine: inactive -> entering -> active -> exiting -> inactive.
	Hooks may yield. Rules:
	* A hook is recorded as a cleanup handle BEFORE its enter runs, so a hook
	  that applied part of its change and then errored is still exited. Exit
	  hooks must therefore be safe after a partial or failed enter.
	* enter() refuses (reason "Busy") while entering or exiting; it is
	  idempotent while active.
	* exit() during a yielded enter cancels it: it returns ok=true with
	  pending=true, and the entering thread rolls back every attempted hook as
	  soon as the yielded hook returns. Cancellation is checked after every hook.
	* exit() during exiting is a no-op (pending=true).
	* If an exit hook fails, its handle is kept: hasPendingCleanup() is true,
	  enter() refuses ("CleanupPending"), and the next exit() retries only the
	  failed hooks (the hook objects that were entered, even if rebound since).

	`context` is an opaque table supplied by the builder controller and passed
	through untouched. options.onStateChanged(state) is called on every change.
]]

local BuildModeHandoff = {}
BuildModeHandoff.__index = BuildModeHandoff

BuildModeHandoff.SLOTS = { "camera", "hostControls", "hostDrawer", "worldClickHandlers" }
BuildModeHandoff.DEFAULT_REQUIRED = { "camera", "hostControls" }

local INACTIVE, ENTERING, ACTIVE, EXITING = "inactive", "entering", "active", "exiting"
BuildModeHandoff.States = { Inactive = INACTIVE, Entering = ENTERING, Active = ACTIVE, Exiting = EXITING }

-- Inputs the hostControls hook suppresses while building (contract, 2026-10-25).
BuildModeHandoff.SUPPRESSED_HOST_INPUTS = { "One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five", "V", "F", "AutoShot", "SeatControls" }
-- Inputs that must keep working; the builder must not bind them. Escape is the
-- one the builder may listen to (never sink) to cancel placement.
BuildModeHandoff.PRESERVED_HOST_INPUTS = { "E", "Q", "Escape", "MouseButton2" }
BuildModeHandoff.LISTEN_ONLY_INPUTS = { Escape = true }

local VALID_SLOTS = {}
for _, slot in ipairs(BuildModeHandoff.SLOTS) do
	VALID_SLOTS[slot] = true
end

local function checkHook(slot, hook)
	assert(VALID_SLOTS[slot], "unknown build-mode slot: " .. tostring(slot))
	assert(type(hook) == "table" and type(hook.enter) == "function" and type(hook.exit) == "function", "hook for " .. slot .. " needs enter and exit functions")
end

-- options.hooks: { [slot] = hook } (optional)
-- options.required: list of slots that must be bound (optional)
-- options.onStateChanged: function(state) (optional)
function BuildModeHandoff.new(options)
	options = options or {}
	local self = setmetatable({
		hooks = {},
		required = options.required or BuildModeHandoff.DEFAULT_REQUIRED,
		onStateChanged = options.onStateChanged,
		state = INACTIVE,
		generation = 0,
		handles = {}, -- { slot, hook } entered or attempted and not yet cleaned up, in entry order
	}, BuildModeHandoff)
	for _, slot in ipairs(self.required) do
		assert(VALID_SLOTS[slot], "unknown required slot: " .. tostring(slot))
	end
	if options.hooks then
		for slot, hook in pairs(options.hooks) do
			self:bind(slot, hook)
		end
	end
	return self
end

function BuildModeHandoff:_setState(state)
	self.state = state
	if self.onStateChanged then
		pcall(self.onStateChanged, state)
	end
end

-- Bind or replace a hook; only allowed while inactive. Pending cleanup handles
-- keep the hook they entered with.
function BuildModeHandoff:bind(slot, hook)
	assert(self.state == INACTIVE, "cannot rebind hooks while build mode is " .. self.state)
	checkHook(slot, hook)
	self.hooks[slot] = hook
end

-- { [slot] = "bound" | "unbound" }
function BuildModeHandoff:describe()
	local out = {}
	for _, slot in ipairs(BuildModeHandoff.SLOTS) do
		out[slot] = self.hooks[slot] and "bound" or "unbound"
	end
	return out
end

function BuildModeHandoff:getState()
	return self.state
end

function BuildModeHandoff:isActive()
	return self.state == ACTIVE
end

function BuildModeHandoff:hasPendingCleanup()
	return #self.handles > 0
end

-- Runs exit for every handle in reverse order (may yield). Keeps the handles
-- whose exit failed, in entry order. Returns the failures.
function BuildModeHandoff:_cleanup()
	local handles = self.handles
	self.handles = {}
	local failures, kept = {}, {}
	for i = #handles, 1, -1 do
		local handle = handles[i]
		local ok, err = pcall(handle.hook.exit)
		if not ok then
			failures[#failures + 1] = { slot = handle.slot, reason = "ExitFailed", detail = tostring(err) }
			table.insert(kept, 1, handle)
		end
	end
	-- Handles recorded while this cleanup yielded cannot exist (enter refuses
	-- while exiting), so replacing the list is safe.
	self.handles = kept
	return failures
end

local function append(list, items)
	for _, item in ipairs(items) do
		list[#list + 1] = item
	end
	return list
end

-- Returns ok, failures ({ slot?, reason, detail? } list).
function BuildModeHandoff:enter(context)
	if self.state == ACTIVE then
		return true, {}
	end
	if self.state ~= INACTIVE then
		return false, { { reason = "Busy", state = self.state } }
	end
	if #self.handles > 0 then
		return false, { { reason = "CleanupPending" } }
	end
	for _, slot in ipairs(self.required) do
		if self.hooks[slot] == nil then
			return false, { { slot = slot, reason = "Unbound" } }
		end
	end

	self.generation = self.generation + 1
	local generation = self.generation
	self:_setState(ENTERING)

	for _, slot in ipairs(BuildModeHandoff.SLOTS) do
		local hook = self.hooks[slot]
		if hook then
			self.handles[#self.handles + 1] = { slot = slot, hook = hook }
			local ok, err = pcall(hook.enter, context)
			if self.generation ~= generation then
				-- exit() was requested while this hook yielded: roll back everything.
				local failures = append({ { slot = slot, reason = "Cancelled" } }, self:_cleanup())
				self:_setState(INACTIVE)
				return false, failures
			end
			if not ok then
				self:_setState(EXITING)
				local failures = append({ { slot = slot, reason = "EnterFailed", detail = tostring(err) } }, self:_cleanup())
				self:_setState(INACTIVE)
				return false, failures
			end
		end
	end

	self:_setState(ACTIVE)
	return true, {}
end

-- Returns ok, failures, pending. pending=true means cleanup is still running in
-- another thread (a yielded enter being cancelled, or an exit in progress).
-- Also retries pending cleanup when inactive.
function BuildModeHandoff:exit()
	if self.state == ENTERING then
		self.generation = self.generation + 1
		self:_setState(EXITING)
		return true, {}, true
	end
	if self.state == EXITING then
		return true, {}, true
	end
	if self.state == INACTIVE and #self.handles == 0 then
		return true, {}, false
	end
	self.generation = self.generation + 1
	self:_setState(EXITING)
	local failures = self:_cleanup()
	self:_setState(INACTIVE)
	return #failures == 0, failures, false
end

-- Builder keys that collide with host inputs it must suppress or preserve.
function BuildModeHandoff.conflictingKeys(builderKeys)
	local reserved = {}
	for _, key in ipairs(BuildModeHandoff.SUPPRESSED_HOST_INPUTS) do
		reserved[key] = true
	end
	for _, key in ipairs(BuildModeHandoff.PRESERVED_HOST_INPUTS) do
		if not BuildModeHandoff.LISTEN_ONLY_INPUTS[key] then
			reserved[key] = true
		end
	end
	local conflicts = {}
	for _, key in ipairs(builderKeys) do
		if reserved[key] then
			conflicts[#conflicts + 1] = key
		end
	end
	return conflicts
end

return BuildModeHandoff

--[[
	PodcastCameraHook: the `camera` slot for BuildModeHandoff, built on the
	verified PodcastCamera contract (read-only inspection, 2026-10-25):

		PlayerGui.PodcastCameraUI.StudioCameraControl  (BindableEvent, local only)
			control:Fire("FreeCamera", true)   selects free camera (SelectedShot -2)
			control:Fire("FreeCamera", false)  selects Wide (0)
			control:Fire("Shot", 0..4)         0 Wide, 1 Host, 2..4 Guests
			control:Fire("POV", true)          POV on the current positive seat
		Readback attributes on PodcastCameraUI: SelectedShot, FreeCamera, POV.

	Build mode reuses PodcastCamera's own free camera (WASD, Q/E, right-drag
	look), so the builder never adds a second camera CFrame writer. SelectedShot
	< 0 already pauses PodcastSpeakerFollow's automatic cuts. There is no
	BuildMode/ownership API in PodcastCamera yet: shot keys 1-5/V/F still work
	until the hostControls gate exists (see docs/adapters.md).

	On exit the previous view is restored: free camera stays free, a seat shot
	(1..4) is reselected, POV is re-enabled if it was on, and anything else
	(Wide, Walk, unknown) returns to Wide. Walk is deliberately not re-entered,
	because entering Walk fires PodcastSeatRequest("Leave").
]]

local PodcastCameraHook = {}

local function isShot(v)
	return type(v) == "number" and v == math.floor(v) and v >= 1 and v <= 4
end

-- options.fire(action, value)  sends one StudioCameraControl action
-- options.readState() -> { SelectedShot, FreeCamera, POV } (may error; treated as unknown)
-- Returns a hook { enter(context), exit() }.
function PodcastCameraHook.new(options)
	assert(type(options) == "table" and type(options.fire) == "function" and type(options.readState) == "function", "PodcastCameraHook.new requires fire and readState")
	local fire, readState = options.fire, options.readState
	local saved = nil

	local hook = {}

	function hook.enter()
		local ok, state = pcall(readState)
		if not ok or type(state) ~= "table" then
			state = {}
		end
		saved = { selectedShot = state.SelectedShot, freeCamera = state.FreeCamera == true, pov = state.POV == true }
		fire("FreeCamera", true)
	end

	function hook.exit()
		local s = saved
		saved = nil
		if s == nil or s.freeCamera then
			return
		end
		fire("FreeCamera", false) -- back to Wide
		if isShot(s.selectedShot) then
			fire("Shot", s.selectedShot)
			if s.pov then
				fire("POV", true)
			end
		end
	end

	return hook
end

-- Live default (Studio integration pending). Returns nil if the control is
-- missing or not a BindableEvent, so BuildModeHandoff refuses to enter.
function PodcastCameraHook.fromLocalPlayer(timeoutSeconds)
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	local gui = playerGui:WaitForChild("PodcastCameraUI", timeoutSeconds or 10)
	local control = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("StudioCameraControl")
	if control == nil or not control:IsA("BindableEvent") then
		return nil
	end
	return PodcastCameraHook.new({
		fire = function(action, value)
			control:Fire(action, value)
		end,
		readState = function()
			return {
				SelectedShot = gui:GetAttribute("SelectedShot"),
				FreeCamera = gui:GetAttribute("FreeCamera"),
				POV = gui:GetAttribute("POV"),
			}
		end,
	})
end

return PodcastCameraHook

--[[
	BuildController: client build-mode behaviour, independent of Roblox so its
	asynchronous paths can be tested. BuilderClient supplies `env` (Roblox
	bindings) and forwards signals; every env call may yield.

	env = {
		config, catalog,
		request(payload) -> response,               -- RemoteFunction invoke (yields)
		handoff,                                    -- BuildModeHandoff instance
		readSandbox() -> { origin, bounds } | nil,
		isHost() -> boolean,
		createDrawer(callbacks) -> drawer,          -- BuildDrawer
		previewTemplate(itemId) -> template | nil,  -- prepared PreviewTemplates
		itemSize(itemId) -> { x, y, z } | nil,
		createGhost(itemId) -> { catalogId, show(transform, valid), destroy() } | nil,
		raycast(pointer, excludeId) -> { x, y, z, upDot } | nil,  -- sandbox local
		pickPlaced(pointer) -> id | nil,
		selectedInfo(id) -> { catalogId, yaw } | nil,
		mouseLocation() -> pointer,
		setSelectionHighlight(id | nil),
		panel = { getPosition() -> x, y, onClosed(info) },  -- optional
		spawn(fn), wait(seconds),
	}

	Async rules (review of 3d6519f):
	* generation: bumped on every open and close. Every yielding request
	  captures it and discards its result if it changed, so a response that
	  arrives after close (or after close + reopen) can never revive or
	  overwrite a session. Stale status revisions are ignored by BuildSession.
	* opening is tracked separately from open. close(), host change, room
	  switch and respawn during a yielding handoff:enter cancel the open: the
	  handoff is exited, no drawer is created, open() returns "Cancelled".
	* A failed handoff exit keeps its cleanup handle; it is reported to the
	  panel, retried in the background and on every close()/open(), and open()
	  refuses with "CleanupPending" until it succeeds. Failed cleanup means an
	  INACTIVE handoff that still holds handles (an active handoff's handles
	  are not failed cleanup). Background workers are scoped to a cleanup
	  generation: a successful cleanup, a newer worker or a new open
	  invalidates older ones, and every wake re-checks generation and that
	  nothing is open or opening before touching the handoff.
	* The ghost tracks its catalog ID and is replaced when the chosen item
	  changes; a placement only uses a preview computed for the current item.
	* intent: bumped by every same-session change of intent (choose, move,
	  cancel, preview rotate, select). An edit response that arrives after
	  the intent changed still updates status/undo/redo/revision/pause, but
	  never mode, selection or the chosen item (a pending Place of A cannot
	  wipe a newer choice of B).
	* open() stays "opening" until every yield is over (handoff enter,
	  createDrawer, panel.getPosition) and keeps the drawer local until the
	  generation check passes; a cancelled open destroys only its own drawer
	  and never touches a newer session.
	* The active input method (mouse or touch) is tracked per input, not by
	  device capability: touch taps preview and confirm with Place here, mouse
	  clicks confirm, and mouse polling never overwrites a touched point.
	* Pointer presses inside the drawer never reach the world, whatever
	  gameProcessed says.
]]

local BuildSession = require(script.Parent.BuildSession)
local PlacementPreview = require(script.Parent.PlacementPreview)

local BuildController = {}
BuildController.__index = BuildController

local RETRY_SECONDS = 2

function BuildController.new(env)
	local self = setmetatable({
		env = env,
		session = BuildSession.new(env.config),
		generation = 0,
		opening = false,
		sending = false,
		drawer = nil,
		ghost = nil,
		sandbox = nil,
		pointer = nil,
		inputMethod = "mouse",
		lastPreview = nil,
		intent = 0,
		cleanupGeneration = 0,
		lastCloseInfo = nil,
	}, BuildController)
	return self
end

function BuildController:isOpen()
	return self.session:isOpen()
end

function BuildController:isOpening()
	return self.opening
end

-- Requests ------------------------------------------------------------------

function BuildController:_bumpIntent()
	self.intent = self.intent + 1
end

-- One yielding request bound to the current generation. Returns the response,
-- or nil when it was discarded because the session closed/reopened meanwhile.
-- intent (optional): when the user's intent changed meanwhile, only status is applied.
function BuildController:_request(payload, intent)
	local generation = self.generation
	local response = self.env.request(payload)
	if generation ~= self.generation then
		return nil
	end
	if type(response) ~= "table" then
		response = { ok = false, code = "Internal" }
	end
	local statusOnly = intent ~= nil and intent ~= self.intent
	self.session:applyResponse(payload.op, response, statusOnly)
	return response
end

-- Sends one edit; ignores input while an edit of this session is in flight.
function BuildController:_send(payload)
	if self.sending or not self.session:canEdit() then
		return nil
	end
	self.sending = true
	local generation = self.generation
	local response = self:_request(payload, self.intent)
	if generation ~= self.generation then
		return nil -- a newer session owns `sending` now
	end
	self.sending = false
	if response and not response.ok and response.code then
		self.session.message = self.env.messageFor and self.env.messageFor(response.code) or response.code
	end
	self:_refresh()
	return response
end

function BuildController:_refreshStatus()
	self:_request({ op = "Status" })
	self:_refresh()
end

-- Handoff cleanup -------------------------------------------------------------

-- Failed cleanup = the handoff is inactive but still holds handles from a
-- failed exit. Handles of an active (or entering/exiting) handoff are not.
function BuildController:_hasFailedCleanup()
	local handoff = self.env.handoff
	return handoff:getState() == "inactive" and handoff:hasPendingCleanup()
end

-- Invalidates every background cleanup worker scheduled so far.
function BuildController:_invalidateCleanupWorkers()
	self.cleanupGeneration = self.cleanupGeneration + 1
end

function BuildController:_retryCleanup()
	if not self:_hasFailedCleanup() then
		return true
	end
	self.env.handoff:exit()
	if self:_hasFailedCleanup() then
		return false
	end
	self:_invalidateCleanupWorkers()
	return true
end

function BuildController:_scheduleCleanupRetry()
	self:_invalidateCleanupWorkers()
	local generation = self.cleanupGeneration
	self.env.spawn(function()
		while true do
			self.env.wait(RETRY_SECONDS)
			-- Re-check ownership after every wait: a newer worker, a successful
			-- cleanup or a new open/opening means this worker is stale.
			if generation ~= self.cleanupGeneration or self.opening or self.session:isOpen() or not self:_hasFailedCleanup() then
				return
			end
			if self:_retryCleanup() then
				return
			end
		end
	end)
end

function BuildController:_exitHandoff()
	local ok, failures = self.env.handoff:exit()
	if not ok and self:_hasFailedCleanup() then
		self:_scheduleCleanupRetry()
		return false, failures
	end
	return true
end

function BuildController:_notifyClosed(info)
	self.lastCloseInfo = info
	local panel = self.env.panel
	if panel and panel.onClosed then
		pcall(panel.onClosed, info)
	end
end

-- Open / close ----------------------------------------------------------------

function BuildController:open()
	if self.session:isOpen() then
		return true
	end
	if self.opening then
		return false, "Opening"
	end
	if not self:_retryCleanup() then
		self:_scheduleCleanupRetry()
		return false, "CleanupPending"
	end
	self:_invalidateCleanupWorkers() -- no worker may touch the handoff this open enters
	local sandbox = self.env.readSandbox()
	if sandbox == nil then
		return false, "Unavailable"
	end

	self.generation = self.generation + 1
	local generation = self.generation
	self.opening = true
	local entered, failures = self.env.handoff:enter({ sandboxOrigin = sandbox.origin, bounds = sandbox.bounds })
	if generation ~= self.generation then
		-- Cancelled while entering; _cancelOpening already asked the handoff to exit.
		if entered then
			self:_exitHandoff()
		end
		return false, "Cancelled"
	end
	if not entered then
		self.opening = false
		local reason = failures and failures[1] and failures[1].reason == "Unbound" and "HandoffUnbound" or "HandoffFailed"
		return false, reason
	end

	-- Still "opening": createDrawer (WaitForChild) and getPosition may yield.
	-- Keep the drawer local until no cancellation happened meanwhile.
	local drawer = self.env.createDrawer(self:_drawerCallbacks())
	if generation ~= self.generation then
		drawer:destroy() -- _cancelOpening already exited the handoff
		return false, "Cancelled"
	end
	local x, y = nil, nil
	local panel = self.env.panel
	if panel and panel.getPosition then
		local ok, px, py = pcall(panel.getPosition)
		if ok and type(px) == "number" and type(py) == "number" then
			x, y = px, py
		end
	end
	if generation ~= self.generation then
		drawer:destroy()
		return false, "Cancelled"
	end

	self.opening = false
	self.sandbox = sandbox
	self.sending = false
	self.session:opened(self.env.isHost())
	self.drawer = drawer
	if x then
		drawer:setPosition(x, y)
	end
	drawer:setInputMode(self.inputMethod)
	self:showFilter(self.session.filter)
	self:_startRecoveryPolling(generation)
	self:_refreshStatus()
	return true
end

function BuildController:_cancelOpening(reason)
	self.generation = self.generation + 1
	self.opening = false
	local ok = self:_exitHandoff() -- cancels a yielded enter (pending) or cleans up
	self:_notifyClosed({ reason = reason, cancelled = true, cleanupFailed = not ok or nil })
end

-- reason: optional message for the panel (host change, room switch, respawn).
function BuildController:close(reason)
	if self.opening then
		self:_cancelOpening(reason)
		return
	end
	if not self.session:isOpen() then
		-- Nothing open, but a previous exit may still need cleaning up.
		if not self:_retryCleanup() then
			self:_scheduleCleanupRetry()
		end
		return
	end
	self.generation = self.generation + 1
	local x, y = nil, nil
	if self.drawer then
		x, y = self.drawer:getPosition()
	end
	self.session:closed()
	self.sending = false
	self:_clearGhost()
	self.env.setSelectionHighlight(nil)
	if self.drawer then
		self.drawer:destroy()
		self.drawer = nil
	end
	local ok = self:_exitHandoff()
	self:_notifyClosed({ x = x, y = y, reason = reason, cleanupFailed = not ok or nil })
end

function BuildController:_startRecoveryPolling(generation)
	self.env.spawn(function()
		while generation == self.generation do
			self.env.wait(RETRY_SECONDS)
			if generation ~= self.generation then
				break
			end
			if self.session.paused then
				self:_refreshStatus() -- _request discards results from older sessions
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Preview ---------------------------------------------------------------------

function BuildController:_clearGhost()
	if self.ghost then
		self.ghost:destroy()
	end
	self.ghost = nil
	self.lastPreview = nil
end

function BuildController:_ensureGhost()
	local itemId = self.session.itemId
	if self.ghost and self.ghost.catalogId ~= itemId then
		self:_clearGhost()
	end
	if self.ghost == nil and itemId then
		self.ghost = self.env.createGhost(itemId)
	end
end

function BuildController:_updatePreview()
	local session = self.session
	if not session:isPreviewing() or self.sandbox == nil then
		self:_clearGhost()
		return
	end
	self:_ensureGhost()
	if self.ghost == nil or self.pointer == nil then
		return
	end
	local size = self.env.itemSize(session.itemId)
	if size == nil then
		return
	end
	local exclude = session.mode == "moving" and session.selectedId or nil
	local hit = self.env.raycast(self.pointer, exclude)
	local preview = PlacementPreview.compute(hit, { size = size, yaw = session.previewYaw, bounds = self.sandbox.bounds, snap = true, config = self.env.config })
	preview.itemId = session.itemId
	self.lastPreview = preview
	if preview.transform then
		self.ghost.show(preview.transform, preview.valid)
	end
end

function BuildController:confirmPlacement()
	local session = self.session
	if not session:isPreviewing() or not session:canEdit() then
		return nil
	end
	local preview = self.lastPreview
	if preview == nil or preview.itemId ~= session.itemId or not preview.valid then
		session.message = self.env.messageFor and self.env.messageFor(preview and preview.code == "OutOfBounds" and "OutOfBounds" or "BadTransform") or "Can't place there."
		self:_refresh()
		return nil
	end
	local t = preview.transform
	local transform = { x = t.x, y = t.y, z = t.z, yaw = t.yaw }
	if session.mode == "placing" then
		return self:_send({ op = "Place", itemId = session.itemId, transform = transform })
	end
	return self:_send({ op = "Move", id = session.selectedId, transform = transform })
end

-- UI ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

function BuildController:_refresh()
	local session = self.session
	if self.drawer == nil then
		return
	end
	if not session:isPreviewing() then
		self:_clearGhost()
	end
	local highlighted = (session.mode == "selected" or session.mode == "moving") and session.selectedId or nil
	self.env.setSelectionHighlight(highlighted)
	local status
	if session.readOnly then
		status = "Only the host can build."
	elseif session:isPreviewing() then
		status = "Placing: snaps to floors and tabletops."
	else
		status = "Build your studio."
	end
	self.drawer:setStatus(status)
	self.drawer:setFooter(session.message or "")
	self.drawer:refresh(session)
end

function BuildController:showFilter(collectionId)
	local session = self.session
	session:setFilter(collectionId)
	if self.drawer == nil then
		return
	end
	local catalog = self.env.catalog
	local collection = catalog.getCollection(session.filter)
	self.drawer:setFilter(session.filter, collection and collection.displayName)
	local items = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(catalog.getItemsTagged(session.filter)) do
		local template = self.env.previewTemplate(item.id)
		items[#items + 1] = { id = item.id, displayName = item.displayName, installed = template ~= nil, preview = template }
	end
	self.drawer:setItems(items)
	self:_refresh()
end

function BuildController:chooseItem(itemId)
	self:_bumpIntent()
	self.session:choose(itemId, self.env.previewTemplate(itemId) ~= nil)
	self:_updatePreview()
	self:_refresh()
end

function BuildController:rotate()
	local action = self.session:rotate()
	if action == "request" then
		return self:_send({ op = "Rotate", id = self.session.selectedId })
	end
	if action == "preview" then
		self:_bumpIntent()
	end
	self:_updatePreview()
	self:_refresh()
	return nil
end

function BuildController:cancel()
	self:_bumpIntent()
	self.session:cancel()
	self:_refresh()
end

function BuildController:beginMove()
	local session = self.session
	local info = session.selectedId and self.env.selectedInfo(session.selectedId) or nil
	if info then
		self:_bumpIntent()
		session:beginMove(info.catalogId, info.yaw)
		self:_updatePreview()
		self:_refresh()
	end
end

function BuildController:_drawerCallbacks()
	return {
		onFilter = function(id)
			self:showFilter(id)
		end,
		onItem = function(itemId)
			self:chooseItem(itemId)
		end,
		onUndo = function()
			self:_send({ op = "Undo", expectedRevision = self.session.revision })
		end,
		onRedo = function()
			self:_send({ op = "Redo", expectedRevision = self.session.revision })
		end,
		onBack = function()
			self:close()
		end,
		onDone = function()
			self:close() -- task 5: save first; stay open with a visible error if it fails
		end,
		onMove = function()
			self:beginMove()
		end,
		onRotate = function()
			self:rotate()
		end,
		onDuplicate = function()
			if self.session.selectedId then
				self:_send({ op = "Duplicate", id = self.session.selectedId })
			end
		end,
		onDelete = function()
			if self.session.selectedId then
				self:_send({ op = "Delete", id = self.session.selectedId })
			end
		end,
		onPlaceHere = function()
			self:confirmPlacement()
		end,
		onCancel = function()
			self:cancel()
		end,
	}
end

-- Signals from BuilderClient ------------------------------------------------------

function BuildController:_setInputMethod(method)
	if method ~= self.inputMethod then
		self.inputMethod = method
		if self.drawer then
			self.drawer:setInputMode(method)
		end
	end
end

-- Mouse movement or touch drag over the world.
function BuildController:onPointerMoved(pointer, method)
	self:_setInputMethod(method)
	if method == "touch" then
		self.pointer = pointer
		self:_updatePreview()
	end
end

-- Left click or tap. screenX/screenY are in GUI space for the drawer hit test.
function BuildController:onPointerPressed(pointer, method, screenX, screenY)
	if not self.session:isOpen() then
		return
	end
	if self.drawer and self.drawer:containsPoint(screenX, screenY) then
		return -- presses on the drawer (even its background) never reach the world
	end
	self:_setInputMethod(method)
	self.pointer = pointer
	if self.session:isPreviewing() then
		self:_updatePreview()
		if method == "mouse" then
			self:confirmPlacement() -- touch confirms with Place here
		end
		return
	end
	self:_bumpIntent()
	self.session:select(self.env.pickPlaced(pointer))
	self:_refresh()
end

-- Per frame.
function BuildController:tick()
	if not self.session:isPreviewing() then
		return
	end
	if self.inputMethod == "mouse" then
		self.pointer = self.env.mouseLocation()
	end
	self:_updatePreview()
end

function BuildController:onHostChanged()
	if self.opening then
		if not self.env.isHost() then
			self:_cancelOpening("Host changed; build mode closed.")
		end
		return
	end
	if self.session:isOpen() and self.session:hostChanged(self.env.isHost()) then
		self:close(self.session.message)
	elseif self.session:isOpen() then
		self:_refresh()
	end
end

function BuildController:onRoomSwitched()
	if self.opening then
		self:_cancelOpening("Room changed; build mode closed.")
	elseif self.session:isOpen() then
		self.session:roomSwitched()
		self:close(self.session.message)
	end
end

function BuildController:onRespawned()
	if self.opening then
		self:_cancelOpening("Respawned; build mode closed.")
	elseif self.session:isOpen() then
		self.session:respawned()
		self:close(self.session.message)
	end
end

function BuildController:onRevisionChanged(revision)
	if self.session:isOpen() then
		self.session:revisionChanged(revision)
		self:_refresh()
	end
end

function BuildController:onViewportChanged(width, height)
	if self.drawer then
		self.drawer:refit(width, height)
	end
end

function BuildController:onFocusLost()
	if self.drawer then
		self.drawer:cancelDrag()
	end
end

return BuildController

--[[
	BuildDrawer: the Build catalog drawer, built only from PanelTheme so it
	matches the live host panel (docs/ui-contract.md). Studio-pending: not run
	outside Roblox.

	Layout (contract positions):
	* title "Build" at (18, 13), shared status line at (18, 39);
	* DRAG TO MOVE handle top right, 30x30 close (= Back) at (right - 48, 12);
	* the five collection filters in the tab row (x 14, y 72, h 34, gap 6),
	  standard/selected button styles;
	* scroll body (x 14, y 119, w - 28, h - 177), rows with 9 px padding:
	  actions (Undo / Redo / Back / Done), selection (Move / Rotate /
	  Duplicate / Delete), placement row (Place here when the active input is
	  touch / Rotate / Cancel), then catalog cards with ViewportFrames from
	  PreviewTemplates;
	* footer status at (18, bottom - 49), 11 px muted.
	The drawer is draggable by its handle and clamped on-screen; refit() follows
	viewport resizes/orientation; containsPoint() lets the controller keep every
	press on the drawer (background and labels included) out of the world.
]]

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local PanelTheme = require(script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("UI"):WaitForChild("PanelTheme"))

local BuildDrawer = {}
BuildDrawer.__index = BuildDrawer

local L = PanelTheme.Layout

local function place(instance, parent, position, size)
	instance.Position = position
	instance.Size = size
	instance.Parent = parent
	return instance
end

local function row(parent, order, height)
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height)
	f.LayoutOrder = order
	f.Parent = parent
	return f
end

-- Lays buttons out across a row with the tab gap.
local function buttonRow(parent, order, labels, callbacks)
	local r = row(parent, order, L.tabsHeight)
	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, L.tabsGap)
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	layout.Parent = r
	local buttons = {}
	local n = #labels
	for i, label in ipairs(labels) do
		local b = PanelTheme.button(label, false)
		b.Size = UDim2.new(1 / n, -L.tabsGap * (n - 1) / n, 1, 0)
		b.LayoutOrder = i
		b.Parent = r
		b.Activated:Connect(callbacks[i])
		buttons[label] = b
	end
	return r, buttons
end

-- callbacks: onFilter(id), onItem(itemId), onUndo, onRedo, onBack, onDone,
--            onMove, onRotate, onDuplicate, onDelete, onPlaceHere, onCancel
-- collections: sorted { id, displayName }
function BuildDrawer.new(playerGui, collections, callbacks)
	local self = setmetatable({ callbacks = callbacks, cards = {}, filterButtons = {} }, BuildDrawer)

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "StudioBuilderDrawer"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = PanelTheme.ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = PanelTheme.ScreenGui.IgnoreGuiInset
	gui.DisplayOrder = PanelTheme.ScreenGui.DisplayOrder
	self.gui = gui

	local viewport = Workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
	local fit = PanelTheme.fit(viewport.X, viewport.Y)
	local drawer = PanelTheme.drawer("Drawer")
	drawer.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fit.width, fit.height)
	drawer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(fit.x, fit.y)
	drawer.Active = true
	drawer.Parent = gui
	self.drawer = drawer

	local title = PanelTheme.label("title", "Build")
	place(title, drawer, UDim2.fromOffset(L.headerX, L.headerY), UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, L.titleHeight))
	self.status = place(PanelTheme.label("status", ""), drawer, UDim2.fromOffset(L.statusX, L.statusY), UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 16))

	local handle = PanelTheme.label("handle", L.handleText)
	handle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	handle.Active = true
	place(handle, drawer, UDim2.new(1, -150, 0, L.closeTop), UDim2.fromOffset(96, L.closeSize))
	self:_makeDraggable(handle)

	-- Close label: confirm against the live panel's close glyph during visual comparison.
	local close = PanelTheme.button("X", false)
	place(close, drawer, UDim2.new(1, -L.closeRightInset, 0, L.closeTop), UDim2.fromOffset(L.closeSize, L.closeSize))
	close.Activated:Connect(callbacks.onBack)

	-- Filter row in the tab position.
	local tabs = Instance.new("Frame")
	tabs.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	place(tabs, drawer, UDim2.fromOffset(L.tabsX, L.tabsY), UDim2.new(1, -L.tabsX * 2, 0, L.tabsHeight))
	local tabLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	tabLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
	tabLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, L.tabsGap)
	tabLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	tabLayout.Parent = tabs
	local n = #collections
	for i, c in ipairs(collections) do
		local b = PanelTheme.button(c.displayName, false)
		b.Size = UDim2.new(1 / n, -L.tabsGap * (n - 1) / n, 1, 0)
		b.LayoutOrder = i
		b.Parent = tabs
		b.Activated:Connect(function()
			callbacks.onFilter(c.id)
		end)
		self.filterButtons[c.id] = b
	end

	local body = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	body.BorderSizePixel = 0
	body.ScrollBarThickness = L.scrollBarThickness
	body.ScrollBarImageColor3 = PanelTheme.color("teal")
	body.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
	body.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	place(body, drawer, UDim2.fromOffset(L.bodyX, L.bodyY), UDim2.new(1, -L.bodyWidthInset, 1, -L.bodyHeightInset))
	local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	list.Padding = UDim.new(0, L.rowPadding)
	list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	list.Parent = body
	local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, L.rowPaddingRight)
	padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, L.rowPaddingBottom)
	padding.Parent = body
	self.body = body

	local _, actions = buttonRow(body, 1, { "Undo", "Redo", "Back", "Done" }, { callbacks.onUndo, callbacks.onRedo, callbacks.onBack, callbacks.onDone })
	self.actions = actions

	local selection
