local function isPress(input)
	return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end

function BuildDrawer:_makeDraggable(handle)
	local startInput, startPosition = nil, nil
	self.dragging = false
	handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if isPress(input) then
			self.dragging, startInput, startPosition = true, input.Position, self.drawer.AbsolutePosition
		end
	end)
	-- Release anywhere ends the drag (the handle may not see the release).
	self.dragEndConnection = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if isPress(input) then
			self.dragging = false
		end
	end)
	self.dragConnection = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if self.dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
			local delta = input.Position - startInput
			self:setPosition(startPosition.X + delta.X, startPosition.Y + delta.Y)
		end
	end)
end

-- Focus loss: stop dragging so the panel doesn't follow a later mouse move.
function BuildDrawer:cancelDrag()
	self.dragging = false
end

-- Viewport resize/orientation: refit size with the live formula, keep the
-- current position but clamp it on-screen.
function BuildDrawer:refit(viewportX, viewportY)
	local fit = PanelTheme.fit(viewportX, viewportY)
	self.drawer.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fit.width, fit.height)
	local p = self.drawer.AbsolutePosition
	local x, y = PanelTheme.clamp(p.X, p.Y, fit.width, fit.height, viewportX, viewportY)
	self.drawer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
end

-- True when (x, y) in GUI space (same space as InputObject.Position) is on the drawer.
function BuildDrawer:containsPoint(x, y)
	if type(x) ~= "number" or type(y) ~= "number" then
		return false
	end
	local p, size = self.drawer.AbsolutePosition, self.drawer.AbsoluteSize
	return x >= p.X and x <= p.X + size.X and y >= p.Y and y <= p.Y + size.Y
end

-- "touch" shows Place here (taps only preview); "mouse" clicks place directly.
function BuildDrawer:setInputMode(method)
	local touch = method == "touch"
	self.placeHere.Visible = touch
	self.hintText.Text = touch and "Tap a surface to preview, then Place here." or "Click a surface to place. R rotates, Esc cancels."
end

function BuildDrawer:setPosition(x, y)
	local viewport = Workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
	local size = self.drawer.AbsoluteSize
	local cx, cy = PanelTheme.clamp(x, y, size.X, size.Y, viewport.X, viewport.Y)
	self.drawer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, cy)
end

function BuildDrawer:getPosition()
	local p = self.drawer.AbsolutePosition
	return p.X, p.Y
end

function BuildDrawer:setStatus(text)
	self.status.Text = text or ""
end

function BuildDrawer:setFooter(text)
	self.footer.Text = text or ""
end

function BuildDrawer:setFilter(collectionId, displayName)
	for id, b in pairs(self.filterButtons) do
		PanelTheme.setSelected(b, id == collectionId)
	end
	self.collectionHeading.Text = displayName or ""
end

local function setEnabled(button, enabled)
	button.AutoButtonColor = enabled
	button.Active = enabled
	button.TextColor3 = PanelTheme.color(enabled and "white" or "muted")
end

-- Reflects BuildSession state: which rows show and which buttons are live.
function BuildDrawer:refresh(session)
	local editable = session:canEdit()
	setEnabled(self.actions.Undo, editable and session.canUndo)
	setEnabled(self.actions.Redo, editable and session.canRedo)
	self.selectionRow.Visible = session.mode == "selected"
	for _, b in pairs(self.selectionButtons) do
		setEnabled(b, editable)
	end
	self.hintRow.Visible = session:isPreviewing()
	for _, card in pairs(self.cards) do
		setEnabled(card.button, editable and card.installed)
	end
end

local function frameViewport(viewport, model)
	local camera = Instance.new("Camera")
	camera.FieldOfView = 35
	camera.Parent = viewport
	viewport.CurrentCamera = camera
	local cf, size = model:GetBoundingBox()
	local radius = math.max(size.Magnitude / 2, 0.5)
	local distance = radius / math.tan(math.rad(camera.FieldOfView / 2)) * 1.05
	local direction = (cf.LookVector + cf.RightVector * 0.6 + cf.UpVector * 0.5).Unit
	camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position + direction * distance, cf.Position)
end

-- items: { { id, displayName, installed, preview = Model? } } for the current filter.
function BuildDrawer:setItems(items)
	for _, card in pairs(self.cards) do
		card.button:Destroy()
	end
	self.cards = {}
	for i, item in ipairs(items) do
		local b = PanelTheme.button("", false)
		b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 64)
		b.LayoutOrder = 10 + i
		local viewport = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
		viewport.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		viewport.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 56)
		viewport.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4)
		viewport.Parent = b
		if item.preview then
			local model = item.preview:Clone()
			model.Parent = viewport
			frameViewport(viewport, model)
		end
		place(PanelTheme.label("body", item.displayName), b, UDim2.fromOffset(70, 14), UDim2.new(1, -78, 0, 18))
		place(PanelTheme.label("description", item.installed and "Ready to place" or "Not installed"), b, UDim2.fromOffset(70, 34), UDim2.new(1, -78, 0, 14))
		b.Parent = self.body
		b.Activated:Connect(function()
			if item.installed then
				self.callbacks.onItem(item.id)
			end
		end)
		self.cards[item.id] = { button = b, installed = item.installed }
	end
end

function BuildDrawer:destroy()
	if self.dragConnection then
		self.dragConnection:Disconnect()
	end
	if self.dragEndConnection then
		self.dragEndConnection:Disconnect()
	end
	self.gui:Destroy()
end

return BuildDrawer

--[[
	BuildInput: decides what a raw input means in build mode. Pure.

	The builder only LISTENS (UserInputService); it never binds or sinks
	input, so the host panel, chat and PodcastCamera keep their keys:
	* Anything while a TextBox has focus is ignored (text-entry safe).
	* Escape cancels placement/selection even if the game processed it, but
	  is never sunk, so the cursor-release safeguard still runs.
	* R rotates, left click / tap is a pointer action, only when the game did
	  not process the input (clicks on UI never place items).
	* E/Q (free-camera vertical), right mouse (look / cursor release), 1-5, V
	  and F are never handled here. Suppressing host shortcuts is the
	  hostControls hook's job, not this module's.
]]

local BuildInput = {}

BuildInput.NeverHandled = { E = true, Q = true, One = true, Two = true, Three = true, Four = true, Five = true, V = true, F = true, MouseButton2 = true }

-- ctx: { keyCode = "R" | "Escape" | ..., inputType = "Keyboard" | "MouseButton1" | "Touch" | ...,
--        gameProcessed = boolean, textFocused = boolean }
-- Returns "rotate" | "cancel" | "pointer" | nil.
function BuildInput.classify(ctx)
	if ctx.textFocused then
		return nil
	end
	if BuildInput.NeverHandled[ctx.keyCode] or BuildInput.NeverHandled[ctx.inputType] then
		return nil
	end
	if ctx.keyCode == "Escape" then
		return "cancel"
	end
	if ctx.gameProcessed then
		return nil
	end
	if ctx.keyCode == "R" then
		return "rotate"
	end
	if ctx.inputType == "MouseButton1" or ctx.inputType == "Touch" then
		return "pointer"
	end
	return nil
end

return BuildInput

--[[
	BuildSession: client-side state of the Build drawer. Pure; the controller
	feeds it events and reads the result. The server stays authoritative: the
	session only decides what the UI shows and which request to send.

	Modes: "closed" | "idle" | "placing" | "moving" | "selected".
	* placing/moving show a preview; R turns the preview by RotationStep.
	* Escape: placing -> idle, moving -> selected, selected -> idle.
	* Edits are blocked while read-only (not host) or paused (server in
	  recovery). The pause lifts only when a status says "ready".
	* Host loss, room switch and respawn cancel any preview or move and ask
	  the controller to exit build mode.
	* A BuildRevision the session didn't cause cancels an in-progress move
	  (the item may have changed); undo/redo send expectedRevision so the
	  server refuses stale steps.
	* Responses are ignored once closed, and status older than the newest
	  known revision is ignored (a Status op entirely).
]]

local BuildSession = {}
BuildSession.__index = BuildSession

local FILTERS = { cozy = true, ["1980s"] = true, retro = true, winter = true, futuristic = true }

function BuildSession.new(config)
	return setmetatable({
		config = config,
		mode = "closed",
		filter = "cozy",
		itemId = nil,
		selectedId = nil,
		previewYaw = 0,
		readOnly = false,
		paused = false,
		canUndo = false,
		canRedo = false,
		revision = nil,
		message = nil,
	}, BuildSession)
end

function BuildSession:isOpen()
	return self.mode ~= "closed"
end

function BuildSession:canEdit()
	return self:isOpen() and not self.readOnly and not self.paused
end

function BuildSession:isPreviewing()
	return self.mode == "placing" or self.mode == "moving"
end

function BuildSession:opened(isHost)
	self.mode = "idle"
	self.revision = nil
	self.paused = false
	self.canUndo, self.canRedo = false, false
	self.readOnly = not isHost
	self.itemId, self.selectedId, self.message = nil, nil, nil
	if self.readOnly then
		self.message = "Only the host can build."
	end
end

function BuildSession:closed()
	self.mode = "closed"
	self.itemId, self.selectedId = nil, nil
end

function BuildSession:setFilter(collectionId)
	if FILTERS[collectionId] then
		self.filter = collectionId
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- Starts placing a catalog item (installed = has a prepared template).
function BuildSession:choose(itemId, installed)
	if not self:canEdit() then
		return false
	end
	if not installed then
		self.message = "That item isn't installed yet."
		return false
	end
	self.mode = "placing"
	self.itemId = itemId
	self.selectedId = nil
	self.previewYaw = 0
	return true
end

function BuildSession:select(id)
	if not self:isOpen() or self:isPreviewing() then
		return false
	end
	self.selectedId = id
	self.mode = id and "selected" or "idle"
	return true
end

function BuildSession:beginMove(itemId, currentYaw)
	if self.mode ~= "selected" or not self:canEdit() then
		return false
	end
	self.mode = "moving"
	self.itemId = itemId
	self.previewYaw = currentYaw or 0
	return true
end

-- R / Rotate button. Returns "preview" (local turn) or "request" (send Rotate).
function BuildSession:rotate()
	if self:isPreviewing() then
		self.previewYaw = (self.previewYaw + self.config.RotationStep) % 360
		return "preview"
	end
	if self.mode == "selected" and self:canEdit() then
		return "request"
	end
	return nil
end

function BuildSession:cancel()
	if self.mode == "placing" then
		self.mode = "idle"
		self.itemId = nil
	elseif self.mode == "moving" then
		self.mode = "selected"
		self.itemId = nil
	elseif self.mode == "selected" then
		self.mode = "idle"
		self.selectedId = nil
	end
end

-- Applies a server response to op. Failed placements keep the preview so the
-- user can try another spot. statusOnly: the user's intent changed while the
-- request was in flight, so apply status but not mode/selection changes.
function BuildSession:applyResponse(op, response, statusOnly)
	if self.mode == "closed" then
		return -- a late response must never revive a closed session
	end
	local status = type(response) == "table" and response.status or nil
	if type(status) == "table" and type(status.revision) == "number" and self.revision ~= nil and status.revision < self.revision then
		-- Older than what we already know (e.g. a slow Status poll): ignore it.
		if op == "Status" then
			return
		end
		status = nil
	end
	if type(status) == "table" then
		self.canUndo = status.canUndo == true
		self.canRedo = status.canRedo == true
		if type(status.revision) == "number" then
			self.revision = status.revision
		end
		if status.state == "recovery" then
			self.paused = true
		elseif status.state == "ready" and self.paused then
			self.paused = false
			self.message = nil
		end
	end
	if type(response) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	if response.code == "RecoveryNeeded" or response.recoveryNeeded then
		self.paused = true
	end
	if self.paused then
		self.message = "The build area is resynchronizing; edits are paused."
	end
	if response.code == "NotHost" then
		self.readOnly = true
		self:cancelPreview()
	end
	if not response.ok or statusOnly then
		return
	end
	if op == "Place" or op == "Duplicate" then
		self.mode = "selected"
		self.selectedId = response.id
		self.itemId = nil
	elseif op == "Move" then
		self.mode = "selected"
		self.itemId = nil
	elseif op == "Delete" then
		self.mode = "idle"
		self.selectedId = nil
	elseif op == "Undo" or op == "Redo" then
		-- The affected item may have disappeared; start from a clean selection.
		self.mode = "idle"
		self.selectedId = nil
		self.itemId = nil
	end
end

function BuildSession:cancelPreview()
	if self.mode == "placing" then
		self.mode = "idle"
	elseif self.mode == "moving" then
		self.mode = "selected"
	end
	self.itemId = nil
end

-- Returns true when the controller must exit build mode.
function BuildSession:hostChanged(isHost)
	if isHost then
		-- Became (or stayed) host: editing is allowed; the server starts a fresh history.
		if self.readOnly then
			self.readOnly = false
			self.message = nil
		end
		return false
	end
	self:cancelPreview()
	self.readOnly = true
	self.message = "Host changed; build mode closed."
	return true
end

function BuildSession:roomSwitched()
	self:cancelPreview()
	self.message = "Room changed; build mode closed."
	return true
end

function BuildSession:respawned()
	self:cancelPreview()
	self.message = "Respawned; build mode closed."
	return true
end

-- A BuildRevision change that our own responses didn't explain.
function BuildSession:revisionChanged(revision)
	if revision == self.revision then
		return
	end
	self.revision = revision
	if self.mode == "moving" then
		self:cancelPreview()
		self.message = "The studio changed; move cancelled."
	end
end

return BuildSession

--[[
	PlacementPreview: turns a pointer raycast hit into a candidate transform.
	Pure; the client controller does the raycast and passes the hit in sandbox
	local space. The server re-validates everything.

	* Surface snapping (default): the item sits on whatever it hit, as long as
	  the surface faces up: floor, tabletop or another placed item. Overlaps
	  and floating are allowed by the server, so this only picks a sensible
	  height. Walls and undersides (upDot < MinUpDot) are rejected.
	* Grid snapping (default on): x and z round to Config.GridSize.
	* Tiny negative heights from the floor surface clamp to 0.
	* Bounds and yaw rules come from the shared Transform module, so the preview
	  turns invalid exactly where the server would reject.
]]

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("StudioBuilder")
local Transform = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Transform"))

local PlacementPreview = {}

PlacementPreview.MinUpDot = 0.7
PlacementPreview.FloorTolerance = 0.5

-- hit: { x, y, z, upDot } in sandbox local space, or nil when nothing was hit.
-- ctx: { size, yaw, bounds, snap, config }
-- Returns { valid, code, transform }; transform is the best guess for drawing
-- the ghost even when invalid (nil when there is no surface).
function PlacementPreview.compute(hit, ctx)
	if hit == nil or type(hit.upDot) ~= "number" or hit.upDot < PlacementPreview.MinUpDot then
		return { valid = false, code = "NoSurface" }
	end
	local x, y, z = hit.x, hit.y, hit.z
	if ctx.snap then
		local grid = ctx.config.GridSize
		x = Transform.round(x, grid)
		z = Transform.round(z, grid)
	end
	if y < 0 and y > -PlacementPreview.FloorTolerance then
		y = 0
	end
	local raw = { x = x, y = y, z = z, yaw = ctx.yaw }
	local clean, code = Transform.sanitize(raw, ctx.size, ctx.bounds, ctx.config)
	if clean then
		return { valid = true, transform = clean }
	end
	return { valid = false, code = code, transform = raw }
end

return PlacementPreview

--[[
	BuilderClient: Roblox binding for build mode. All behaviour lives in
	Build/BuildController (tested with fakes); this module only supplies the
	Roblox env and forwards signals. Studio/Play pending.

	API (for the host panel's Studio page; no live function is guessed):
		BuilderClient.configure({
			hooks = { camera = ..., hostControls = ..., hostDrawer = ..., worldClickHandlers = ... },
			panel = {
				getPosition = function() -> x, y end,               -- optional: open where the panel is
				onClosed = function({ x, y, reason, cancelled, cleanupFailed }) end, -- optional
			},
			roomSwitchSignal = RBXScriptSignal?,                    -- optional live room-switch gate
		})
		BuilderClient.open()  -> ok, reason   -- reasons: Unavailable, HandoffUnbound,
		                                     -- HandoffFailed, Cancelled, CleanupPending, Opening
		BuilderClient.close()                 -- Back / Done
		BuilderClient.isOpen()

	Signals (host change, room switch, respawn, input, viewport, focus) are
	connected once when this module loads, before any open can yield.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("StudioBuilder")
local Config = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Config"))
local Catalog = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Catalog"))
local Protocol = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Protocol"))

local Build = script.Parent:WaitForChild("Build")
local BuildController = require(Build:WaitForChild("BuildController"))
local BuildInput = require(Build:WaitForChild("BuildInput"))
local BuildDrawer = require(Build:WaitForChild("BuildDrawer"))
local BuildModeHandoff = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Adapters"):WaitForChild("BuildModeHandoff"))

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local GHOST_VALID = Color3.fromRGB(91, 224, 198) -- panel teal
local GHOST_INVALID = Color3.fromRGB(235, 87, 87) -- world-space ghost only

local BuilderClient = {}
local handoff = BuildModeHandoff.new()
local panelCallbacks = {}
local selectionHighlight = nil
local controller -- created below

local function placedFolder()
	return Workspace:FindFirstChild(Config.PlacedItemsFolderName)
end

local function previewTemplate(itemId)
	local folder = Shared:FindFirstChild(Config.PreviewTemplatesFolderName)
	return folder and folder:FindFirstChild(itemId) or nil
end

local function sandboxFrame()
	local folder = placedFolder()
	local origin = folder and folder:GetAttribute("SandboxOrigin")
	local size = folder and folder:GetAttribute("SandboxSize")
	if typeof(origin) ~= "CFrame" or typeof(size) ~= "Vector3" then
		return nil
	end
	return { origin = origin, bounds = { halfX = size.X / 2, halfZ = size.Z / 2, height = size.Y } }
end

local function ray(pointer)
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if pointer.space == "screen" then
		return camera:ScreenPointToRay(pointer.position.X, pointer.position.Y)
	end
	return camera:ViewportPointToRay(pointer.position.X, pointer.position.Y)
end

local function placedModel(id)
	local folder = placedFolder()
	return id and folder and folder:FindFirstChild(id) or nil
end

local env = {
	config = Config,
	catalog = Catalog,
	handoff = handoff,
	messageFor = Protocol.message,
	readSandbox = sandboxFrame,
	previewTemplate = previewTemplate,
	spawn = function(fn)
		task.spawn(fn)
	end,
	wait = function(seconds)
		task.wait(seconds)
	end,
}

function env.request(payload)
	local remotes = Shared:FindFirstChild(Config.RemotesFolderName)
	local remote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild(Config.RequestRemoteName)
	if remote == nil then
		return { ok = false, code = Protocol.Codes.Unavailable }
	end
	local ok, response = pcall(remote.InvokeServer, remote, payload)
	if not ok or type(response) ~= "table" then
		return { ok = false, code = Protocol.Codes.Internal }
	end
	return response
end

function env.isHost()
	local settings = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PodcastSettings")
	return settings ~= nil and settings:GetAttribute("HostUserId") == player.UserId
end

function env.createDrawer(callbacks)
	return BuildDrawer.new(player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"), Catalog.getCollectionsSorted(), callbacks)
end

function env.itemSize(itemId)
	local template = previewTemplate(itemId)
	if template == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local _, size = template:GetBoundingBox()
	return { size.X, size.Y, size.Z }
end

function env.createGhost(itemId)
	local template = previewTemplate(itemId)
	local frame = sandboxFrame()
	if template == nil or frame == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local model = template:Clone() -- already inert (sanitized server-side)
	for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.Transparency = math.max(part.Transparency, 0.45)
		end
	end
	local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
	highlight.FillTransparency = 0.7
	highlight.Parent = model
	model.Parent = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	return {
		catalogId = itemId,
		model = model,
		show = function(t, valid)
			model:PivotTo(frame.origin * CFrame.new(t.x, t.y, t.z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(t.yaw), 0))
			highlight.FillColor = valid and GHOST_VALID or GHOST_INVALID
			highlight.OutlineColor = highlight.FillColor
		end,
		destroy = function()
			model:Destroy()
		end,
	}
end

function env.raycast(pointer, excludeId)
	local frame = sandboxFrame()
	if frame == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	local exclude = {}
	if controller.ghost and controller.ghost.model then
		exclude[#exclude + 1] = controller.ghost.model
	end
	if player.Character then
		exclude[#exclude + 1] = player.Character
	end
	local moving = placedModel(excludeId)
	if moving then
		exclude[#exclude + 1] = moving
	end
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = exclude
	local r = ray(pointer)
	local result = Workspace:Raycast(r.Origin, r.Direction * 2000, params)
	if result == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local p = frame.origin:PointToObjectSpace(result.Position)
	return { x = p.X, y = p.Y, z = p.Z, upDot = frame.origin.UpVector:Dot(result.Normal) }
end

function env.pickPlaced(pointer)
	local folder = placedFolder()
	if folder == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { folder }
	local r = ray(pointer)
	local result = Workspace:Raycast(r.Origin, r.Direction * 2000, params)
	local node = result and result.Instance
	while node and node.Parent ~= folder do
		node = node.Parent
	end
	return node and node:GetAttribute(Config.BuildItemIdAttribute) or nil
end

function env.selectedInfo(id)
	local model = placedModel(id)
	local frame = sandboxFrame()
	if model == nil or frame == nil then
		return nil
	end
	local _, yaw = frame.origin:ToObjectSpace(model:GetPivot()):ToOrientation()
	local step = Config.RotationStep
	return { catalogId = model:GetAttribute("BuildCatalogId"), yaw = (math.floor(math.deg(yaw) / step + 0.5) * step) % 360 }
end

function env.mouseLocation()
	return { position = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation(), space = "viewport" }
end

function env.setSelectionHighlight(id)
	local model = placedModel(id)
	if model == nil then
		if selectionHighlight then
			selectionHighlight:Destroy()
			selectionHighlight = nil
		end
		return
	end
	if selectionHighlight == nil then
		selectionHighlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
		selectionHighlight.FillTransparency = 1
		selectionHighlight.OutlineColor = GHOST_VALID
		selectionHighlight.Parent = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	end
	selectionHighlight.Adornee = model
end

env.panel = {
	getPosition = function()
		if panelCallbacks.getPosition then
			return panelCallbacks.getPosition()
		end
		return nil
	end,
	onClosed = function(info)
		if panelCallbacks.onClosed then
			panelCallbacks.onClosed(info)
		end
	end,
}

controller = BuildController.new(env)

-- Signals: bound once, so cancellation works even while open() is yielding.
local function method(input)
	return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and "touch" or "mouse"
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	local action = BuildInput.classify({
		keyCode = input.KeyCode.Name,
		inputType = input.UserInputType.Name,
		gameProcessed = gameProcessed,
		textFocused = UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() ~= nil,
	})
	if action == "cancel" then
		controller:cancel()
	elseif action == "rotate" then
		controller:rotate()
	elseif action == "pointer" then
		local m = method(input)
		local pointer = m == "touch" and { position = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y), space = "screen" } or env.mouseLocation()
		controller:onPointerPressed(pointer, m, input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
		controller:onPointerMoved(env.mouseLocation(), "mouse")
	elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and not gameProcessed then
		controller:onPointerMoved({ position = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y), space = "screen" }, "touch")
	end
end)

UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
	controller:onFocusLost()
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	controller:tick()
end)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	controller:onRespawned()
end)

local function watchCamera(camera)
	if camera then
		camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(function()
			controller:onViewportChanged(camera.ViewportSize.X, camera.ViewportSize.Y)
		end)
	end
end
watchCamera(Workspace.CurrentCamera)
Workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
	watchCamera(Workspace.CurrentCamera)
end)

local function watchSettings(settings)
	settings:GetAttributeChangedSignal("HostUserId"):Connect(function()
		controller:onHostChanged()
	end)
	settings:GetAttributeChangedSignal("SceneSet"):Connect(function()
		controller:onRoomSwitched()
	end)
end
local existingSettings = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("PodcastSettings")
if existingSettings then
	watchSettings(existingSettings)
else
	ReplicatedStorage.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child.Name == "PodcastSettings" then
			watchSettings(child)
		end
	end)
end

local function watchRevision(folder)
	folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal(Config.BuildRevisionAttribute):Connect(function()
		controller:onRevisionChanged(folder:GetAttribute(Config.BuildRevisionAttribute))
	end)
end
if placedFolder() then
	watchRevision(placedFolder())
else
	Workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
		if child.Name == Config.PlacedItemsFolderName then
			watchRevision(child)
		end
	end)
end

function BuilderClient.configure(options)
	assert(not controller:isOpen() and not controller:isOpening(), "configure before opening build mode")
	options = options or {}
	for slot, hook in pairs(options.hooks or {}) do
		handoff:bind(slot, hook)
	end
	panelCallbacks = options.panel or {}
	if options.roomSwitchSignal then
		options.roomSwitchSignal:Connect(function()
			controller:onRoomSwitched()
		end)
	end
end

function BuilderClient.open()
	return controller:open()
end

function BuilderClient.close()
	controller:close()
end

function BuilderClient.isOpen()
	return controller:isOpen()
end

return BuilderClient

--[[
	PanelTheme: shared look for NEW builder UI, transcribed from the live
	PodcastStudioPanel (see docs/ui-contract.md). Values here must match that
	contract exactly; the existing panel source is not modified.

	Pure part (tested): tokens, layout constants, fit() and clamp().
	Roblox part: small constructors that apply the tokens to Instances.
]]

local PanelTheme = {}

-- C = { bg, card, teal, white, muted } plus the drawer stroke, as RGB triples.
PanelTheme.Colors = {
	bg = { 16, 24, 29 },
	card = { 31, 43, 49 },
	teal = { 91, 224, 198 },
	white = { 237, 235, 225 },
	muted = { 155, 175, 180 },
	stroke = { 66, 89, 94 },
}

PanelTheme.FontName = "GothamMedium"

PanelTheme.TextSize = {
	button = 12,
	heading = 13,
	description = 10,
	body = 12,
	title = 17,
	status = 11,
	handle = 9,
}

PanelTheme.Drawer = {
	transparency = 0.015,
	radius = 14,
	strokeTransparency = 0.25,
}

PanelTheme.ButtonRadius = 8

PanelTheme.Layout = {
	headerX = 18, headerY = 13, titleHeight = 24,
	statusX = 18, statusY = 39,
	handleText = "DRAG TO MOVE",
	closeSize = 30, closeRightInset = 48, closeTop = 12,
	tabsX = 14, tabsY = 72, tabsHeight = 34, tabsGap = 6,
	bodyX = 14, bodyY = 119, bodyWidthInset = 28, bodyHeightInset = 177,
	scrollBarThickness = 3,
	rowPadding = 9, rowPaddingRight = 6, rowPaddingBottom = 10,
	footerX = 18, footerBottomInset = 49, footerHeight = 38,
}

PanelTheme.ScreenGui = { ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = false, DisplayOrder = 20 }

-- Live responsive fit. Returns { x, y, width, height } in pixels.
function PanelTheme.fit(viewportX, viewportY)
	local width = math.min(402, viewportX - 24)
	local y = viewportY < 550 and 108 or 178
	local height = math.min(710, math.max(230, viewportY - y - 24))
	return { x = 18, y = y, width = width, height = height }
end

-- Keeps a dragged panel on-screen.
function PanelTheme.clamp(x, y, width, height, viewportX, viewportY)
	local maxX = math.max(0, viewportX - width)
	local maxY = math.max(0, viewportY - height)
	return math.min(math.max(x, 0), maxX), math.min(math.max(y, 0), maxY)
end

-- Width of each of `count` buttons in a row of `rowWidth` with tab gaps.
function PanelTheme.rowButtonWidth(count, rowWidth)
	local gap = PanelTheme.Layout.tabsGap
	return (rowWidth - gap * (count - 1)) / count
end

-- Roblox constructors -------------------------------------------------------

function PanelTheme.color(name)
	local c = PanelTheme.Colors[name]
	return Color3.fromRGB(c[1], c[2], c[3])
end

local function corner(parent, radius)
	local ui = Instance.new("UICorner")
	ui.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	ui.Parent = parent
end

-- Standard button: card background, white text, 12 px; selected = teal on bg.
function PanelTheme.button(text, selected)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Font = Enum.Font[PanelTheme.FontName]
	b.TextSize = PanelTheme.TextSize.button
	b.Text = text
	b.BorderSizePixel = 0
	b.AutoButtonColor = true
	corner(b, PanelTheme.ButtonRadius)
	PanelTheme.setSelected(b, selected == true)
	return b
end

function PanelTheme.setSelected(button, selected)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = PanelTheme.color(selected and "teal" or "card")
	button.TextColor3 = PanelTheme.color(selected and "bg" or "white")
end

-- kind: "heading" (teal 13), "description" (muted 10), "body" (white 12),
-- "title" (white 17), "status" (muted 11), "handle" (muted 9).
function PanelTheme.label(kind, text)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.Font = Enum.Font[PanelTheme.FontName]
	l.TextSize = PanelTheme.TextSize[kind]
	l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	l.TextWrapped = true
	l.Text = text or ""
	local colorName = "white"
	if kind == "heading" then
		colorName = "teal"
	elseif kind == "description" or kind == "status" or kind == "handle" then
		colorName = "muted"
	end
	l.TextColor3 = PanelTheme.color(colorName)
	return l
end

-- Drawer frame: bg at 0.015 transparency, 14 px corner, stroke at 0.25.
function PanelTheme.drawer(name)
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.Name = name
	f.BackgroundColor3 = PanelTheme.color("bg")
	f.BackgroundTransparency = PanelTheme.Drawer.transparency
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0
	corner(f, PanelTheme.Drawer.radius)
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = PanelTheme.color("stroke")
	stroke.Transparency = PanelTheme.Drawer.strokeTransparency
	stroke.Parent = f
	return f
end

return PanelTheme
